3.8.2.s: catuṣṭayya āpo bhavanti | catuḥśapho vā aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai | tā digbhyaḥ samābhṛtā bhavanti | dikṣu vā āpaḥ | annaṃ vā āpaḥ | adbhyo vā annaṃ jāyate | yadevādbhyo'nnaṃ jāyate | tadavarundhe | tāsu brahmaudanaṃ pacati | reta eva taddadhāti
3.8.2.d: चतुष्टय्य आपो भवन्ति । चतुःशफो वा अश्वः प्राजापत्यः समृद्ध्यै । ता दिग्भ्यः समाभृता भवन्ति । दिक्षु वा आपः । अन्नं वा आपः । अद्भ्यो वा अन्नं जायते । यदेवाद्भ्योऽन्नं जायते । तदवरुन्धे । तासु ब्रह्मौदनं पचति । रेत एव तद्दधाति

3.8.2.s: catuḥśarāvo bhavati | dikṣveva pratitiṣṭhati | ubhayato rukmau bhavataḥ | ubhayata evāsminrucaṃ dadhāti | uddharati śṛtatvāya | sarpiṣvānbhavati medhyatvāya | catvāra ārṣeyāḥ prāśnanti | diśāmeva jyotiṣi juhoti | catvāri hiraṇyāni dadāti | diśāmeva jyotīgṣyavarundhe
3.8.2.d: चतुःशरावो भवति । दिक्ष्वेव प्रतितिष्ठति । उभयतो रुक्मौ भवतः । उभयत एवास्मिन्रुचं दधाति । उद्धरति शृतत्वाय । सर्पिष्वान्भवति मेध्यत्वाय । चत्वार आर्षेयाः प्राश्नन्ति । दिशामेव ज्योतिषि जुहोति । चत्वारि हिरण्यानि ददाति । दिशामेव ज्योतीग्ष्यवरुन्धे

3.8.2.s: yadājyamucchiṣyate | tasminraśanāṃ nyunatti | prajāpatirvā odanaḥ | reta ājyam | yadājye raśanāṃ nyunatti | prajāpatimeva retasā samardhayati | darbhamayī raśanā bhavati | bahu vā eṣa kucaro'medhyamupagacchati | yadaśvaḥ | pavitraṃ vai darbhāḥ
3.8.2.d: यदाज्यमुच्छिष्यते । तस्मिन्रशनां न्युनत्ति । प्रजापतिर्वा ओदनः । रेत आज्यम् । यदाज्ये रशनां न्युनत्ति । प्रजापतिमेव रेतसा समर्धयति । दर्भमयी रशना भवति । बहु वा एष कुचरोऽमेध्यमुपगच्छति । यदश्वः । पवित्रं वै दर्भाः
3.8.2.m: Whatever ghee is left over, / in that he dips the halter. / The boiled rice mess is Prajāpati; / ghee is semen. / In that he dips the halter in ghee, / he endows Prajāpati with semen. / The halter is made of darbha grass. / He goes about much in bad ways, [and] approaches what is impure, / namely the horse. / Darbha grass is a purifier.

3.8.2.s: yaddarbhamayī raśanā bhavati | punātyevainam | pūtamenaṃ medhyamālabhate | aśvasya vā ālabdhasya mahimodakrāmat | sa mahartvijaḥ prāviśat | tanmahartvijāṃ mahartviktvam | yanmahartvijaḥ prāśnanti | mahimānamevāsmintaddadhati | aśvasya vā ālabdhasya reta udakrāmat | tathsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyamabhavat | yathsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti | reta eva taddadhāti | odane dadāti | reto vā odanaḥ | reto hiraṇyam | retasaivāsminreto dadhāti
3.8.2.d: यद्दर्भमयी रशना भवति । पुनात्येवैनम् । पूतमेनं मेध्यमालभते । अश्वस्य वा आलब्धस्य महिमोदक्रामत् । स महर्त्विजः प्राविशत् । तन्महर्त्विजां महर्त्विक्त्वम् । यन्महर्त्विजः प्राश्नन्ति । महिमानमेवास्मिन्तद्दधति । अश्वस्य वा आलब्धस्य रेत उदक्रामत् । तथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यमभवत् । यथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यं ददाति । रेत एव तद्दधाति । ओदने ददाति । रेतो वा ओदनः । रेतो हिरण्यम् । रेतसैवास्मिन्रेतो दधाति
3.8.2.m: In that the halter is made of darbha grass, / it purifies him; / purified, fit for sacrifice, he seizes him. / The greatness of the horse, when seized, departed; / it entered the chief priests. / That is the function of the chief priests as chief priests. / In that the chief priests eat [of it], / they place greatness in him thereby. / The semen of the horse, when seized, departed; / it became yellow gold. / In that he gives yellow gold, / he thereby bestows semen. / He gives it upon the boiled rice mess. / The boiled rice mess is semen; / gold is semen. / With semen he bestows semen in him.

3.8.3.s: yo vai brahmaṇe devebhyaḥ prajāpataye'pratiprocyāśvaṃ medhyaṃ badhnāti | ā devatābhyo vṛścyate | pāpīyānbhavati | yaḥ pratiprocya | na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyānbhavati | yadāha | brahmannaśvaṃ medhyaṃ bhanthsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsamiti | brahma vai brahmā | brahmaṇa eva devebhyaḥ prajāpataye pratiprocyāśvaṃ medhyaṃ badhnāti
3.8.3.d: यो वै ब्रह्मणे देवेभ्यः प्रजापतयेऽप्रतिप्रोच्याश्वं मेध्यं बध्नाति । आ देवताभ्यो वृश्च्यते । पापीयान्भवति । यः प्रतिप्रोच्य । न देवताभ्य आवृश्च्यते । वसीयान्भवति । यदाह । ब्रह्मन्नश्वं मेध्यं भन्थ्स्यामि देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये तेन राध्यासमिति । ब्रह्म वै ब्रह्मा । ब्रह्मण एव देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये प्रतिप्रोच्याश्वं मेध्यं बध्नाति
3.8.3.m: He who binds the horse fit for sacrifice without announcing [it] to the brahman priest, to the gods, to Prajāpati, / is cut off from the deities; / he becomes worse. / He who [does so] having announced [it], / is not cut off from the deities; / he becomes better off. / When he says: / 'O brahman priest, I will bind the horse fit for sacrifice for the gods, for Prajāpati; may I succeed through that,' / the brahman priest is indeed the brahman. / Having announced [it] to the brahman priest, to the gods, to Prajāpati, he binds the horse fit for sacrifice.

3.8.3.s: na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyānbhavati | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti raśanāmādatte prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha | aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | vyṛddhaṃ vā etadyajñasya | yadayajuṣkeṇa kriyate | imāmagṛbhṇanraśanāmṛtasyetyadhivadati yajuṣkṛtyai | yajñasya samṛddhyai
3.8.3.d: न देवताभ्य आवृश्च्यते । वसीयान्भवति । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति रशनामादत्ते प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह । अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । व्यृद्धं वा एतद्यज्ञस्य । यदयजुष्केण क्रियते । इमामगृभ्णन्रशनामृतस्येत्यधिवदति यजुष्कृत्यै । यज्ञस्य समृद्ध्यै
3.8.3.m: He is not cut off from the deities; / he becomes better off. / 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ,' [saying this] he takes the halter, for impulsion. / 'With the arms of the Aśvins,' he says; / for the Aśvins were the two Adhvaryu priests of the gods. / 'With the hands of Pūṣan,' he says, for restraint. / Deficient indeed is that [part] of the sacrifice / which is performed without a yajus formula. / 'They took this halter of cosmic order,' he recites over [it], to supply it with a yajus, / for the success of the sacrifice.

3.8.3.s: tadāhuḥ | dvādaśāratnī raśanā kartavyātrayodaśāratnīriti | ṛṣabho vā eṣa ṛtūnām | yathsaṃvathsaraḥ | tasya trayodaśo māso viṣṭapam | ṛṣabha eṣa yajñānām | yadaśvamedhaḥ | yathā vā ṛṣabhasya viṣṭapam | evametasya viṣṭapam | trayodaśamaratniṃ raśanāyāmupādadhāti
3.8.3.d: तदाहुः । द्वादशारत्नी रशना कर्तव्यात्रयोदशारत्नीरिति । ऋषभो वा एष ऋतूनाम् । यथ्संवथ्सरः । तस्य त्रयोदशो मासो विष्टपम् । ऋषभ एष यज्ञानाम् । यदश्वमेधः । यथा वा ऋषभस्य विष्टपम् । एवमेतस्य विष्टपम् । त्रयोदशमरत्निं रशनायामुपादधाति
3.8.3.m:
Regarding this they say: / 'Should the halter be made twelve cubits long, or thirteen cubits long?' / A bull among the seasons is this [one], / namely the year. / Its thirteenth month is the hump. / A bull among the sacrifices is this [one], / namely the Aśvamedha. / As is the hump of a bull, / so is its hump. / He adds a thirteenth cubit to the halter.

Just as one adorns the hump of a bull, / just so is that. / 'Wise in the assemblies of early life,' he says; / he places lifespan in him. / 'By her the gods attained the pressed [soma],' he says; / he turns toward prosperity. / 'Touching the course along the border of cosmic order,' he says; / truth is cosmic order; / with truth, with cosmic order he takes hold of him. / 'You are the haltering halter,' he says.

3.8.3.s: yatharṣabhasya viṣṭapaṃ saṃskaroti | tādṛgeva tat | pūrva āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavyetyāha | āyurevāsmindadhāti | tayā devāḥ sutamābabhūvurityāha | bhūtimevopāvartate | ṛtasya sāmanthsaramārapantītyāha | satyaṃ vā ṛtam | satyenaivainamṛtenārabhate | abhidhā asītyāha
3.8.3.d: यथर्षभस्य विष्टपं संस्करोति । तादृगेव तत् । पूर्व आयुषि विदथेषु कव्येत्याह । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । तया देवाः सुतमाबभूवुरित्याह । भूतिमेवोपावर्तते । ऋतस्य सामन्थ्सरमारपन्तीत्याह । सत्यं वा ऋतम् । सत्येनैवैनमृतेनारभते । अभिधा असीत्याह

3.8.3.s: tasmādaśvamedhayājī sarvāṇi bhūtānyabhibhavati | bhuvanamasītyāha | bhūmānamevopaiti | yantā'sītyāha | yantāramevainaṃ karoti | dhartā'sītyāha | dhartāramevainaṃ karoti | so'gniṃ vaiśvānaramityāha | agnāvevainaṃ vaiśvānare juhoti | saprathasamityāha
3.8.3.d: तस्मादश्वमेधयाजी सर्वाणि भूतान्यभिभवति । भुवनमसीत्याह । भूमानमेवोपैति । यन्ताऽसीत्याह । यन्तारमेवैनं करोति । धर्ताऽसीत्याह । धर्तारमेवैनं करोति । सोऽग्निं वैश्वानरमित्याह । अग्नावेवैनं वैश्वानरे जुहोति । सप्रथसमित्याह
3.8.3.m: Therefore the performer of the Aśvamedha overcomes all beings. / 'You are the world,' he says; / he attains abundance. / 'You are the restrainer,' he says; / he makes him a restrainer. / 'You are the upholder,' he says; / he makes him an upholder. / 'He [is dedicated] to Agni Vaiśvānara,' he says; / in Agni Vaiśvānara he offers him. / 'Wide-spreading,' he says.

3.8.3.s: prajayaivainaṃ paśubhiḥ prathayati | svāhākṛta ityāha | homa evāsyaiṣaḥ | pṛthivyāmityāha | asyāmevainaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | yantā rāḍyantā'si yamano dhartā'si dharuṇa ityāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | svagā tvā devebhya ityāha | devebhya evainaṃ svagā karoti | svāhā tvā prajāpataya ityāha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | yasyā eva devatāyā ālabhyate | tayaivainaṃ samardhayati
3.8.3.d: प्रजयैवैनं पशुभिः प्रथयति । स्वाहाकृत इत्याह । होम एवास्यैषः । पृथिव्यामित्याह । अस्यामेवैनं प्रतिष्ठापयति । यन्ता राड्यन्ताऽसि यमनो धर्ताऽसि धरुण इत्याह । रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । कृष्यै त्वा क्षेमाय त्वा रय्यै त्वा पोषाय त्वेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । स्वगा त्वा देवेभ्य इत्याह । देवेभ्य एवैनं स्वगा करोति । स्वाहा त्वा प्रजापतय इत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । यस्या एव देवताया आलभ्यते । तयैवैनं समर्धयति
3.8.3.m: With offspring, with domestic animals he expands him. / 'Offered with svāhā,' he says; / this is his oblation. / 'Upon the earth,' he says; / upon this [earth] he firmly establishes him. / 'A ruler, a restrainer, a guide are you; an upholder, a support are you,' he says; / he declares this form, this greatness of his. / 'Thee for agriculture, thee for security, thee for wealth, thee for nourishment,' he says; / he prays for this blessing. / 'Hail to thee, for the gods!' he says; / he makes him acceptable to the gods. / 'Svāhā to thee, for Prajāpati!' he says; / the horse belongs to Prajāpati. / To whichever deity he is seized, / with that [deity] he makes him prosper.

3.8.4.s: yaḥ pituranujāyāḥ putraḥ | sa purastānnayati | yo māturanujāyāḥ putraḥ | sa paścānnayati | viṣvañcamevāsmātpāpmānaṃ vivṛhataḥ | yo arvantaṃ jighāṃsati tamabhyamīti varuṇa iti śvānaṃ caturakṣaṃ prasauti | paro martaḥ paraḥ śveti śunaścaturakṣasya prahanti | śveva vai pāpmā bhrātṛvyaḥ | pāpmānamevāsya bhrātṛvyaṃ hanti | saidhrakaṃ musalaṃ bhavati
3.8.4.d: यः पितुरनुजायाः पुत्रः । स पुरस्तान्नयति । यो मातुरनुजायाः पुत्रः । स पश्चान्नयति । विष्वञ्चमेवास्मात्पाप्मानं विवृहतः । यो अर्वन्तं जिघांसति तमभ्यमीति वरुण इति श्वानं चतुरक्षं प्रसौति । परो मर्तः परः श्वेति शुनश्चतुरक्षस्य प्रहन्ति । श्वेव वै पाप्मा भ्रातृव्यः । पाप्मानमेवास्य भ्रातृव्यं हन्ति । सैध्रकं मुसलं भवति
3.8.4.m: He who is the son of a subsequent wife of the father, / he leads [the horse] in front. / He who is the son of a subsequent wife of the mother, / he leads [the horse] behind. / In opposite directions they tear away evil from him. / 'Whoever seeks to slay the courser, him Varuṇa attacks,' [saying this] he drives a four-eyed dog forward. / 'Far away be the mortal, far away the dog!' [saying this] he strikes down the four-eyed dog. / Like a dog indeed is evil, the rival; / he strikes down his evil rival. / The pestle is made of sidhraka wood.

3.8.4.s: karma karmaivāsmai sādhayati | pauṃścaleyo hanti | puṃścalvāṃ vai devāḥ śucaṃ nyadadhuḥ | śucaivāsya śucaṃ hanti | pāpmā vā etamīpsatītyāhuḥ | yo'śvamedhena yajata iti | aśvasyādhaspadamupāsyati | vajrī vā aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ | vajreṇaiva pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyamavakrāmati | dakṣiṇā'paplāvayati
3.8.4.d: कर्म कर्मैवास्मै साधयति । पौंश्चलेयो हन्ति । पुंश्चल्वां वै देवाः शुचं न्यदधुः । शुचैवास्य शुचं हन्ति । पाप्मा वा एतमीप्सतीत्याहुः । योऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति । अश्वस्याधस्पदमुपास्यति । वज्री वा अश्वः प्राजापत्यः । वज्रेणैव पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यमवक्रामति । दक्षिणाऽपप्लावयति
3.8.4.m: It accomplishes deed after deed for him. / The son of a harlot strikes [the dog]. / The gods placed anguish in a harlot; / with anguish he strikes his anguish. / 'Evil seeks to seize him,' they say, / '[namely] him who sacrifices with the Aśvamedha.' / He casts [the dog] under the horse's feet. / The horse belonging to Prajāpati possesses the vajra; / with the vajra he tramples down his evil rival. / He lets [the dog] float away to the south.

3.8.4.s: pāpmānamevāsmācchamalamapaplāvayati | aiṣīka udūho bhavati | āyurvā iṣīkāḥ | āyurevāsmindadhati | amṛtaṃ vā iṣīkāḥ | amṛtamevāsmindadhati | vetasa śākhopa saṃbaddhā bhavati | apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | svādevainaṃ yonernirmimīte | purastātpratyañcamabhyudūhati | purastādevāsminpratīcyamṛtaṃ dadhāti | ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahanniti brahmā yajamānasya hastaṃ gṛhṇāti | brahmakṣattre eva saṃdadhāti | abhi kratvendra bhūradhajmannityadhvaryuryajamānaṃ vācayatyabhijityai
3.8.4.d: पाप्मानमेवास्माच्छमलमपप्लावयति । ऐषीक उदूहो भवति । आयुर्वा इषीकाः । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधति । अमृतं वा इषीकाः । अमृतमेवास्मिन्दधति । वेतस शाखोप संबद्धा भवति । अप्सुयोनिर्वा अश्वः । अप्सुजो वेतसः । स्वादेवैनं योनेर्निर्मिमीते । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चमभ्युदूहति । पुरस्तादेवास्मिन्प्रतीच्यमृतं दधाति । अहं च त्वं च वृत्रहन्निति ब्रह्मा यजमानस्य हस्तं गृह्णाति । ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रे एव संदधाति । अभि क्रत्वेन्द्र भूरधज्मन्नित्यध्वर्युर्यजमानं वाचयत्यभिजित्यै
3.8.4.m: He washes away evil, defilement from him. / The broom is made of reeds. / Lifespan is reeds; / they place lifespan in him. / Immortality is reeds; / they place immortality in him. / A cane branch is tied to [it]. / The horse has his origin in water; / cane is born in water; / he produces him from his own source. / From the east facing west he sweeps toward [him]; / from the east toward the west he places immortality in him. / 'Both I and you, O Vṛtra-slayer,' [saying this] the brahman priest takes the hand of the sacrificer; / he unites the brahman and the regal power. / 'Thou hast overcome by mental power, O Indra, beneath the earth,' [saying this] the Adhvaryu makes the sacrificer recite, for victorious conquest.

3.8.5.s: catvāra ṛtvijaḥ samukṣanti | ābhya evainaṃ catasṛbhyo digbhyo'bhisamīrayanti | śatena rājaputraiḥ sahādhvaryuḥ | purastātpratyaṅtiṣṭhanprokṣati | anenāśvena medhyeneṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā vṛtraṃ vadhyāditi | rājyaṃ vā adhvaryuḥ | kṣattraṃ rājaputraḥ | rājyenaivāsmin kṣattraṃ dadhāti | śatenārājabhirugraiḥ saha brahmā
3.8.5.d: चत्वार ऋत्विजः समुक्षन्ति । आभ्य एवैनं चतसृभ्यो दिग्भ्योऽभिसमीरयन्ति । शतेन राजपुत्रैः सहाध्वर्युः । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ्तिष्ठन्प्रोक्षति । अनेनाश्वेन मेध्येनेष्ट्वा । अयं राजा वृत्रं वध्यादिति । राज्यं वा अध्वर्युः । क्षत्त्रं राजपुत्रः । राज्येनैवास्मिन् क्षत्त्रं दधाति । शतेनाराजभिरुग्रैः सह ब्रह्मा
3.8.5.m: Four priests sprinkle [him] together; / from these four directions they impel him together. / The Adhvaryu, together with a hundred sons of kings, / standing in front, facing west, sprinkles [him], / [saying]: 'Having sacrificed with this horse fit for sacrifice, / may this king slay Vṛtra.' / The Adhvaryu is sovereignty; / the king's son is regal power; / by means of sovereignty he places regal power in him. / The brahman priest, together with a hundred fierce non-kings, [sprinkles him]—

3.8.5.s: dakṣiṇata udaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | anenāśvena medhyeneṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā'pratidhṛṣyo'stviti | balaṃ vai brahmā | balamarājograḥ | balenaivāsminbalaṃ dadhāti | śatena sūtagrāmaṇibhiḥ saha hotā | paścāt prāṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | anenāśvena medhyeneṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā'syai viśaḥ
3.8.5.d: दक्षिणत उदङ् तिष्ठन् प्रोक्षति । अनेनाश्वेन मेध्येनेष्ट्वा । अयं राजाऽप्रतिधृष्योऽस्त्विति । बलं वै ब्रह्मा । बलमराजोग्रः । बलेनैवास्मिन्बलं दधाति । शतेन सूतग्रामणिभिः सह होता । पश्चात् प्राङ् तिष्ठन् प्रोक्षति । अनेनाश्वेन मेध्येनेष्ट्वा । अयं राजाऽस्यै विशः
3.8.5.m:
Standing on the south facing north, he sprinkles [him, saying]:
"Having sacrificed with this sacrificial horse,
may this king be unassailable!"
Power indeed is the Brahman;
power is the non-kingly noble.
With power he thus places power in him.
Together with a hundred heralds and village chiefs, the Hotṛ,
standing on the west facing east, sprinkles [him, saying]:
"Having sacrificed with this sacrificial horse,
may this king be [the king] of this populace,

3.8.5.s: bahugvai bahvaśvāyai bahvajāvikāyai | bahuvrīhiyavāyai bahumāṣatilāyai | bahuhiraṇyāyai bahuhastikāyai | bahudāsapūruṣāyai rayimatyai puṣṭimatyai | bahurāyaspoṣāyai rājā'stviti | bhūmā vai hotā | bhūmā sūtagrāmaṇyaḥ | bhūmnaivāsminbhūmānaṃ dadhāti | śatena kṣattasaṃgrahītṛbhiḥ sahodgātā | uttarato dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan prokṣati
3.8.5.d: बहुग्वै बह्वश्वायै बह्वजाविकायै । बहुव्रीहियवायै बहुमाषतिलायै । बहुहिरण्यायै बहुहस्तिकायै । बहुदासपूरुषायै रयिमत्यै पुष्टिमत्यै । बहुरायस्पोषायै राजाऽस्त्विति । भूमा वै होता । भूमा सूतग्रामण्यः । भूम्नैवास्मिन्भूमानं दधाति । शतेन क्षत्तसंग्रहीतृभिः सहोद्गाता । उत्तरतो दक्षिणा तिष्ठन् प्रोक्षति
3.8.5.m:
rich in cows, rich in horses, rich in goats and sheep,
rich in rice and barley, rich in beans and sesame,
rich in gold, rich in elephants,
rich in male servants and men, possessed of wealth, possessed of nourishment,
rich in the increase of wealth!"
Abundance indeed is the Hotṛ;
abundance are the heralds and village chiefs.
With abundance he thus places abundance in him.
Together with a hundred chamberlains and charioteers, the Udgātṛ,
standing on the north facing south, sprinkles [him, saying]:

3.8.5.s: anenāśvena medhyeneṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā sarvamāyuretviti | āyurvā udgātā | āyuḥ kṣattasaṃgrahītāraḥ | āyuṣaivāsminnāyurdadhāti | śataṃ śataṃ bhavanti | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati | catuḥśatā bhavanti | catasro diśaḥ | dikṣveva pratitiṣṭhati
3.8.5.d: अनेनाश्वेन मेध्येनेष्ट्वा । अयं राजा सर्वमायुरेत्विति । आयुर्वा उद्गाता । आयुः क्षत्तसंग्रहीतारः । आयुषैवास्मिन्नायुर्दधाति । शतं शतं भवन्ति । शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति । चतुःशता भवन्ति । चतस्रो दिशः । दिक्ष्वेव प्रतितिष्ठति

3.8.6.s: yathā vai haviṣo gṛhītasya skandati | evaṃ vā etadaśvasya skandati | yanniktamanālabdhamuthsṛjanti | yathstokyā anvāha | sarvahutamevainaṃ karotyaskandāya | askannaṃ hi tat | yaddhutasya skandati | sahasramanvāha | sahasrasaṃmitaḥ suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai
3.8.6.d: यथा वै हविषो गृहीतस्य स्कन्दति । एवं वा एतदश्वस्य स्कन्दति । यन्निक्तमनालब्धमुथ्सृजन्ति । यथ्स्तोक्या अन्वाह । सर्वहुतमेवैनं करोत्यस्कन्दाय । अस्कन्नं हि तत् । यद्धुतस्य स्कन्दति । सहस्रमन्वाह । सहस्रसंमितः सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै

3.8.6.s: yatparimitā anubrūyāt | parimitamavarundhīta | aparimitā anvāha | aparimitaḥ suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | stokyā juhoti | yā eva varṣyā āpaḥ | tā avarundhe | asyāṃ juhoti | iyaṃ vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ
3.8.6.d: यत्परिमिता अनुब्रूयात् । परिमितमवरुन्धीत । अपरिमिता अन्वाह । अपरिमितः सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । स्तोक्या जुहोति । या एव वर्ष्या आपः । ता अवरुन्धे । अस्यां जुहोति । इयं वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः

3.8.6.s: asyāmevaināḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati | uvāca ha prajāpatiḥ | stokyāsu vā ahamaśvamedhaṃ saṃsthāpayāmi | tena tataḥ saṃsthitena carāmīti | agnaye svāhetyāha | agnaya evainaṃ juhoti | somāya svāhetyāha | somāyaivainaṃ juhoti | savitre svāhetyāha | savitra evainaṃ juhoti
3.8.6.d: अस्यामेवैनाः प्रतिष्ठापयति । उवाच ह प्रजापतिः । स्तोक्यासु वा अहमश्वमेधं संस्थापयामि । तेन ततः संस्थितेन चरामीति । अग्नये स्वाहेत्याह । अग्नय एवैनं जुहोति । सोमाय स्वाहेत्याह । सोमायैवैनं जुहोति । सवित्रे स्वाहेत्याह । सवित्र एवैनं जुहोति

3.8.6.s: sarasvatyai svāhetyāha | sarasvatyā evainaṃ juhoti | pūṣṇe svāhetyāha | pūṣṇa evainaṃ juhoti | bṛhaspataye svāhetyāha | bṛhaspataya evainaṃ juhoti | apāṃ modāya svāhetyāha | adbhya evainaṃ juhoti | vāyave svāhetyāha | vāyava evainaṃ juhoti
3.8.6.d: सरस्वत्यै स्वाहेत्याह । सरस्वत्या एवैनं जुहोति । पूष्णे स्वाहेत्याह । पूष्ण एवैनं जुहोति । बृहस्पतये स्वाहेत्याह । बृहस्पतय एवैनं जुहोति । अपां मोदाय स्वाहेत्याह । अद्भ्य एवैनं जुहोति । वायवे स्वाहेत्याह । वायव एवैनं जुहोति

3.8.6.s: mitrāya svāhetyāha | mitrāyaivainaṃ juhoti | varuṇāya svāhetyāha | varuṇāyaivainaṃ juhoti | etābhya evainaṃ devatābhyo juhoti | daśa daśa saṃpādaṃ juhoti | daśākṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | pra vā eṣo'smāllokāccyavate | yaḥ parācīrāhutīrjuhoti | punaḥ punarabhyāvartaṃ juhoti | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | etāṃ ha vāva so'śvamedhasya saṃsthitimuvācāskandāya | askannaṃ hi tat | yadyajñasya saṃsthitasya skandati
3.8.6.d: मित्राय स्वाहेत्याह । मित्रायैवैनं जुहोति । वरुणाय स्वाहेत्याह । वरुणायैवैनं जुहोति । एताभ्य एवैनं देवताभ्यो जुहोति । दश दश संपादं जुहोति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । प्र वा एषोऽस्माल्लोकाच्च्यवते । यः पराचीराहुतीर्जुहोति । पुनः पुनरभ्यावर्तं जुहोति । अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । एतां ह वाव सोऽश्वमेधस्य संस्थितिमुवाचास्कन्दाय । अस्कन्नं हि तत् । यद्यज्ञस्य संस्थितस्य स्कन्दति

3.8.7.s: prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīti purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | prajāpatirvai devānāmannādo vīryāvān | annādyamevāsminvīryaṃ dadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāmannādo vīryāvattamaḥ | indrāgnibhyāṃ tveti dakṣiṇataḥ | indrāgnī vai devānāmojiṣṭhau baliṣṭhau | oja evāsminbalaṃ dadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāmojiṣṭho baliṣṭhaḥ | vāyave tveti paścāt | vāyurvai devānāmāśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ
3.8.7.d: प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामीति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ् तिष्ठन् प्रोक्षति । प्रजापतिर्वै देवानामन्नादो वीर्यावान् । अन्नाद्यमेवास्मिन्वीर्यं दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनामन्नादो वीर्यावत्तमः । इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वेति दक्षिणतः । इन्द्राग्नी वै देवानामोजिष्ठौ बलिष्ठौ । ओज एवास्मिन्बलं दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनामोजिष्ठो बलिष्ठः । वायवे त्वेति पश्चात् । वायुर्वै देवानामाशुः सारसारितमः

3.8.7.s: javamevāsmindadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāmāśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ | viśvebhyastvā devebhya ityuttarataḥ | viśve vai devā devānāṃ yaśasvitamāḥ | yaśa evāsmindadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāṃ yaśasvitamaḥ | devebhyastvetyadhastāt | devā vai devānāmapacitatamāḥ | apacitimevāsmindadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāmapacitatamaḥ
3.8.7.d: जवमेवास्मिन्दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनामाशुः सारसारितमः । विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य इत्युत्तरतः । विश्वे वै देवा देवानां यशस्वितमाः । यश एवास्मिन्दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनां यशस्वितमः । देवेभ्यस्त्वेत्यधस्तात् । देवा वै देवानामपचिततमाः । अपचितिमेवास्मिन्दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनामपचिततमः

3.8.7.s: sarvebhyastvā devebhya ityupariṣṭāt | sarve vai devāstviṣimanto harasvinaḥ | tviṣimevāsmin haro dadhāti | tasmādaśvaḥ paśūnāṃ tviṣimān harasvitamaḥ | dive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvetyāha | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyaḥ prokṣati | sate tvā'sate tvā'dbhyastvauṣadhībhyastvā viśvebhyastvā bhūtebhya ityāha | tasmādaśvamedhayājinaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtānyupajīvanti | brahmavādino vadanti | yatprājāpatyo'śvaḥ | atha kasmādenamanyābhyo devatābhyo'pi prokṣatīti | aśve vai sarvā devatā anvāyattāḥ | taṃ yadviśvebhyastvā bhūtebhya iti prokṣati | devatā evāsminnanvāyātayati | tasmādaśve sarvā devatā anvāyattāḥ
3.8.7.d: सर्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य इत्युपरिष्टात् । सर्वे वै देवास्त्विषिमन्तो हरस्विनः । त्विषिमेवास्मिन् हरो दधाति । तस्मादश्वः पशूनां त्विषिमान् हरस्वितमः । दिवे त्वाऽन्तरिक्षाय त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वेत्याह । एभ्य एवैनं लोकेभ्यः प्रोक्षति । सते त्वाऽसते त्वाऽद्भ्यस्त्वौषधीभ्यस्त्वा विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा भूतेभ्य इत्याह । तस्मादश्वमेधयाजिनं सर्वाणि भूतान्युपजीवन्ति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । यत्प्राजापत्योऽश्वः । अथ कस्मादेनमन्याभ्यो देवताभ्योऽपि प्रोक्षतीति । अश्वे वै सर्वा देवता अन्वायत्ताः । तं यद्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा भूतेभ्य इति प्रोक्षति । देवता एवास्मिन्नन्वायातयति । तस्मादश्वे सर्वा देवता अन्वायत्ताः

3.8.8.s: yathā vai haviṣo gṛhītasya skandati | evaṃ vā etadaśvasya skandati | yatprokṣitamanālabdhamuthsṛjanti | yadaśvacaritāni juhoti | sarvahutamevainaṃ karotyaskandāya | askannaṃ hi tat | yaddhutasya skandati | īṃkārāya svāheṃkṛtāya svāhetyāha | etāni vā aśvacaritāni | caritairevainaṃ samardhayati
3.8.8.d: यथा वै हविषो गृहीतस्य स्कन्दति । एवं वा एतदश्वस्य स्कन्दति । यत्प्रोक्षितमनालब्धमुथ्सृजन्ति । यदश्वचरितानि जुहोति । सर्वहुतमेवैनं करोत्यस्कन्दाय । अस्कन्नं हि तत् । यद्धुतस्य स्कन्दति । ईंकाराय स्वाहेंकृताय स्वाहेत्याह । एतानि वा अश्वचरितानि । चरितैरेवैनं समर्धयति

3.8.8.s: tadāhuḥ | anāhutayo vā aśvacaritāni | naitā hotavyā iti | atho khalvāhuḥ | hotavyā eva | atra vāvaivaṃ vidvānaśvamedhaṃ saṃsthāpayati | yadaśvacaritāni juhoti | tasmāddhotavyā iti | bahirdhā vā enametadāyatanāddadhāti | bhrātṛvyamasmai janayati
3.8.8.d: तदाहुः । अनाहुतयो वा अश्वचरितानि । नैता होतव्या इति । अथो खल्वाहुः । होतव्या एव । अत्र वावैवं विद्वानश्वमेधं संस्थापयति । यदश्वचरितानि जुहोति । तस्माद्धोतव्या इति । बहिर्धा वा एनमेतदायतनाद्दधाति । भ्रातृव्यमस्मै जनयति

3.8.8.s: yasyānāyatane'nyatrāgnerāhutīrjuhoti | sāvitriyā iṣṭyāḥ purastāthsviṣṭakṛtaḥ | āhavanīye'śvacaritāni juhoti | āyatana evāsyāhutīrjuhoti | nāsmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | tadāhuḥ | yajñamukhe yajñamukhe hotavyāḥ | yajñasya klṛptyai | suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyā iti | atho khalvāhuḥ |
3.8.8.d: यस्यानायतनेऽन्यत्राग्नेराहुतीर्जुहोति । सावित्रिया इष्ट्याः पुरस्ताथ्स्विष्टकृतः । आहवनीयेऽश्वचरितानि जुहोति । आयतन एवास्याहुतीर्जुहोति । नास्मै भ्रातृव्यं जनयति । तदाहुः । यज्ञमुखे यज्ञमुखे होतव्याः । यज्ञस्य क्लृप्त्यै । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्या इति । अथो खल्वाहुः ।
3.8.8.m:
[The rival gets born] of him who offers the oblations in a non-proper receptacle, elsewhere than in the fire.
Before the Sviṣṭakṛt of the Sāvitra offering,
he offers the horse-actions into the Āhavanīya fire.
He offers the oblations in his proper place itself;
he does not generate a rival for him.
On this they say:
‘They should be offered at each mouth of the sacrifice,
for the proper arrangement of the sacrifice,
for the revelation of the heavenly realm.’
Now, however, they say:

3.8.8.s: yadyajñamukhe yajñamukhe juhuyāt | paśubhiryajamānaṃ vyardhayet | ava suvargāllokātpadyeta | pāpīyānthsyāditi | sakṛdeva hotavyāḥ | na yajamānaṃ paśubhirvyardhayati | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | na pāpīyānbhavati | aṣṭācatvāriṃśatamaśvarūpāṇi juhoti | aṣṭācatvāriṃśadakṣarā jagatī | jāgato'śvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai | ekamatiriktaṃ juhoti | tasmādekaḥ prajāsvardhukaḥ
3.8.8.d: यद्यज्ञमुखे यज्ञमुखे जुहुयात् । पशुभिर्यजमानं व्यर्धयेत् । अव सुवर्गाल्लोकात्पद्येत । पापीयान्थ्स्यादिति । सकृदेव होतव्याः । न यजमानं पशुभिर्व्यर्धयति । अभि सुवर्गं लोकं जयति । न पापीयान्भवति । अष्टाचत्वारिंशतमश्वरूपाणि जुहोति । अष्टाचत्वारिंशदक्षरा जगती । जागतोऽश्वः प्राजापत्यः समृद्ध्यै । एकमतिरिक्तं जुहोति । तस्मादेकः प्रजास्वर्धुकः

3.8.9.s: vibhūrmātrā prabhūḥ pitretyāha | iyaṃ vai mātā | asau pitā | ābhyāmevainaṃ paridadāti | aśvo'si hayo'sītyāha | śāstyevainametat | tasmācchiṣṭāḥ prajā jāyante | atyo'sītyāha | tasmādaśvaḥ sarvānpaśūnatye'ti | tasmādaśvaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśūnāg śraiṣṭhyaṃ gacchati
3.8.9.d: विभूर्मात्रा प्रभूः पित्रेत्याह । इयं वै माता । असौ पिता । आभ्यामेवैनं परिददाति । अश्वोऽसि हयोऽसीत्याह । शास्त्येवैनमेतत् । तस्माच्छिष्टाः प्रजा जायन्ते । अत्योऽसीत्याह । तस्मादश्वः सर्वान्पशूनत्येऽति । तस्मादश्वः सर्वेषां पशूनाग् श्रैष्ठ्यं गच्छति

3.8.9.s: pra yaśaḥ śraiṣṭhyamāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | naro'syarvā'si saptirasi vājyasītyāha | rūpamevāsyaitanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | yayurnāmā'sītyāha | etadvā aśvasya priyaṃ nāmadheyam | priyeṇaivainaṃ nāmadheyenābhivadati | tasmādapyāmitrau saṃgatya | nāmnā ceddhvayete | mitrameva bhavataḥ
3.8.9.d: प्र यशः श्रैष्ठ्यमाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । नरोऽस्यर्वाऽसि सप्तिरसि वाज्यसीत्याह । रूपमेवास्यैतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । ययुर्नामाऽसीत्याह । एतद्वा अश्वस्य प्रियं नामधेयम् । प्रियेणैवैनं नामधेयेनाभिवदति । तस्मादप्यामित्रौ संगत्य । नाम्ना चेद्ध्वयेते । मित्रमेव भवतः

3.8.9.s: ādityānāṃ patvā'nvihītyāha | ādityānevainaṃ gamayati | agnaye svāhā svāhendrāgnibhyāmiti pūrvahomāñjuhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati | bhūrasi bhuve tvā bhavyāya tvā bhaviṣyate tvetyuthsṛjati sarvatvāya | devā āśāpālā etaṃ devebhyo'śvaṃ medhāya prokṣitaṃ gopāyatetyāha | śataṃ vai talpyā rājaputrā devā āśāpālāḥ | tebhya evainaṃ paridadāti | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ | iha dhṛtiḥ svāheha vidhṛtiḥ svāheha rantiḥ svāheha ramatiḥ svāheti catṛṣu pathsu juhoti
3.8.9.d: आदित्यानां पत्वाऽन्विहीत्याह । आदित्यानेवैनं गमयति । अग्नये स्वाहा स्वाहेन्द्राग्निभ्यामिति पूर्वहोमाञ्जुहोति । पूर्व एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति । भूरसि भुवे त्वा भव्याय त्वा भविष्यते त्वेत्युथ्सृजति सर्वत्वाय । देवा आशापाला एतं देवेभ्योऽश्वं मेधाय प्रोक्षितं गोपायतेत्याह । शतं वै तल्प्या राजपुत्रा देवा आशापालाः । तेभ्य एवैनं परिददाति । ईश्वरो वा अश्वः प्रमुक्तः परां परावतं गन्तोः । इह धृतिः स्वाहेह विधृतिः स्वाहेह रन्तिः स्वाहेह रमतिः स्वाहेति चतृषु पथ्सु जुहोति

3.8.9.s: etā vā aśvasya bandhanam | tābhirevainaṃ badhnāti | tasmādaśvaḥ pramukto bandhanamāgacchati | tasmādaśvaḥ pramukto bandhanaṃ na jahāti | rāṣṭraṃ vā aśvamedhaḥ | rāṣṭre khalu vā ete vyāyacchante | ye'śvaṃ medhyaṃ rakṣanti | teṣāṃ ya udṛcaṃ gacchanti | rāṣṭrādeva te rāṣṭraṃ gacchanti | atha ya udṛcaṃ na gacchanti |
3.8.9.d: एता वा अश्वस्य बन्धनम् । ताभिरेवैनं बध्नाति । तस्मादश्वः प्रमुक्तो बन्धनमागच्छति । तस्मादश्वः प्रमुक्तो बन्धनं न जहाति । राष्ट्रं वा अश्वमेधः । राष्ट्रे खलु वा एते व्यायच्छन्ते । येऽश्वं मेध्यं रक्षन्ति । तेषां य उदृचं गच्छन्ति । राष्ट्रादेव ते राष्ट्रं गच्छन्ति । अथ य उदृचं न गच्छन्ति ।

3.8.9.s: rāṣṭrādeva te vyavacchidyante | parā vā eṣa sicyate | yo'balo'śvamedhena yajate | yadamitrā aśvaṃ vinderan | hanyetāsya yajñaḥ | catuḥśatā rakṣanti | yajñasyāghātāya | athānyamānīya prokṣeyuḥ | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ
3.8.9.d: राष्ट्रादेव ते व्यवच्छिद्यन्ते । परा वा एष सिच्यते । योऽबलोऽश्वमेधेन यजते । यदमित्रा अश्वं विन्देरन् । हन्येतास्य यज्ञः । चतुःशता रक्षन्ति । यज्ञस्याघाताय । अथान्यमानीय प्रोक्षेयुः । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः

3.8.10.s: prajāpatirakāmayatāśvamedhena yajeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | tasya tepānasya | saptātmano devatā udakrāman | sā dīkṣā'bhavat | sa etāni vaiśvadevānyapaśyat | tānyajuhot | tairvai sa dīkṣāmavārundha | yadvaiśvadevāni juhoti | dīkṣāmeva tairyajamāno'varundhe
3.8.10.d: प्रजापतिरकामयताश्वमेधेन यजेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । तस्य तेपानस्य । सप्तात्मनो देवता उदक्रामन् । सा दीक्षाऽभवत् । स एतानि वैश्वदेवान्यपश्यत् । तान्यजुहोत् । तैर्वै स दीक्षामवारुन्ध । यद्वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । दीक्षामेव तैर्यजमानोऽवरुन्धे

3.8.10.s: sapta juhoti | sapta hi tā devatā udakrāman | anvahaṃ juhoti | anvahameva dīkṣāmavarundhe | trīṇi vaiśvadevāni juhoti | catvāryaudgrahaṇāni | sapta saṃpadyante | sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | prāṇā dīkṣā | prāṇaireva prāṇāndīkṣāmavarundhe
3.8.10.d: सप्त जुहोति । सप्त हि ता देवता उदक्रामन् । अन्वहं जुहोति । अन्वहमेव दीक्षामवरुन्धे । त्रीणि वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । चत्वार्यौद्ग्रहणानि । सप्त संपद्यन्ते । सप्त वै शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः । प्राणा दीक्षा । प्राणैरेव प्राणान्दीक्षामवरुन्धे

3.8.10.s: ekaviṃśatiṃ vaiśvadevāni juhoti | ekaviṃśatirvai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | taddaivyaṃ kṣattram | sā śrīḥ | tadbradhnasya viṣṭapam | tathsvārājyamucyate
3.8.10.d: एकविंशतिं वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । एकविंशतिर्वै देवलोकाः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एष सुवर्गो लोकः । तद्दैव्यं क्षत्त्रम् । सा श्रीः । तद्ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् । तथ्स्वाराज्यमुच्यते

3.8.10.s: triṃśatamaudgrahaṇāni juhoti | triṃśadakṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | tredhā vibhajya devatāṃ juhoti | tryāvṛto vai devāḥ | tryāvṛta ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ klṛptyai | apa vā etasmāt prāṇāḥ krāmanti
3.8.10.d: त्रिंशतमौद्ग्रहणानि जुहोति । त्रिंशदक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । त्रेधा विभज्य देवतां जुहोति । त्र्यावृतो वै देवाः । त्र्यावृत इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । एषां लोकानां क्लृप्त्यै । अप वा एतस्मात् प्राणाः क्रामन्ति

3.8.10.s: yo dīkṣāmati recayati | saptāhaṃ pracaranti | sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | prāṇā dīkṣā | prāṇaireva prāṇāndīkṣāmavarundhe | pūrṇāhutimuttamāṃ juhoti | sarvaṃ vai pūrṇāhutiḥ | sarvamevāpnoti | atho iyaṃ vai pūrṇāhutiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati
3.8.10.d: यो दीक्षामति रेचयति । सप्ताहं प्रचरन्ति । सप्त वै शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः । प्राणा दीक्षा । प्राणैरेव प्राणान्दीक्षामवरुन्धे । पूर्णाहुतिमुत्तमां जुहोति । सर्वं वै पूर्णाहुतिः । सर्वमेवाप्नोति । अथो इयं वै पूर्णाहुतिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति

3.8.11.s: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | taṃ sṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃcanodayacchat | taṃ vaiśvadevānyevodayacchan | yadvaiśvadevāni juhoti | yajñasyodyatyai | svāhā''dhimādhītāya svāhā | svāhā''dhītaṃ manase svāhā | svāhā manaḥ prajāpataye svāhā | kāya svāhā kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāheti prājāpatye mukhye bhavataḥ | prajāpatimukhābhirevainaṃ devatābhirudyacchate
3.8.11.d: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । तं सृष्टं न किंचनोदयच्छत् । तं वैश्वदेवान्येवोदयच्छन् । यद्वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । यज्ञस्योद्यत्यै । स्वाहा'ऽधिमाधीताय स्वाहा । स्वाहा'ऽधीतं मनसे स्वाहा । स्वाहा मनः प्रजापतये स्वाहा । काय स्वाहा कस्मै स्वाहा कतमस्मै स्वाहेति प्राजापत्ये मुख्ये भवतः । प्रजापतिमुखाभिरेवैनं देवताभिरुद्यच्छते
3.8.11.m:
Prajāpati created the horse sacrifice;
when it was created, nothing lifted it up.
The Vaiśvadeva [oblations] alone lifted it up.
When he offers the Vaiśvadeva [oblations],
[it is] for the raising of the sacrifice.
‘Svāhā to attention, svāhā to that which is attended to!
Svāhā to that which is attended to, svāhā to the mind!
Svāhā to the mind, svāhā to Prajāpati!
To Ka svāhā, to Kasmai svāhā, to Katamasmai svāhā!’—these two belonging to Prajāpati are foremost;
with deities that have Prajāpati at their head, he lifts it up.

3.8.11.s: adityai svāhā'dityai mahyai svāhā'dityai sumṛḍīkāyai svāhetyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāyodyacchate | sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhetyāha | vāgvai sarasvatī | vācaivainamudyacchate | pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe narandhiṣāya svāhetyāha | paśavo vai pūṣā | paśubhirevainamudyacchate | tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre pururūpāya svāhetyāha | tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ mithunānāṃ rūpakṛt | rūpameva paśuṣu dadhāti | atho rūpairevainamudyacchate | viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave nikhuryapāya svāhā viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhetyāha | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñāyaivainamudyacchate | pūrṇāhutimuttamāṃ juhoti | pratyuttabdhyai sayatvāya
3.8.11.d: अदित्यै स्वाहाऽदित्यै मह्यै स्वाहाऽदित्यै सुमृडीकायै स्वाहेत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्या एवैनं प्रतिष्ठायोद्यच्छते । सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै बृहत्यै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै पावकायै स्वाहेत्याह । वाग्वै सरस्वती । वाचैवैनमुद्यच्छते । पूष्णे स्वाहा पूष्णे प्रपथ्याय स्वाहा पूष्णे नरन्धिषाय स्वाहेत्याह । पशवो वै पूषा । पशुभिरेवैनमुद्यच्छते । त्वष्ट्रे स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे तुरीपाय स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे पुरुरूपाय स्वाहेत्याह । त्वष्टा वै पशूनां मिथुनानां रूपकृत् । रूपमेव पशुषु दधाति । अथो रूपैरेवैनमुद्यच्छते । विष्णवे स्वाहा विष्णवे निखुर्यपाय स्वाहा विष्णवे निभूयपाय स्वाहेत्याह । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । यज्ञायैवैनमुद्यच्छते । पूर्णाहुतिमुत्तमां जुहोति । प्रत्युत्तब्ध्यै सयत्वाय
3.8.11.m: "To Aditi svāhā! To Aditi the great svāhā! To Aditi the very gracious svāhā!" he says. / This [earth] is Aditi. / Upon this very [earth] as a foundation he sustains it. / "To Sarasvatī svāhā! To Sarasvatī the mighty svāhā! To Sarasvatī the purifying svāhā!" he says. / Speech is Sarasvatī. / By speech he sustains it. / "To Pūṣan svāhā! To Pūṣan of the journey svāhā! To Pūṣan who watches over men svāhā!" he says. / Domestic animals are Pūṣan. / By domestic animals he sustains it. / "To Tvaṣṭṛ svāhā! To Tvaṣṭṛ the quick protector svāhā! To Tvaṣṭṛ of many forms svāhā!" he says. / Tvaṣṭṛ is the maker of forms of mating domestic animals. / He establishes form in domestic animals. / And also by forms he sustains it. / "To Viṣṇu svāhā! To Viṣṇu who protects from falling svāhā! To Viṣṇu who protects from sinking svāhā!" he says. / Sacrifice is Viṣṇu. / For the sacrifice he sustains it. / He offers a full offering last, / for firm support, for cohesion.

3.8.12.s: sāvitramaṣṭākapālaṃ prātarnirvapati | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanam | prātaḥsavanādevainaṃ gāyatriyāśchandaso'dhi nirmimīte | atho prātaḥsavanameva tenāpnoti | gāyatrīṃ chandaḥ | savitre prasavitra ekādaśakapālaṃ madhyandine | ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup | traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam | mādhyandinādevainaṃ savanāt triṣṭubhaśchandaso'dhi nirmimīte
3.8.12.d: सावित्रमष्टाकपालं प्रातर्निर्वपति । अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री । गायत्रं प्रातःसवनम् । प्रातःसवनादेवैनं गायत्रियाश्छन्दसोऽधि निर्मिमीते । अथो प्रातःसवनमेव तेनाप्नोति । गायत्रीं छन्दः । सवित्रे प्रसवित्र एकादशकपालं मध्यन्दिने । एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुप् । त्रैष्टुभं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् । माध्यन्दिनादेवैनं सवनात् त्रिष्टुभश्छन्दसोऽधि निर्मिमीते
3.8.12.m: He sets apart an eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Savitṛ in the morning. / The gāyatrī has eight syllables. / The morning pressing belongs to the gāyatrī. / From the morning pressing, from the gāyatrī meter he fashions him. / Moreover, he obtains the morning pressing thereby, / [and] the gāyatrī meter. / To Savitṛ the impeller, an eleven-pot-sherd [cake] at midday. / The triṣṭubh has eleven syllables. / The midday pressing belongs to the triṣṭubh. / From the midday pressing, from the triṣṭubh meter he fashions him.

3.8.12.s: atho mādhyandinameva savanaṃ tenāpnoti | triṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ | savitra āsavitre dvādaśakapālamaparāhṇe | dvādaśākṣarā jagatī | jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam | tṛtīyasavanādevainaṃ jagatyāśchandaso'dhi nirmimīte | atho tṛtīyasavanameva tenāpnoti | jagatīṃ chandaḥ | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ | iha dhṛtiḥ svāheha vidhṛtiḥ svāheha rantiḥ svāheha ramatiḥ svāheti catasra āhutīrjuhoti |
3.8.12.d: अथो माध्यन्दिनमेव सवनं तेनाप्नोति । त्रिष्टुभं छन्दः । सवित्र आसवित्रे द्वादशकपालमपराह्णे । द्वादशाक्षरा जगती । जागतं तृतीयसवनम् । तृतीयसवनादेवैनं जगत्याश्छन्दसोऽधि निर्मिमीते । अथो तृतीयसवनमेव तेनाप्नोति । जगतीं छन्दः । ईश्वरो वा अश्वः प्रमुक्तः परां परावतं गन्तोः । इह धृतिः स्वाहेह विधृतिः स्वाहेह रन्तिः स्वाहेह रमतिः स्वाहेति चतस्र आहुतीर्जुहोति ।
3.8.12.m: Moreover, he obtains the midday pressing thereby, / [and] the triṣṭubh meter. / To Savitṛ who brings about, a twelve-pot-sherd [cake] in the afternoon. / The jagatī has twelve syllables. / The third pressing belongs to the jagatī. / From the third pressing, from the jagatī meter he fashions him. / Moreover, he obtains the third pressing thereby, / [and] the jagatī meter. / Left free, the horse is capable of going to the farthest distance. / "Here is holding, svāhā! Here is maintaining, svāhā! Here is delight, svāhā! Here is delight, svāhā!" Thus he offers four oblations.

3.8.12.s: catasro diśaḥ | digbhirevainaṃ parigṛhṇāti | āśvattho vrajo bhavati | prajāpatirdevebhyo nilāyata | aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | so'śvatthe saṃvathsaramatiṣṭhat | tadaśvatthasyāśvatthatvam | yadāśvattho vrajo bhavati | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati
3.8.12.d: चतस्रो दिशः । दिग्भिरेवैनं परिगृह्णाति । आश्वत्थो व्रजो भवति । प्रजापतिर्देवेभ्यो निलायत । अश्वो रूपं कृत्वा । सोऽश्वत्थे संवथ्सरमतिष्ठत् । तदश्वत्थस्याश्वत्थत्वम् । यदाश्वत्थो व्रजो भवति । स्व एवैनं योनौ प्रतिष्ठापयति
3.8.12.m: There are four quarters. / By the quarters he encompasses it. / The enclosure is of aśvattha wood. / Prajāpati hid from the gods, / having assumed the form of a horse. / He stayed in an aśvattha [tree] for a year. / That is the aśvattha-nature of the aśvattha. / When the enclosure is of aśvattha wood, / he establishes him in his own womb.

3.8.13.s: ā brahmanbrāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatāmityāha | brāhmaṇa eva brahmavarcasaṃ dadhāti | tasmātpurā brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasyajāyata | ā'sminrāṣṭre rājanya iṣavyaḥ śūro mahāratho jāyatāmityāha | rājanya eva śauryaṃ mahimānaṃ dadhāti | tasmātpurā rājanya iṣavyaḥ śūro mahāratho'jāyata | dogdhrī dhenurityāha | dhenvāmeva payo dadhāti | tasmātpurā dogdhrī dhenurajāyata | voḍhā'naḍvānityāha
3.8.13.d: आ ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायतामित्याह । ब्राह्मण एव ब्रह्मवर्चसं दधाति । तस्मात्पुरा ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चस्यजायत । आऽस्मिन्राष्ट्रे राजन्य इषव्यः शूरो महारथो जायतामित्याह । राजन्य एव शौर्यं महिमानं दधाति । तस्मात्पुरा राजन्य इषव्यः शूरो महारथोऽजायत । दोग्ध्री धेनुरित्याह । धेन्वामेव पयो दधाति । तस्मात्पुरा दोग्ध्री धेनुरजायत । वोढाऽनड्वानित्याह
3.8.13.m: "In the brahman may a Brahmin be born endowed with spiritual preeminence!" he says. / He establishes spiritual preeminence in the Brahmin. / Therefore, formerly, a Brahmin endowed with spiritual preeminence was born. / "In this realm may a Rājanya be born, an archer, a hero, a chariot-fighter of great stature!" he says. / He establishes heroism and greatness in the Rājanya. / Therefore, formerly, a Rājanya was born, an archer, a hero, a chariot-fighter of great stature. / "A milk cow!" he says. / He establishes milk in the cow. / Therefore, formerly, a milk cow was born. / "A draft ox!" he says.

3.8.13.s: anaḍuhyeva vīryaṃ dadhāti | tasmātpurā voḍhā'naḍvānajāyata | āśuḥ saptirityāha | aśva eva javaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt purā''śuraśvo'jāyata | puraṃdhiryoṣetyāha | yoṣityeva rūpaṃ dadhāti | tasmāthstrī yuvatiḥ priyā bhāvukā | jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhā ityāha | ā ha vai tatra jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhā jāyate
3.8.13.d: अनडुह्येव वीर्यं दधाति । तस्मात्पुरा वोढाऽनड्वानजायत । आशुः सप्तिरित्याह । अश्व एव जवं दधाति । तस्मात् पुरा'ऽशुरश्वोऽजायत । पुरंधिर्योषेत्याह । योषित्येव रूपं दधाति । तस्माथ्स्त्री युवतिः प्रिया भावुका । जिष्णू रथेष्ठा इत्याह । आ ह वै तत्र जिष्णू रथेष्ठा जायते
3.8.13.m: He establishes heroic power in the ox. / Therefore, formerly, a draft ox was born. / "A swift steed!" he says. / He establishes speed in the horse. / Therefore, formerly, a swift horse was born. / "A fecund young woman!" he says. / He establishes beauty in the woman. / Therefore a young woman becomes beloved. / "A victorious chariot-fighter!" he says. / Truly, a victorious chariot-fighter is born there,

3.8.13.s: yatraitena yajñena yajante | sabheyo yuvetyāha | yo vai pūrvavayasī | sa sabheyo yuvā | tasmādyuvā pumānpriyo bhāvukaḥ | ā'sya yajamānasya vīro jāyatāmityāha | ā ha vai tatra yajamānasya vīro jāyate | yatraitena yajñena yajante | nikāme nikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatvityāha | nikāme nikāme ha vai tatra parjanyo varṣati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | phalinyo na oṣadhayaḥ pacyantāmityāha | phalinyo ha vai tatrauṣadhayaḥ pacyante | yatraitena yajñena yajante | yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatāmityāha | kalpate ha vai tatra prajābhyo yogakṣemaḥ | yatraitena yajñena yajante
3.8.13.d: यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । सभेयो युवेत्याह । यो वै पूर्ववयसी । स सभेयो युवा । तस्माद्युवा पुमान्प्रियो भावुकः । आऽस्य यजमानस्य वीरो जायतामित्याह । आ ह वै तत्र यजमानस्य वीरो जायते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । निकामे निकामे नः पर्जन्यो वर्षत्वित्याह । निकामे निकामे ह वै तत्र पर्जन्यो वर्षति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । फलिन्यो न ओषधयः पच्यन्तामित्याह । फलिन्यो ह वै तत्रौषधयः पच्यन्ते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । योगक्षेमो नः कल्पतामित्याह । कल्पते ह वै तत्र प्रजाभ्यो योगक्षेमः । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते
3.8.13.m: where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / "A youth fit for the assembly!" he says. / He who is in the first stage of life, / he is a youth fit for the assembly. / Therefore a young man becomes beloved. / "May a heroic son be born to this sacrificer!" he says. / Truly, a heroic son is born to the sacrificer there, / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / "Whenever we wish, may Parjanya rain for us!" he says. / Truly, Parjanya rains whenever they wish there, / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / "May the plants ripen bearing fruit for us!" he says. / Truly, the plants ripen bearing fruit there, / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / "May yoga-kṣema be prepared for us!" he says. / Truly, yoga-kṣema is prepared for offspring there, / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice.

3.8.14.s: prajāpatirdevebhyo yajñānvyādiśat | sa ātmannaśvamedhamadhatta | taṃ devā abruvan | eṣa vāva yajñaḥ | yadaśvamedhaḥ | apyeva no'trāstviti | tebhya etānannahomān prāyacchat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa devānaprīṇāt | yadannahomāñjuhoti
3.8.14.d: प्रजापतिर्देवेभ्यो यज्ञान्व्यादिशत् । स आत्मन्नश्वमेधमधत्त । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । एष वाव यज्ञः । यदश्वमेधः । अप्येव नोऽत्रास्त्विति । तेभ्य एतानन्नहोमान् प्रायच्छत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स देवानप्रीणात् । यदन्नहोमाञ्जुहोति
3.8.14.m: Prajāpati assigned the sacrifices to the gods. / He kept the horse sacrifice for himself. / The gods said to him: / "This indeed is the sacrifice, / that is, the horse sacrifice. / Let there be [a share] in this for us as well." / He gave them these food oblations. / He offered them. / With them he gratified the gods. / When he offers the food oblations,

3.8.14.s: devāneva tairyajamānaḥ prīṇāti | ājyena juhoti | agnervā etadrūpam | yadājyam | yadājyena juhoti | agnimeva tatprīṇāti | madhunā juhoti | mahatyai vā etaddevatāyai rūpam | yanmadhu | yanmadhunā juhoti
3.8.14.d: देवानेव तैर्यजमानः प्रीणाति । आज्येन जुहोति । अग्नेर्वा एतद्रूपम् । यदाज्यम् । यदाज्येन जुहोति । अग्निमेव तत्प्रीणाति । मधुना जुहोति । महत्यै वा एतद्देवतायै रूपम् । यन्मधु । यन्मधुना जुहोति
3.8.14.m: the sacrificer gratifies the gods with them. / He offers with clarified butter. / This is the form of Agni, / namely, clarified butter. / When he offers with clarified butter, / he gratifies Agni thereby. / He offers with honey. / This is the form of the great deity, / namely, honey. / When he offers with honey,

3.8.14.s: mahatīmeva taddevatāṃ prīṇāti | taṇḍulairjuhoti | vasūnāṃ vā etadrūpam | yattaṇḍulāḥ | yattaṇḍulairjuhoti | vasūneva tatprīṇāti | pṛthukairjuhoti | rudrāṇāṃ vā etadrūpam | yatpṛthukāḥ | yatpṛthukairjuhoti
3.8.14.d: महतीमेव तद्देवतां प्रीणाति । तण्डुलैर्जुहोति । वसूनां वा एतद्रूपम् । यत्तण्डुलाः । यत्तण्डुलैर्जुहोति । वसूनेव तत्प्रीणाति । पृथुकैर्जुहोति । रुद्राणां वा एतद्रूपम् । यत्पृथुकाः । यत्पृथुकैर्जुहोति
3.8.14.m: he gratifies the great deity thereby. / He offers with husked rice grains. / This is the form of the Vasus, / namely, husked rice grains. / When he offers with husked rice grains, / he gratifies the Vasus thereby. / He offers with flattened grain. / This is the form of the Rudras, / namely, flattened grain. / When he offers with flattened grain,

3.8.14.s: rudrāneva tatprīṇāti | lājairjuhoti | ādityānāṃ vā etadrūpam | yallājāḥ | yallājairjuhoti | ādityāneva tatprīṇāti | karambairjuhoti | viśveṣāṃ vā etaddevānāṃ rūpam | yatkarambāḥ | yatkarambairjuhoti
3.8.14.d: रुद्रानेव तत्प्रीणाति । लाजैर्जुहोति । आदित्यानां वा एतद्रूपम् । यल्लाजाः । यल्लाजैर्जुहोति । आदित्यानेव तत्प्रीणाति । करम्बैर्जुहोति । विश्वेषां वा एतद्देवानां रूपम् । यत्करम्बाः । यत्करम्बैर्जुहोति
3.8.14.m: he gratifies the Rudras thereby. / He offers with puffed grain. / This is the form of the Ādityas, / namely, puffed grain. / When he offers with puffed grain, / he gratifies the Ādityas thereby. / He offers with groats porridge. / This is the form of the All-Gods, / namely, groats porridge. / When he offers with groats porridge,

3.8.14.s: viśvāneva taddevānprīṇāti | dhānābhirjuhoti | nakṣatrāṇāṃ vā etadrūpam | yaddhānāḥ | yaddhānābhirjuhoti | nakṣatrāṇyeva tatprīṇāti | saktubhirjuhoti | prajāpatervā etadrūpam | yathsaktavaḥ | yathsaktubhirjuhoti
3.8.14.d: विश्वानेव तद्देवान्प्रीणाति । धानाभिर्जुहोति । नक्षत्राणां वा एतद्रूपम् । यद्धानाः । यद्धानाभिर्जुहोति । नक्षत्राण्येव तत्प्रीणाति । सक्तुभिर्जुहोति । प्रजापतेर्वा एतद्रूपम् । यथ्सक्तवः । यथ्सक्तुभिर्जुहोति
3.8.14.m: he gratifies the All-Gods thereby. / He offers with parched grain. / This is the form of the lunar mansions, / namely, parched grain. / When he offers with parched grain, / he gratifies the lunar mansions thereby. / He offers with roasted barley flour. / This is the form of Prajāpati, / namely, roasted barley flour. / When he offers with roasted barley flour,

3.8.14.s: prajāpatimeva tatprīṇāti | masūsyairjuhoti | sarvāsāṃ vā etaddevatānāṃ rūpam | yanmasūsyāni | yanmasūsyairjuhoti | sarvā eva taddevatāḥ prīṇāti | priyaṅgutaṇḍulairjuhoti | priyāṅgā ha vai nāmaite | etairvai devā aśvasyāṅgāni samadadhuḥ | yatpriyaṅgutaṇḍulairjuhoti | aśvasyaivāṅgāni saṃdadhāti | daśānnāni juhoti | daśākṣarā virāṭ | virāṭkṛthsnasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai
3.8.14.d: प्रजापतिमेव तत्प्रीणाति । मसूस्यैर्जुहोति । सर्वासां वा एतद्देवतानां रूपम् । यन्मसूस्यानि । यन्मसूस्यैर्जुहोति । सर्वा एव तद्देवताः प्रीणाति । प्रियङ्गुतण्डुलैर्जुहोति । प्रियाङ्गा ह वै नामैते । एतैर्वै देवा अश्वस्याङ्गानि समदधुः । यत्प्रियङ्गुतण्डुलैर्जुहोति । अश्वस्यैवाङ्गानि संदधाति । दशान्नानि जुहोति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । विराट्कृथ्स्नस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै
3.8.14.m:
Then indeed he pleases Prajāpati.
He offers with lentils.
Lentils are indeed the form of all the deities.
When he offers with lentils,
he pleases all the deities.
He offers with priyaṅgu grains.
These are indeed 'dear limbs' (priyāṅga) by name.
By means of these, the gods pieced together the horse's limbs.
When he offers with priyaṅgu grains,
he pieces together the horse's limbs.
He offers ten food offerings.
The virāj consists of ten syllables.
[This is] to obtain the virāj, [that is,] all food.

3.8.15.s: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | taṃ sṛṣṭaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsan | sa etānprajāpatirnaktaṃ homānapaśyat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa yajñādrakṣāṃsyapāhan | yannaktaṃhomāñjuhoti | yajñādeva tairyajamāno rakṣāṃsyapahanti | ājyena juhoti | vajro vā ājyam | vajreṇaiva yajñādrakṣāṃsyapahanti
3.8.15.d: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । तं सृष्टं रक्षांस्यजिघांसन् । स एतान्प्रजापतिर्नक्तं होमानपश्यत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स यज्ञाद्रक्षांस्यपाहन् । यन्नक्तंहोमाञ्जुहोति । यज्ञादेव तैर्यजमानो रक्षांस्यपहन्ति । आज्येन जुहोति । वज्रो वा आज्यम् । वज्रेणैव यज्ञाद्रक्षांस्यपहन्ति
3.8.15.m:
Prajāpati created the horse sacrifice.
When it was created, the rakṣases sought to destroy it.
Prajāpati saw these night-offerings.
He offered them.
With them he smote away the rakṣases from the sacrifice.
When he offers the night-offerings,
the sacrificer thereby smites away the rakṣases from the sacrifice.
He offers with ghee.
Ghee is a thunderbolt.
With the thunderbolt he smites away the rakṣases from the sacrifice.

3.8.15.s: ājyasya pratipadaṃ karoti | prāṇo vā ājyam | mukhata evāsya prāṇaṃ dadhāti | annahomāñjuhoti | śarīravadevāvarundhe | vyatyāsaṃ juhoti | ubhayasyāvarudhyai | naktaṃ juhoti | rakṣasāmapahatyai | ājyenāntato juhoti
3.8.15.d: आज्यस्य प्रतिपदं करोति । प्राणो वा आज्यम् । मुखत एवास्य प्राणं दधाति । अन्नहोमाञ्जुहोति । शरीरवदेवावरुन्धे । व्यत्यासं जुहोति । उभयस्यावरुध्यै । नक्तं जुहोति । रक्षसामपहत्यै । आज्येनान्ततो जुहोति
3.8.15.m:
He makes an opening with ghee.
Ghee is exhalation.
He places exhalation in its mouth at the very beginning.
He offers the food offerings.
He secures it as having a body.
He offers alternately,
to secure both.
He offers at night,
to slay the rakṣases.
He offers with ghee bordering the food.

3.8.15.s: prāṇo vā ājyam | ubhayata evāsya prāṇaṃ dadhāti | purastāccopariṣṭācca | ekasmai svāhetyāha | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | dvābhyāg svāhetyāha | amuṣminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | ubhayoreva lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati | asmiṃścāmuṣmiṃśca | śatāya svāhetyāha | śatāyurvai puruṣaḥ śatavīryaḥ | āyureva vīryamavarundhe | sahasrāya svāhetyāha | āyurvai sahasram | āyurevāvarundhe | sarvasmai svāhetyāha | aparimitamevāvarundhe
3.8.15.d: प्राणो वा आज्यम् । उभयत एवास्य प्राणं दधाति । पुरस्ताच्चोपरिष्टाच्च । एकस्मै स्वाहेत्याह । अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । द्वाभ्याग् स्वाहेत्याह । अमुष्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । उभयोरेव लोकयोः प्रतितिष्ठति । अस्मिंश्चामुष्मिंश्च । शताय स्वाहेत्याह । शतायुर्वै पुरुषः शतवीर्यः । आयुरेव वीर्यमवरुन्धे । सहस्राय स्वाहेत्याह । आयुर्वै सहस्रम् । आयुरेवावरुन्धे । सर्वस्मै स्वाहेत्याह । अपरिमितमेवावरुन्धे
3.8.15.m:
Ghee is exhalation.
He places exhalation on both sides of it,
both before and after.
He says, 'To one, svāhā.'
He firmly establishes himself in this realm.
He says, 'To two, svāhā.'
He firmly establishes himself in yonder realm.
He firmly establishes himself in both realms,
both in this one and in yonder one.
He says, 'To a hundred, svāhā.'
A man has a hundred-year lifespan, a hundredfold heroic power.
He secures lifespan and heroic power.
He says, 'To a thousand, svāhā.'
A thousand is lifespan.
He secures lifespan.
He says, 'To everything, svāhā.'
He secures what is boundless.

3.8.16.s: prajāpatiṃ vā eṣa īpsatītyāhuḥ | yo'śvamedhena yajata iti | atho āhuḥ | sarvāṇi bhūtānīti | ekasmai svāhetyāha | prajāpatirvā ekaḥ | tamevāpnoti | ekasmai svāhā dvābhyāg svāhetyabhi pūrvamāhutīrjuhoti | abhipūrvameva suvargaṃ lokameti | ekottaraṃ juhoti
3.8.16.d: प्रजापतिं वा एष ईप्सतीत्याहुः । योऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति । अथो आहुः । सर्वाणि भूतानीति । एकस्मै स्वाहेत्याह । प्रजापतिर्वा एकः । तमेवाप्नोति । एकस्मै स्वाहा द्वाभ्याग् स्वाहेत्यभि पूर्वमाहुतीर्जुहोति । अभिपूर्वमेव सुवर्गं लोकमेति । एकोत्तरं जुहोति
3.8.16.m:
They say, 'He who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice seeks to obtain Prajāpati.'
Moreover, they say,
'[He seeks to obtain] all beings.'
He says, 'To one, svāhā.'
Prajāpati is one.
He obtains him.
He offers the oblations consecutively, saying, 'To one, svāhā; to two, svāhā.'
Consecutively he goes to the heavenly realm.
He offers increasing by one;

3.8.16.s: ekavadeva suvargaṃ lokameti | santataṃ juhoti | suvargasya lokasya saṃtatyai | śatāya svāhetyāha | śatāyurvai puruṣaḥ śatavīryaḥ | āyureva vīryamavarundhe | sahasrāya svāhetyāha | āyurvai sahasram | āyurevāvarundhe | ayutāya svāhā niyutāya svāhā prayutāya svāhetyāha
3.8.16.d: एकवदेव सुवर्गं लोकमेति । सन्ततं जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य संतत्यै । शताय स्वाहेत्याह । शतायुर्वै पुरुषः शतवीर्यः । आयुरेव वीर्यमवरुन्धे । सहस्राय स्वाहेत्याह । आयुर्वै सहस्रम् । आयुरेवावरुन्धे । अयुताय स्वाहा नियुताय स्वाहा प्रयुताय स्वाहेत्याह
3.8.16.m:
as one he goes to the heavenly realm.
He offers continuously,
for the continuity of the heavenly realm.
He says, 'To a hundred, svāhā.'
A man has a hundred-year lifespan, a hundredfold heroic power.
He secures lifespan and heroic power.
He says, 'To a thousand, svāhā.'
A thousand is lifespan.
He secures lifespan.
He says, 'To ten thousand, svāhā; to a hundred thousand, svāhā; to a million, svāhā.'

3.8.16.s: traya ime lokāḥ | imāneva lokānavarundhe | arbudāya svāhetyāha | vāgvā arbudam | vācamevāvarundhe | nyarbudāya svāhetyāha | yo vai vāco bhūmā | tannyarbudam | vāca eva bhūmānamavarundhe | samudrāya svāhetyāha
3.8.16.d: त्रय इमे लोकाः । इमानेव लोकानवरुन्धे । अर्बुदाय स्वाहेत्याह । वाग्वा अर्बुदम् । वाचमेवावरुन्धे । न्यर्बुदाय स्वाहेत्याह । यो वै वाचो भूमा । तन्न्यर्बुदम् । वाच एव भूमानमवरुन्धे । समुद्राय स्वाहेत्याह
3.8.16.m:
These worlds are three.
He secures these worlds.
He says, 'To ten million (arbuda), svāhā.'
Speech is ten million.
He secures speech.
He says, 'To a hundred million (nyarbuda), svāhā.'
Whatever is the fullness of speech,
that is a hundred million.
He secures the fullness of speech.
He says, 'To the ocean, svāhā.'

3.8.16.s: samudramevāpnoti | madhyāya svāhetyāha | madhyamevāpnoti | antāya svāhetyāha | antamevāpnoti | parārdhāya svāhetyāha | parārdhamevāpnoti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhetyāha | rātrirvā uṣāḥ | aharvyuṣṭiḥ | ahorātre evāvarundhe | atho ahorātrayoreva pratitiṣṭhati | tā yadubhayīrdivā vā naktaṃ vā juhuyāt | ahorātre mohayet | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhodeṣyate svāhodyate svāhetyanudite juhoti | uditāya svāhā suvargāya svāhā lokāya svāhetyudite juhoti | ahorātrayoravyatimohāya
3.8.16.d: समुद्रमेवाप्नोति । मध्याय स्वाहेत्याह । मध्यमेवाप्नोति । अन्ताय स्वाहेत्याह । अन्तमेवाप्नोति । परार्धाय स्वाहेत्याह । परार्धमेवाप्नोति । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहेत्याह । रात्रिर्वा उषाः । अहर्व्युष्टिः । अहोरात्रे एवावरुन्धे । अथो अहोरात्रयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति । ता यदुभयीर्दिवा वा नक्तं वा जुहुयात् । अहोरात्रे मोहयेत् । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहोदेष्यते स्वाहोद्यते स्वाहेत्यनुदिते जुहोति । उदिताय स्वाहा सुवर्गाय स्वाहा लोकाय स्वाहेत्युदिते जुहोति । अहोरात्रयोरव्यतिमोहाय
3.8.16.m:
He reaches the ocean.
He says, 'To the middle, svāhā.'
He reaches the middle.
He says, 'To the end, svāhā.'
He reaches the end.
He says, 'To the highest number, svāhā.'
He reaches the highest number.
He says, 'To dawn, svāhā; to daybreak, svāhā.'
Night is dawn;
day is daybreak.
He secures day and night.
Furthermore, he firmly establishes himself in day and night.
If he were to offer both by day or by night,
he would confuse day and night.
He offers before sunrise, saying, 'To dawn, svāhā; to daybreak, svāhā; to him about to rise, svāhā; to him rising, svāhā.'
He offers after sunrise, saying, 'To him who has risen, svāhā; to the heavenly, svāhā; to the realm, svāhā,'
so that day and night are not confused.

3.8.17.s: vibhūrmātrā prabhūḥ pitretyaśvanāmāni juhoti | ubhayorevainaṃ lokayornāmadheyaṃ gamayati | āyanāya svāhā prāyaṇāya svāhetyuddrāvāñjuhoti | sarvamevainamaskannaṃ suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | agnaye svāhā somāya svāheti pūrvahomāñjuhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati | pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | agnaye svāhā somāya svāheti pūrvadīkṣā juhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati
3.8.17.d: विभूर्मात्रा प्रभूः पित्रेत्यश्वनामानि जुहोति । उभयोरेवैनं लोकयोर्नामधेयं गमयति । आयनाय स्वाहा प्रायणाय स्वाहेत्युद्द्रावाञ्जुहोति । सर्वमेवैनमस्कन्नं सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेति पूर्वहोमाञ्जुहोति । पूर्व एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति । पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेति पूर्वदीक्षा जुहोति । पूर्व एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति
3.8.17.m:
He offers the names of the horse, saying, 'Extensive through its mother, mighty through its father.'
He causes its name to go to both realms.
He offers the departures, saying, 'To approach, svāhā; to setting forth, svāhā.'
He causes it to go whole, unspilled, to the heavenly realm.
He offers the preceding offerings, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Soma, svāhā.'
He surpasses the hostile rival from the outset.
He says, 'To the earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā.'
That is in accordance with the formula.
He offers the preceding consecration offerings, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Soma, svāhā.'
He surpasses the hostile rival from the outset.

3.8.17.s: pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyekaviṃśinīṃ dīkṣāṃ juhoti | ekaviṃśatirvai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | bhuvo devānāṃ karmaṇetyṛtudīkṣā juhoti | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayati | agnaye svāhā vāyave svāheti juhotyanantarityai
3.8.17.d: पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्येकविंशिनीं दीक्षां जुहोति । एकविंशतिर्वै देवलोकाः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एष सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । भुवो देवानां कर्मणेत्यृतुदीक्षा जुहोति । ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयति । अग्नये स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहेति जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै
3.8.17.m:
He offers the twenty-one-fold consecration, saying, 'To the earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā.'
The realms of the gods are twenty-one:
twelve months, five seasons,
these three worlds;
yonder sun is the twenty-first.
This is the heavenly realm;
[this is] for the attainment of the heavenly realm.
He offers the season consecration offerings, saying, 'Become through the rite of the gods.'
He prepares the seasons for him.
He offers, saying, 'To Agni, svāhā; to Vāyu, svāhā,' so as not to omit [any].

3.8.17.s: arvāṅyajñaḥ saṃkrāmatvityāptīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyāptyai | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaditi paryāptīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya paryāptyai | ā me gṛhā bhavantvityābhūrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyābhūtyai | agninā tapo'nvabhavadityanubhūrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasyānubhūtyai | svāhā''dhimādhītāya svāheti samastāni vaiśvadevāni juhoti | samastameva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamatikrāmati
3.8.17.d: अर्वाङ्यज्ञः संक्रामत्वित्याप्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याप्त्यै । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यदिति पर्याप्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य पर्याप्त्यै । आ मे गृहा भवन्त्वित्याभूर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभूत्यै । अग्निना तपोऽन्वभवदित्यनुभूर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्यानुभूत्यै । स्वाहा'ऽधिमाधीताय स्वाहेति समस्तानि वैश्वदेवानि जुहोति । समस्तमेव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमतिक्रामति
3.8.17.m:
He offers the reaching-mantras (āptis), saying, 'May the sacrifice proceed hither,'
for the reaching of the heavenly realm.
He offers the pervasive-mantras (paryāptis), saying, 'What was, what is, what will be,'
for the pervasion of the heavenly realm.
He offers the originating-mantras (ābhūs), saying, 'May houses be mine,'
for the origination of the heavenly realm.
He offers the experiencing-mantras (anubhūs), saying, 'With Agni he experienced heat,'
for the experience of the heavenly realm.
He offers the combined Vaiśvadeva offerings, saying, 'Svāhā to longing, to what is longed for svāhā.'
He completely surpasses the hostile rival.

3.8.17.s: dadbhyaḥ svāhā hanūbhyāg svāhetyaṅgahomāñjuhoti | aṅge aṅge vai puruṣasya pāpmopaśliṣṭaḥ | aṅgādaṅgādevainaṃ pāpmanastena muñcati | añjyetāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā śvetāya svāhetyaśvarūpāṇi juhoti | rūpairevainaṃ samardhayati | oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā mūlebhyaḥ svāhetyoṣadhi homāñjuhoti | dvayyo vā oṣadhayaḥ | puṣpebhyo'nyāḥ phalaṃ gṛhṇanti | mūlebhyo'nyāḥ | tā evobhayīravarundhe
3.8.17.d: दद्भ्यः स्वाहा हनूभ्याग् स्वाहेत्यङ्गहोमाञ्जुहोति । अङ्गे अङ्गे वै पुरुषस्य पाप्मोपश्लिष्टः । अङ्गादङ्गादेवैनं पाप्मनस्तेन मुञ्चति । अञ्ज्येताय स्वाहा कृष्णाय स्वाहा श्वेताय स्वाहेत्यश्वरूपाणि जुहोति । रूपैरेवैनं समर्धयति । ओषधीभ्यः स्वाहा मूलेभ्यः स्वाहेत्योषधि होमाञ्जुहोति । द्वय्यो वा ओषधयः । पुष्पेभ्योऽन्याः फलं गृह्णन्ति । मूलेभ्योऽन्याः । ता एवोभयीरवरुन्धे
3.8.17.m:
He offers the limb offerings, saying, 'To the teeth, svāhā; to the jaws, svāhā.'
Evil adheres to limb after limb of a man.
From limb after limb he frees him from evil thereby.
He offers the horse's colors, saying, 'To the spotted, svāhā; to the black, svāhā; to the white, svāhā.'
He endows him with forms.
He offers the plant offerings, saying, 'To the plants, svāhā; to the roots, svāhā.'
Plants are of two kinds:
some bear fruit from blossoms,
others from roots.
He secures both of them.

3.8.17.s: vanaspatibhyaḥ svāheti vanaspatihomāñjuhoti | āraṇyasyānnādyasyāvarudhyai | meṣastvā pacatairavatvityapāvyāni juhoti | prāṇā vai devā apāvyāḥ | prāṇānevāvarundhe | kūpyābhyaḥ svāhā'dbhyaḥ svāhetyapāṃ homāñjuhoti | apsu vā āpaḥ | annaṃ vā āpaḥ | adbhyo vā annaṃ jāyate | yadevādbhyo'nnaṃ jāyate | tadavarundhe
3.8.17.d: वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहेति वनस्पतिहोमाञ्जुहोति । आरण्यस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । मेषस्त्वा पचतैरवत्वित्यपाव्यानि जुहोति । प्राणा वै देवा अपाव्याः । प्राणानेवावरुन्धे । कूप्याभ्यः स्वाहाऽद्भ्यः स्वाहेत्यपां होमाञ्जुहोति । अप्सु वा आपः । अन्नं वा आपः । अद्भ्यो वा अन्नं जायते । यदेवाद्भ्योऽन्नं जायते । तदवरुन्धे
3.8.17.m: With "Svāhā to the lords of the forest!" he offers the forest-lord offerings, / to secure forest food. / With "May the ram assist thee with cooked meats!" he offers the apāvya offerings. / The gods who are the apāvyas are indeed the breaths; / he secures the breaths. / With "Svāhā to the waters from the well! Svāhā to the waters!" he offers the water offerings. / Water is indeed in waters; / food is indeed water; / food is indeed born from water. / What food is born from water, / that he secures.

3.8.18.s: ambhāṃsi juhoti | ayaṃ vai loko'mbhāṃsi | tasya vasavo'dhipatayaḥ | agnirjyotiḥ | yadambhāṃsi juhoti | imameva lokamavarundhe | vasūnāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | agniṃ jyotiravarundhe | nabhāṃsi juhoti | antarikṣaṃ vai nabhāṃsi
3.8.18.d: अम्भांसि जुहोति । अयं वै लोकोऽम्भांसि । तस्य वसवोऽधिपतयः । अग्निर्ज्योतिः । यदम्भांसि जुहोति । इममेव लोकमवरुन्धे । वसूनां सायुज्यं गच्छति । अग्निं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । नभांसि जुहोति । अन्तरिक्षं वै नभांसि
3.8.18.m: He offers the ambhas offerings. / This world indeed is the waters (ambhas). / Its overlords are the Vasus. / Agni is its light. / When he offers the ambhas offerings, / he wins this very world; / he attains unison with the Vasus; / he wins Agni as light. / He offers the nabhas offerings. / The intermediate space indeed is the mists (nabhas).

3.8.18.s: tasya rudrā adhipatayaḥ | vāyurjyotiḥ | yannabhāṃsi juhoti | antarikṣamevāvarundhe | rudrāṇāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | vāyuṃ jyotiravarundhe | mahāṃsi juhoti | asau vai loko mahāṃsi | tasyādityā adhipatayaḥ | sūryo jyotiḥ
3.8.18.d: तस्य रुद्रा अधिपतयः । वायुर्ज्योतिः । यन्नभांसि जुहोति । अन्तरिक्षमेवावरुन्धे । रुद्राणां सायुज्यं गच्छति । वायुं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । महांसि जुहोति । असौ वै लोको महांसि । तस्यादित्या अधिपतयः । सूर्यो ज्योतिः
3.8.18.m: Its overlords are the Rudras. / Vāyu is its light. / When he offers the nabhas offerings, / he wins the intermediate space; / he attains unison with the Rudras; / he wins Vāyu as light. / He offers the mahas offerings. / That world indeed is the splendors (mahas). / Its overlords are the Ādityas. / Sūrya is its light.

3.8.18.s: yanmahāṃsi juhoti | amumeva lokamavarundhe | ādityānāṃ sāyujyaṃ gacchati | sūryaṃ jyotiravarundhe | namo rājñe namo varuṇāyeti yavyāni juhoti | annādyasyāvarudhyai | mayobhūrvāto abhi vātūsrā iti gavyāni juhoti | paśūnāmavarudhyai | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāheti saṃtatihomāñjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya saṃtatyai
3.8.18.d: यन्महांसि जुहोति । अमुमेव लोकमवरुन्धे । आदित्यानां सायुज्यं गच्छति । सूर्यं ज्योतिरवरुन्धे । नमो राज्ञे नमो वरुणायेति यव्यानि जुहोति । अन्नाद्यस्यावरुध्यै । मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा इति गव्यानि जुहोति । पशूनामवरुध्यै । प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहेति संततिहोमाञ्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य संतत्यै
3.8.18.m: When he offers the mahas offerings, / he wins that very world; / he attains unison with the Ādityas; / he wins Sūrya as light. / With 'Homage to the king, homage to Varuṇa', he offers the barley-offerings, / to secure edible food. / With 'May the blessing-bringing wind blow toward the cows', he offers the cow-offerings, / to secure domestic animals. / With 'To exhalation, svāhā; to diffused breath, svāhā', he offers the continuity-offerings, / for the continuity of the heavenly realm.

3.8.18.s: itāya svāhā'sitāya svāheti pramuktīrjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya pramuktyai | pṛthivyai svāhā'ntarikṣāya svāhetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | dattvate svāhā'dantakāya svāheti śarīrahomāñjuhoti | pitṛlokameva tairyajamāno'varundhe | kastvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktviti paridhīn yunakti | ime vai lokāḥ paridhayaḥ | imānevāsmai lokān yunakti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
3.8.18.d: इताय स्वाहाऽसिताय स्वाहेति प्रमुक्तीर्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रमुक्त्यै । पृथिव्यै स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । दत्त्वते स्वाहाऽदन्तकाय स्वाहेति शरीरहोमाञ्जुहोति । पितृलोकमेव तैर्यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । कस्त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा युनक्त्विति परिधीन् युनक्ति । इमे वै लोकाः परिधयः । इमानेवास्मै लोकान् युनक्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
3.8.18.m: With 'To the bound, svāhā; to the unbound, svāhā', he offers the release-offerings, / for release unto the heavenly realm. / He says, 'To earth, svāhā; to the intermediate space, svāhā'; / this is just in accordance with the yajus. / With 'To the one with teeth, svāhā; to the toothless, svāhā', he offers the body-offerings; / through them the sacrificer wins the world of the ancestors. / With 'Who yokes thee? Let him yoke thee', he yokes the enclosing-sticks. / These worlds indeed are the enclosing-sticks; / these worlds he yokes for him, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

3.8.18.s: yaḥ prāṇato ya ātmadā iti mahimānau juhoti | suvargo vai loko mahaḥ | suvargameva tābhyāṃ lokaṃ yajamāno'varundhe | ā brahmanbrāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatāmiti samastāni brahmavarcasāni juhoti | brahmavarcasameva tairyajamāno'varundhe | jajñi bījamiti juhotyanantarityai | agnaye samanamatpṛthivyai samanamaditi sannati homāñjuhoti | suvargasya lokasya saṃnatyai | bhūtāya svāhā bhaviṣyate svāheti bhūtābhavyau homau juhoti | ayaṃ vai loko bhūtam
3.8.18.d: यः प्राणतो य आत्मदा इति महिमानौ जुहोति । सुवर्गो वै लोको महः । सुवर्गमेव ताभ्यां लोकं यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । आ ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायतामिति समस्तानि ब्रह्मवर्चसानि जुहोति । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेव तैर्यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । जज्ञि बीजमिति जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै । अग्नये समनमत्पृथिव्यै समनमदिति सन्नति होमाञ्जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य संनत्यै । भूताय स्वाहा भविष्यते स्वाहेति भूताभव्यौ होमौ जुहोति । अयं वै लोको भूतम्
3.8.18.m: With 'He who breathing...' [and] 'He who is giver of self...', he offers the two Mahiman cups; / the heavenly realm is indeed greatness (mahas); / through them the sacrificer wins the heavenly realm. / With 'In the brahman, may a Brahmin endowed with spiritual preeminence be born...', he offers the combined spiritual preeminence offerings; / through them the sacrificer wins spiritual preeminence. / With 'The seed was generated...', he offers for uninterrupted continuity. / With 'It bowed to Agni; it bowed to earth...', he offers the obeisance-offerings, / for yielding to the heavenly realm. / With 'To that which has been, svāhā; to that which shall be, svāhā', he offers the two offerings of past and future. / This world is that which has been;

3.8.18.s: asau bhaviṣyat | anayoreva lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasyāvaruddhyai | yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna ityaśvastomīyaṃ juhoti | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasya jityai | sarvameva tenāpnoti | sarvaṃ jayati | yo'śvamedhena yajate
3.8.18.d: असौ भविष्यत् । अनयोरेव लोकयोः प्रतितिष्ठति । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्यावरुद्ध्यै । यदक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान इत्यश्वस्तोमीयं जुहोति । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्य जित्यै । सर्वमेव तेनाप्नोति । सर्वं जयति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते
3.8.18.m: that [world] is that which shall be. / In these two worlds he firmly establishes himself, / to obtain everything, / to win everything. / With 'When first at birth thou didst neigh...', he offers the horse-praise offering, / to obtain everything, / to conquer everything. / Everything he obtains through it, / everything he conquers, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice,

3.8.18.s: ya u cainamevaṃ veda | yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsyajighāṃsan | sa etānprajāpatirnaktaṃ homānapaśyat | tānajuhot | tairvai sa yajñādrakṣāṃsyapāhan | yannaktaṃhomāñjuhoti | yajñādeva tairyajamāno rakṣāṃsyapahanti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhetyantato juhoti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
3.8.18.d: य उ चैनमेवं वेद । यज्ञं रक्षांस्यजिघांसन् । स एतान्प्रजापतिर्नक्तं होमानपश्यत् । तानजुहोत् । तैर्वै स यज्ञाद्रक्षांस्यपाहन् । यन्नक्तंहोमाञ्जुहोति । यज्ञादेव तैर्यजमानो रक्षांस्यपहन्ति । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहेत्यन्ततो जुहोति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
3.8.18.m: and who knows it thus. / The evil spirits wished to slay the sacrifice. / Prajāpati saw these night-offerings; / he offered them; / through them he smote away the evil spirits from the sacrifice. / When he offers the night-offerings, / through them the sacrificer smites away the evil spirits from the sacrifice. / With 'To dawn, svāhā; to dawn-break, svāhā', he offers at the end, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

3.8.19.s: ekayūpo vaikādaśinī vā | anyeṣāṃ yajñānāṃ yūpā bhavanti | ekaviṃśinyaśvamedhasya | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | bailvo vā khādiro vā pālāśo vā | anyeṣāṃ yajñakratūnāṃ yūpā bhavanti | rājjudāla ekaviṃśatyaratniraśvamedhasya | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | nānyeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tejanyā avadyanti | avadyantyaśvasya
3.8.19.d: एकयूपो वैकादशिनी वा । अन्येषां यज्ञानां यूपा भवन्ति । एकविंशिन्यश्वमेधस्य । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । बैल्वो वा खादिरो वा पालाशो वा । अन्येषां यज्ञक्रतूनां यूपा भवन्ति । राज्जुदाल एकविंशत्यरत्निरश्वमेधस्य । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । नान्येषां पशूनां तेजन्या अवद्यन्ति । अवद्यन्त्यश्वस्य
3.8.19.m: Either of a single post or of eleven posts / are the sacrificial posts of other sacrifices; / of twenty-one posts is that of the horse sacrifice, / for the conquest of the heavenly realm. / Either of bilva, of khadira, or of palāśa / are the sacrificial posts of other sacrificial rites; / of rā́jjudāla wood, twenty-one cubits long, is [the central post] of the horse sacrifice, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / Not on a mat of reeds do they cut off portions for the other domestic animals; / they cut off portions for the horse [on one].

3.8.19.s: pāpmā vai tejanī | pāpmano'pahatyai | plakṣaśākhāyāmanyeṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyanti | vetasaśākhāyāmaśvasya | apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | sva evāsya yonāvavadyati | yūpeṣu grāmyānpaśūnniyuñjanti | ārokeṣvāraṇyāndhārayanti | paśūnāṃ vyāvṛttyai | ā grāmyān paśūnlabhante | prāraṇyānthsṛjanti | pāpmano'pahatyai
3.8.19.d: पाप्मा वै तेजनी । पाप्मनोऽपहत्यै । प्लक्षशाखायामन्येषां पशूनामवद्यन्ति । वेतसशाखायामश्वस्य । अप्सुयोनिर्वा अश्वः । अप्सुजो वेतसः । स्व एवास्य योनाववद्यति । यूपेषु ग्राम्यान्पशून्नियुञ्जन्ति । आरोकेष्वारण्यान्धारयन्ति । पशूनां व्यावृत्त्यै । आ ग्राम्यान् पशून्लभन्ते । प्रारण्यान्थ्सृजन्ति । पाप्मनोऽपहत्यै
3.8.19.m: The reed-mat is evil; / [it is done] for the destruction of evil. / On a plakṣa branch they cut off portions for the other domestic animals; / on a reed branch for the horse; / for the horse has its origin in the waters, / the reed is born in the waters; / in its own origin he cuts off portions for it. / To the posts they tie the domestic animals; / in the gaps between they hold the wild animals, / for the distinction of domestic animals. / They seize the domestic animals; / they release the wild animals, / for the destruction of evil.

3.8.20.s: rājjudālamagniṣṭhaṃ minoti | bhrūṇahatyāyā apahatyai | pautudravāvabhito bhavataḥ | puṇyasya gandhasyāvarudhyai | bhrūṇahatyāmevāsmādapahatya | puṇyena gandhenobhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | ṣaḍbailvā bhavanti | brahmavarcasasyāvaruddhyai | ṣaṭkhādirāḥ | tejaso'varudhyai
3.8.20.d: राज्जुदालमग्निष्ठं मिनोति । भ्रूणहत्याया अपहत्यै । पौतुद्रवावभितो भवतः । पुण्यस्य गन्धस्यावरुध्यै । भ्रूणहत्यामेवास्मादपहत्य । पुण्येन गन्धेनोभयतः परिगृह्णाति । षड्बैल्वा भवन्ति । ब्रह्मवर्चसस्यावरुद्ध्यै । षट्खादिराः । तेजसोऽवरुध्यै
3.8.20.m: He sets up a post of rājjudāla wood facing the fire, / for the destruction of the slaying of an embryo. / There are two [posts] of pūtudru wood on either side, / to secure a sacred fragrance; / having struck away the slaying of an embryo from him, / he encloses him on both sides with a sacred fragrance. / There are six of bilva wood, / to secure spiritual preeminence; / six of khadira wood, / to secure fiery energy;

3.8.20.s: ṣaṭpālāśāḥ | somapīthasyāvarudhyai | ekaviṃśatiḥ saṃpadyante | ekaviṃśatirvai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | śataṃ paśavo bhavanti
3.8.20.d: षट्पालाशाः । सोमपीथस्यावरुध्यै । एकविंशतिः संपद्यन्ते । एकविंशतिर्वै देवलोकाः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एष सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । शतं पशवो भवन्ति
3.8.20.m: six of palāśa wood, / to secure the drinking of soma. / They amount to twenty-one. / Twenty-one indeed are the divine realms: / twelve months, five seasons, / these three worlds; / that sun is the twenty-first; / this is the heavenly realm, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / A hundred are the animals;

3.8.20.s: śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati | sarvaṃ vā aśvamedhyāpnoti | aparimitā bhavanti | aparimitasyāvaruddhyai | brahmavādino vadanti | kasmāthsatyāt | dakṣiṇato'nyeṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyanti | uttarato'śvasyeti | vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ
3.8.20.d: शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति । सर्वं वा अश्वमेध्याप्नोति । अपरिमिता भवन्ति । अपरिमितस्यावरुद्ध्यै । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । कस्माथ्सत्यात् । दक्षिणतोऽन्येषां पशूनामवद्यन्ति । उत्तरतोऽश्वस्येति । वारुणो वा अश्वः
3.8.20.m: a man has a lifespan of a hundred years, a hundred faculties; / he firmly establishes himself in lifespan, in faculties. / The performer of the horse sacrifice obtains everything. / They are unlimited, / to secure the unlimited. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / 'For what true reason / do they cut off portions for other animals on the south, / and on the north for the horse?' / The horse is sacred to Varuṇa;

3.8.20.s: eṣā vai varuṇasya dik | svāyāmevāsya diśyavadyati | yaditareṣāṃ paśūnāmavadyati | śatadevatyaṃ tenāvarundhe | cite'gnāvadhivaitase kaṭe'śvaṃ cinoti | apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati | purastātpratyañcaṃ tūparaṃ cinoti | paścātprācīnaṃ gomṛgam
3.8.20.d: एषा वै वरुणस्य दिक् । स्वायामेवास्य दिश्यवद्यति । यदितरेषां पशूनामवद्यति । शतदेवत्यं तेनावरुन्धे । चितेऽग्नावधिवैतसे कटेऽश्वं चिनोति । अप्सुयोनिर्वा अश्वः । अप्सुजो वेतसः । स्व एवैनं योनौ प्रतिष्ठापयति । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चं तूपरं चिनोति । पश्चात्प्राचीनं गोमृगम्
3.8.20.m: this indeed is Varuṇa's quarter; / in its own quarter he cuts off portions for it. / When he cuts off portions for the other animals, / thereby he secures [the favor of] a hundred deities. / He piles the horse upon the piled fire on a reed mat; / the horse has its origin in the waters, the reed is born in the waters; / in its own origin he establishes it. / In front, facing west, he piles the hornless [goat]; / behind, facing east, the wild ox.

3.8.20.s: prāṇāpānāvevāsminthsamyañcau dadhāti | aśvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgamiti sarvahuta etāñjuhoti | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | ātmanā'bhijuhoti | sātmānamevainaṃ satanuṃ karoti | sātmā'muṣmiṃ lloke bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | atho vasoreva dhārāṃ tenāvarundhe | iluvardāya svāhā balivardāya svāhetyāha | saṃvathsaro vā iluvardaḥ | parivathsaro balivardaḥ | saṃvathsarādeva parivathsarādāyuravarundhe | āyurevāsmindadhāti | tasmādaśvamedhayājī jarasā visrasā'muṃ lokameti
3.8.20.d: प्राणापानावेवास्मिन्थ्सम्यञ्चौ दधाति । अश्वं तूपरं गोमृगमिति सर्वहुत एताञ्जुहोति । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । आत्मनाऽभिजुहोति । सात्मानमेवैनं सतनुं करोति । सात्माऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके भवति । य एवं वेद । अथो वसोरेव धारां तेनावरुन्धे । इलुवर्दाय स्वाहा बलिवर्दाय स्वाहेत्याह । संवथ्सरो वा इलुवर्दः । परिवथ्सरो बलिवर्दः । संवथ्सरादेव परिवथ्सरादायुरवरुन्धे । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । तस्मादश्वमेधयाजी जरसा विस्रसाऽमुं लोकमेति
3.8.20.m:
He thus places exhalation and inhalation together in him.
The horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox: he offers these as completely burnt offerings,
for the conquest of these worlds.
He offers [the horse's body] together with its own self;
he thereby makes him possessed of a self, possessed of a body.
Possessed of a self he becomes in yonder world,
he who knows thus.
Moreover, by this he obtains the stream of wealth.
'To Iluvarda svāhā! To Balivarda svāhā!' he says.
The year is indeed Iluvarda;
the subsequent year is Balivarda.
From the year and from the subsequent year he secures lifespan;
he places lifespan in him.
Therefore the performer of the horse sacrifice goes to yonder world through old age, through decay.

3.8.21.s: ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | yathā vā aśvā varṣabhā vā vṛṣāṇaḥ saṃsphureran | evametathstomāḥ saṃsphurante | yadekaviṃśāḥ | te yathsamṛccheran | hanyetāsya yajñaḥ | dvādaśa evāgniḥ syādityāhuḥ | dvādaśaḥ stomaḥ |
3.8.21.d: एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । यथा वा अश्वा वर्षभा वा वृषाणः संस्फुरेरन् । एवमेतथ्स्तोमाः संस्फुरन्ते । यदेकविंशाः । ते यथ्समृच्छेरन् । हन्येतास्य यज्ञः । द्वादश एवाग्निः स्यादित्याहुः । द्वादशः स्तोमः ।
3.8.21.m:
The fire is twenty-one-fold;
the chant is twenty-one-fold;
there are twenty-one sacrificial posts.
Just as horses or bulls, being virile, might jostle one another,
even so do the chants jostle one another
when they are twenty-one-fold.
If they should collide,
his sacrifice would be destroyed.
They say: 'Let the fire be twelve-fold,
the chant twelve-fold,

3.8.21.s: ekādaśa yūpāḥ | yaddvādaśo'gnirbhavati | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmā annamavarundhe | yaddaśa yūpā bhavanti | daśākṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | ya ekādaśaḥ | stana evāsyai saḥ |
3.8.21.d: एकादश यूपाः । यद्द्वादशोऽग्निर्भवति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मा अन्नमवरुन्धे । यद्दश यूपा भवन्ति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । य एकादशः । स्तन एवास्यै सः ।
3.8.21.m:
and the sacrificial posts eleven.'
Since the fire is twelve-fold—
twelve months are the year—
by means of the year he secures food for him.
Since there are ten sacrificial posts—
the Virāj has ten syllables,
the Virāj is food—
by means of the Virāj he secures food.
The one which is the eleventh,
that is her teat.

3.8.21.s: duha evaināṃ tena | tadāhuḥ | yaddvādaśo'gniḥ syāddvādaśaḥ stoma ekādaśa yūpāḥ | yathā sthūriṇā yāyāt | tādṛktat | ekaviṃśa evāgniḥ syādityāhuḥ | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | yathā praṣṭibhiryāti | tādṛgeva tat
3.8.21.d: दुह एवैनां तेन । तदाहुः । यद्द्वादशोऽग्निः स्याद्द्वादशः स्तोम एकादश यूपाः । यथा स्थूरिणा यायात् । तादृक्तत् । एकविंश एवाग्निः स्यादित्याहुः । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । यथा प्रष्टिभिर्याति । तादृगेव तत्
3.8.21.m:
He milks her by means of it.
Regarding this they say:
'If the fire were twelve-fold, the chant twelve-fold, and the sacrificial posts eleven,
that would be just as if one were to drive with an uneven team.'
They say: 'Let the fire be twenty-one-fold,
the chant twenty-one-fold,
and the sacrificial posts twenty-one.'
Just as one drives with evenly matched side-horses,
such indeed is that.
