3.8.21.s: yo vā aśvamedhe tisraḥ kakubho veda | kakuddha rājñāṃ bhavati | ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | etā vā aśvamedhe tisraḥ kakubhaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | kakuddha rājñāṃ bhavati | yo vā aśvamedhe trīṇi śīrṣāṇi veda | śiro ha rājñāṃ bhavati | ekaviṃśo'gnirbhavati | ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ | ekaviṃśatiryūpāḥ | etāni vā aśvamedhe trīṇi śīrṣāṇi | ya evaṃ veda | śiro ha rājñāṃ bhavati
3.8.21.d: यो वा अश्वमेधे तिस्रः ककुभो वेद । ककुद्ध राज्ञां भवति । एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । एता वा अश्वमेधे तिस्रः ककुभः । य एवं वेद । ककुद्ध राज्ञां भवति । यो वा अश्वमेधे त्रीणि शीर्षाणि वेद । शिरो ह राज्ञां भवति । एकविंशोऽग्निर्भवति । एकविंशः स्तोमः । एकविंशतिर्यूपाः । एतानि वा अश्वमेधे त्रीणि शीर्षाणि । य एवं वेद । शिरो ह राज्ञां भवति
3.8.21.m:
He who knows the three summits in the horse sacrifice
becomes the summit of kings.
The fire is twenty-one-fold,
the chant is twenty-one-fold,
and there are twenty-one sacrificial posts:
these indeed are the three summits in the horse sacrifice.
He who knows thus
becomes the summit of kings.
He who knows the three heads in the horse sacrifice
becomes the head of kings.
The fire is twenty-one-fold,
the chant is twenty-one-fold,
and there are twenty-one sacrificial posts:
these indeed are the three heads in the horse sacrifice.
He who knows thus
becomes the head of kings.

3.8.22.s: devā vā aśvamedhe pavamāne | suvargaṃ lokaṃ na prājānan | tamaśvaḥ prājānāt | yadaśvamedhe'śvena medhyenodañco bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti | suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai | na vai manuṣyaḥ suvargaṃ lokamañjasā veda | aśvo vai suvargaṃ lokamañjasā veda | yadudgātodgāyet | yathā'kṣetrajño'nyena pathā pratipādayet | tādṛktat
3.8.22.d: देवा वा अश्वमेधे पवमाने । सुवर्गं लोकं न प्राजानन् । तमश्वः प्राजानात् । यदश्वमेधेऽश्वेन मेध्येनोदञ्चो बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै । न वै मनुष्यः सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा वेद । अश्वो वै सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा वेद । यदुद्गातोद्गायेत् । यथाऽक्षेत्रज्ञोऽन्येन पथा प्रतिपादयेत् । तादृक्तत्
3.8.22.m:
When the horse sacrifice was being purified,
the gods did not know the way to the heavenly realm;
the horse knew it.
When in the horse sacrifice they creep northward with the sacrificial horse for the outward-purifying chant,
it is for the knowing of the heavenly realm.
A human does not directly know the heavenly realm;
the horse directly knows the heavenly realm.
If the Udgātṛ were to chant,
that would be just as if one ignorant of the terrain were to lead along another path.

3.8.22.s: udgātāramaparuddhya | aśvamudgīthāya vṛṇīte | yathā kṣetrajño'ñjasā nayati | evamevainamaśvaḥ suvargaṃ lokamañjasā nayati | pucchamanvārabhante | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | hiṃ karoti | sāmaivākaḥ | hiṃ karoti | udgītha evāsya saḥ
3.8.22.d: उद्गातारमपरुद्ध्य । अश्वमुद्गीथाय वृणीते । यथा क्षेत्रज्ञोऽञ्जसा नयति । एवमेवैनमश्वः सुवर्गं लोकमञ्जसा नयति । पुच्छमन्वारभन्ते । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । हिं करोति । सामैवाकः । हिं करोति । उद्गीथ एवास्य सः
3.8.22.m:
Setting aside the Udgātṛ,
he chooses the horse for the chanting of the udgītha.
Just as one who knows the terrain leads directly,
even so the horse leads him directly to the heavenly realm.
They hold on to its tail,
for the attainment of the heavenly realm.
It neighs;
it has made the sāman.
It neighs;
that is its udgītha.

3.8.22.s: vaḍabā uparundhanti | mithunatvāya prajātyai | atho yathopagātāra upagāyanti | tādṛgeva tat | udagāsīdaśvo medhya ityāha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpatirudgīthaḥ | udgīthamevāvarundhe | atho ṛkhsāmayoreva pratitiṣṭhati | hiraṇyenopākaroti | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | jyotireva mukhato dadhāti | yajamāne ca prajāsu ca | atho hiraṇyajyotireva yajamānaḥ suvargaṃ lokameti
3.8.22.d: वडबा उपरुन्धन्ति । मिथुनत्वाय प्रजात्यै । अथो यथोपगातार उपगायन्ति । तादृगेव तत् । उदगासीदश्वो मेध्य इत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । प्रजापतिरुद्गीथः । उद्गीथमेवावरुन्धे । अथो ऋख्सामयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति । हिरण्येनोपाकरोति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । ज्योतिरेव मुखतो दधाति । यजमाने च प्रजासु च । अथो हिरण्यज्योतिरेव यजमानः सुवर्गं लोकमेति

3.8.23.s: puruṣo vai yajñaḥ | yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ | yadaśve paśūnniyuñjanti | yajñādeva tadyajñaṃ prayuṅkte | aśvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgam | tānagniṣṭha ālabhate | senāmukhameva tathsaṃśyati | tasmādrājamukhaṃ bhīṣmaṃ bhāvukam | āgneyaṃ kṛṣṇagrīvaṃ purastāllalāṭe | pūrvāgnimeva taṃ kurute
3.8.23.d: पुरुषो वै यज्ञः । यज्ञः प्रजापतिः । यदश्वे पशून्नियुञ्जन्ति । यज्ञादेव तद्यज्ञं प्रयुङ्क्ते । अश्वं तूपरं गोमृगम् । तानग्निष्ठ आलभते । सेनामुखमेव तथ्संश्यति । तस्माद्राजमुखं भीष्मं भावुकम् । आग्नेयं कृष्णग्रीवं पुरस्ताल्ललाटे । पूर्वाग्निमेव तं कुरुते
3.8.23.m:
The sacrifice is the Man;
the sacrifice is Prajāpati.
When they fasten the animals to the horse,
he joins sacrifice to sacrifice.
The horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox:
these he binds to the central post facing the fire.
Thereby he sharpens the front of the army;
therefore the face of a king is terrible to behold.
One dedicated to Agni, black-necked, in front on the forehead:
he makes that the front fire.

3.8.23.s: tasmātpūrvāgniṃ purastāthsthāpayanti | pauṣṇamanvañcam | annaṃ vai pūṣā | tasmātpūrvāgnāvāhāryamāharanti | aindrāpauṣṇamupariṣṭāt | aindro vai rājanyo'nnaṃ pūṣā | annādyenaivainamubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | tasmādrājanyo'nnādo bhāvukaḥ | āgneyau kṛṣṇagrīvau bāhuvoḥ | bāhuvoreva vīryaṃ dhatte
3.8.23.d: तस्मात्पूर्वाग्निं पुरस्ताथ्स्थापयन्ति । पौष्णमन्वञ्चम् । अन्नं वै पूषा । तस्मात्पूर्वाग्नावाहार्यमाहरन्ति । ऐन्द्रापौष्णमुपरिष्टात् । ऐन्द्रो वै राजन्योऽन्नं पूषा । अन्नाद्येनैवैनमुभयतः परिगृह्णाति । तस्माद्राजन्योऽन्नादो भावुकः । आग्नेयौ कृष्णग्रीवौ बाहुवोः । बाहुवोरेव वीर्यं धत्ते

3.8.23.s: tasmādrājanyo bāhubalī bhāvukaḥ | tvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyoḥ | sakthyoreva vīryaṃ dhatte | tasmādrājanya ūrubalī bhāvukaḥ | śitipṛṣṭhau bārhaspatyau pṛṣṭhe | brahmavarcasamevopariṣṭāddhatte | atho kavace evaite abhitaḥ paryūhate | tasmādrājanyaḥ saṃnaddho vīryaṃ karoti | dhātre pṛṣodaramadhastāt | pratiṣṭhāmevaitāṃ kurute | atho iyaṃ vai dhātā | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | sauryaṃ balakṣaṃ pucche | uthsedhameva taṃ kurute | tasmāduthsedhaṃ bhaye prajā abhisaṃśrayanti
3.8.23.d: तस्माद्राजन्यो बाहुबली भावुकः । त्वाष्ट्रौ लोमशसक्थौ सक्थ्योः । सक्थ्योरेव वीर्यं धत्ते । तस्माद्राजन्य ऊरुबली भावुकः । शितिपृष्ठौ बार्हस्पत्यौ पृष्ठे । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवोपरिष्टाद्धत्ते । अथो कवचे एवैते अभितः पर्यूहते । तस्माद्राजन्यः संनद्धो वीर्यं करोति । धात्रे पृषोदरमधस्तात् । प्रतिष्ठामेवैतां कुरुते । अथो इयं वै धाता । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । सौर्यं बलक्षं पुच्छे । उथ्सेधमेव तं कुरुते । तस्मादुथ्सेधं भये प्रजा अभिसंश्रयन्ति

3.9.1.s: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | tamaṣṭādaśibhiranu prāyuṅkta | tamāpnot | tamāptvā'ṣṭādaśibhiravārundha | yadaṣṭādaśina ālabhyante | yajñameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | saṃvathsarasya vā eṣā pratimā | yadaṣṭādaśinaḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ
3.9.1.d: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तमष्टादशिभिरनु प्रायुङ्क्त । तमाप्नोत् । तमाप्त्वाऽष्टादशिभिरवारुन्ध । यदष्टादशिन आलभ्यन्ते । यज्ञमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । संवथ्सरस्य वा एषा प्रतिमा । यदष्टादशिनः । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः
3.9.1.m:
Prajāpati created the horse sacrifice.
Having been created, it went away from him.
He pursued it with sets of eighteen [animals];
he reached it;
having reached it, he secured it with sets of eighteen.
Since animals in sets of eighteen are bound,
the sacrificer, having reached the sacrifice with them, secures it.
That which is the sets of eighteen
is the counterpart of the year:
twelve months, five seasons,

3.9.1.s: saṃvathsaro'ṣṭādaśaḥ | yadaṣṭādaśina ālabhyante | saṃvathsarameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | agniṣṭhe'nyānpaśūnupākaroti | itareṣu yūpeṣvaṣṭādaśino'jāmitvāya | nava navālabhyante savīryatvāya | yadāraṇyaiḥ saṃsthāpayet | vyavasyetāṃ pitāputrau | vyadhvānaḥ krāmeyuḥ | vidūraṃ grāmayorgrāmāntau syātām
3.9.1.d: संवथ्सरोऽष्टादशः । यदष्टादशिन आलभ्यन्ते । संवथ्सरमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । अग्निष्ठेऽन्यान्पशूनुपाकरोति । इतरेषु यूपेष्वष्टादशिनोऽजामित्वाय । नव नवालभ्यन्ते सवीर्यत्वाय । यदारण्यैः संस्थापयेत् । व्यवस्येतां पितापुत्रौ । व्यध्वानः क्रामेयुः । विदूरं ग्रामयोर्ग्रामान्तौ स्याताम्
3.9.1.m:
and the year is the eighteenth.
Since animals in sets of eighteen are bound,
the sacrificer, having reached the year with them, secures it.
At the central post facing the fire he presents the other animals,
and at the remaining posts those in sets of eighteen, for the sake of variety;
nine and nine are bound, for the sake of heroic power.
If he were to conclude [the sacrifice] with wild animals,
father and son would part company,
paths would diverge,
and the borders of two villages would be far apart.

3.9.1.s: ṛkṣīkāḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇa āvyādhinīstaskarā araṇyeṣvājāyeran | tadāhuḥ | apaśavo vā ete | yadāraṇyāḥ | yadāraṇyaiḥ saṃsthāpayet | kṣipre yajamānamaraṇyaṃ mṛtaṃ hareyuḥ | araṇyāyatanā hyāraṇyāḥ paśava iti | yatpaśūnnālabheta | anavaruddhā asya paśavaḥ syuḥ | yatparyagnikṛtānuthsṛjet
3.9.1.d: ऋक्षीकाः पुरुषव्याघ्राः परिमोषिण आव्याधिनीस्तस्करा अरण्येष्वाजायेरन् । तदाहुः । अपशवो वा एते । यदारण्याः । यदारण्यैः संस्थापयेत् । क्षिप्रे यजमानमरण्यं मृतं हरेयुः । अरण्यायतना ह्यारण्याः पशव इति । यत्पशून्नालभेत । अनवरुद्धा अस्य पशवः स्युः । यत्पर्यग्निकृतानुथ्सृजेत्
3.9.1.m:
Noxious insects, man-tigers, robbers, and piercing thieves would be born in the forests.
Therefore they say:
‘These are not domestic animals,
namely the wild ones.
If he were to conclude [the sacrifice] with the wild ones,
they would soon carry the sacrificer dead to the forest,
for the wild animals have the forest as their domain.’
If he were not to seize domestic animals,
his domestic animals would be unobtained.
If he were to release them after carrying fire around them,

3.9.1.s: yajñaveśasaṃ kuryāt | yatpaśūnālabhate | tenaiva paśūnavarundhe | yat paryagni kṛtānuthsṛjatyayajña veśasāya | avaruddhā asya paśavo bhavanti | na yajñaveśasaṃ bhavati | na yajamānamaraṇyaṃ mṛtaṃ haranti | grāmyaiḥ saṃsthāpayati | ete vai paśavaḥ kṣemo nāma | saṃ pitāputrāvavasyataḥ | samadhvānaḥ krāmanti | samantikaṃ grāmayorgrāmāntau bhavataḥ | narkṣīkāḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇa āvyādhinīstaskarā araṇyeṣvājāyante
3.9.1.d: यज्ञवेशसं कुर्यात् । यत्पशूनालभते । तेनैव पशूनवरुन्धे । यत् पर्यग्नि कृतानुथ्सृजत्ययज्ञ वेशसाय । अवरुद्धा अस्य पशवो भवन्ति । न यज्ञवेशसं भवति । न यजमानमरण्यं मृतं हरन्ति । ग्राम्यैः संस्थापयति । एते वै पशवः क्षेमो नाम । सं पितापुत्राववस्यतः । समध्वानः क्रामन्ति । समन्तिकं ग्रामयोर्ग्रामान्तौ भवतः । नर्क्षीकाः पुरुषव्याघ्राः परिमोषिण आव्याधिनीस्तस्करा अरण्येष्वाजायन्ते
3.9.1.m:
he would cause slaughter of the sacrifice.
When he seizes domestic animals,
by that alone he obtains domestic animals.
When he releases them after carrying fire around them to avoid slaughter of the sacrifice,
his domestic animals become obtained,
there is no slaughter of the sacrifice,
and they do not carry the sacrificer dead to the forest.
He concludes [the rite] with domestic animals.
These domestic animals, indeed, are security.
Father and son settle together;
the pathways converge;
the borders of two villages are close together;
and noxious insects, man-tigers, robbers, and piercing thieves are not born in the forests.

3.9.2.s: prajāpatirakāmayatobhau lokāvavarundhīyeti | sa etānubhayānpaśūnapaśyat | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | tānālabhata | tairvai sa ubhau lokāvavārundha | grāmyaireva paśubhirimaṃ lokamavārundha | āraṇyairamum | yadgrāmyānpaśūnālabhate | imameva tairlokamavarundhe | yadāraṇyān
3.9.2.d: प्रजापतिरकामयतोभौ लोकाववरुन्धीयेति । स एतानुभयान्पशूनपश्यत् । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । तानालभत । तैर्वै स उभौ लोकाववारुन्ध । ग्राम्यैरेव पशुभिरिमं लोकमवारुन्ध । आरण्यैरमुम् । यद्ग्राम्यान्पशूनालभते । इममेव तैर्लोकमवरुन्धे । यदारण्यान्
3.9.2.m:
Prajāpati desired: ‘May I obtain both worlds.’
He saw both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild.
He seized them.
With them, indeed, he obtained both worlds.
With the domestic animals he obtained this world,
with the wild ones, yonder world.
When he seizes domestic animals,
with them he obtains this world.
When [he seizes] wild ones,

3.9.2.s: amuṃ taiḥ | anavaruddho vā etasya saṃvathsara ityāhuḥ | ya ita itaścāturmāsyāni saṃvathsaraṃ prayuṅkta iti | etāvān vai saṃvathsaraḥ | yaccāturmāsyāni | yadete cāturmāsyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | pratyakṣameva taiḥ saṃvathsaraṃ yajamāno'varundhe | vi vā eṣa prajayā paśubhirṛddhyate | yaḥ saṃvathsaraṃ prayuṅkte | saṃvathsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ
3.9.2.d: अमुं तैः । अनवरुद्धो वा एतस्य संवथ्सर इत्याहुः । य इत इतश्चातुर्मास्यानि संवथ्सरं प्रयुङ्क्त इति । एतावान् वै संवथ्सरः । यच्चातुर्मास्यानि । यदेते चातुर्मास्याः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । प्रत्यक्षमेव तैः संवथ्सरं यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । वि वा एष प्रजया पशुभिरृद्ध्यते । यः संवथ्सरं प्रयुङ्क्ते । संवथ्सरः सुवर्गो लोकः
3.9.2.m:
with them [he obtains] yonder world.
They say: ‘Unobtained is the year for him
who employs the year here and there through the Cāturmāsyas.’
The year, indeed, is of such extent
as the Cāturmāsyas.
When these Cāturmāsya animals are seized,
by them the sacrificer directly obtains the year.
He is deprived of offspring and domestic animals,
who employs the year.
The year is the heavenly realm;

3.9.2.s: suvargaṃ tu lokaṃ nāparādhnoti | prajā vai paśava ekādaśinī | yadeta aikādaśināḥ paśava ālabhyante | sākṣādeva prajāṃ paśūn yajamāno'varundhe | prajāpatirvirājamasṛjata | sā sṛṣṭā'śvamedhaṃ prāviśat | tāṃ daśibhiranu prāyuṅkta | tāmāpnot | tāmāptvā daśibhiravārundha | yaddaśina ālabhyante
3.9.2.d: सुवर्गं तु लोकं नापराध्नोति । प्रजा वै पशव एकादशिनी । यदेत ऐकादशिनाः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । साक्षादेव प्रजां पशून् यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । प्रजापतिर्विराजमसृजत । सा सृष्टाऽश्वमेधं प्राविशत् । तां दशिभिरनु प्रायुङ्क्त । तामाप्नोत् । तामाप्त्वा दशिभिरवारुन्ध । यद्दशिन आलभ्यन्ते
3.9.2.m:
he does not fail to reach the heavenly realm.
Offspring and domestic animals are the group of eleven.
When these eleven animals are seized,
the sacrificer directly obtains offspring and domestic animals.
Prajāpati created the Virāj.
Having been created, she entered the horse sacrifice.
He pursued her with groups of ten.
He reached her.
Having reached her, he obtained her with the groups of ten.
When groups of ten are seized,

3.9.2.s: virājameva tairāptvā yajamāno'varundhe | ekādaśa daśata ālabhyante | ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup | traiṣṭubhāḥ paśavaḥ | paśūnevāvarundhe | vaiśvadevo vā aśvaḥ | nānādevatyāḥ paśavo bhavanti | aśvasya sarvatvāya | nānārūpā bhavanti | tasmānnānārūpāḥ paśavaḥ | bahurūpā bhavanti | tasmādbahurūpāḥ paśavaḥ samṛddhyai
3.9.2.d: विराजमेव तैराप्त्वा यजमानोऽवरुन्धे । एकादश दशत आलभ्यन्ते । एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुप् । त्रैष्टुभाः पशवः । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । वैश्वदेवो वा अश्वः । नानादेवत्याः पशवो भवन्ति । अश्वस्य सर्वत्वाय । नानारूपा भवन्ति । तस्मान्नानारूपाः पशवः । बहुरूपा भवन्ति । तस्माद्बहुरूपाः पशवः समृद्ध्यै

3.9.3.s: asmai vai lokāya grāmyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | amuṣmā āraṇyāḥ | yadgrāmyānpaśūnālabhate | imameva tairlokamavarundhe | yadāraṇyān | amuṃ taiḥ | ubhayānpaśūnālabhate | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayorlokayoravaruddhyai | ubhayān paśūnālabhate
3.9.3.d: अस्मै वै लोकाय ग्राम्याः पशव आलभ्यन्ते । अमुष्मा आरण्याः । यद्ग्राम्यान्पशूनालभते । इममेव तैर्लोकमवरुन्धे । यदारण्यान् । अमुं तैः । उभयान्पशूनालभते । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयोर्लोकयोरवरुद्ध्यै । उभयान् पशूनालभते
3.9.3.m:
For this world domestic animals are seized,
for yonder world, the wild ones.
When he seizes domestic animals,
he obtains this world with them.
When [he seizes] wild ones,
[he obtains] yonder world with them.
He seizes both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both worlds.
He seizes both kinds of animals,

3.9.3.s: grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | ubhayānpaśūnālabhate | grāmyāṃścāraṇyāṃśca | ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnāmavaruddhyai | trayastrayo bhavanti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | brahmavādino vadanti | kasmāthsatyāt
3.9.3.d: ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयस्यान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै । उभयान्पशूनालभते । ग्राम्यांश्चारण्यांश्च । उभयेषां पशूनामवरुद्ध्यै । त्रयस्त्रयो भवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । कस्माथ्सत्यात्
3.9.3.m:
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both kinds of food.
He seizes both kinds of animals,
both domestic and wild,
for the obtaining of both kinds of animals.
They are in sets of three.
Three are these worlds,
for the attainment of these worlds.
The discussers of sacred lore say:
‘By what truth

3.9.3.s: asmiṃ lloke bahavaḥ kāmā iti | yathsamānībhyo devatābhyo'nye'nye paśava ālabhyante | asminneva taṃ lloke kāmāndadhāti | tasmādasmiṃ lloke bahavaḥ kāmāḥ | trayāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ saha vapā juhoti | tryāvṛto vai devāḥ | tryāvṛta ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ klṛptyai | paryagnikṛtānāraṇyānuthsṛjantyahiṃsāyai
3.9.3.d: अस्मिं ल्लोके बहवः कामा इति । यथ्समानीभ्यो देवताभ्योऽन्येऽन्ये पशव आलभ्यन्ते । अस्मिन्नेव तं ल्लोके कामान्दधाति । तस्मादस्मिं ल्लोके बहवः कामाः । त्रयाणां त्रयाणां सह वपा जुहोति । त्र्यावृतो वै देवाः । त्र्यावृत इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । एषां लोकानां क्लृप्त्यै । पर्यग्निकृतानारण्यानुथ्सृजन्त्यहिंसायै

3.9.4.s: yuñjanti bradhnamityāha | asau vā ādityo bradhnaḥ | ādityamevāsmai yunakti | aruṣamityāha | agnirvā aruṣaḥ | agnimevāsmai yunakti | carantamityāha | vāyurvai caran | vāyumevāsmai yunakti | paritasthuṣa ityāha
3.9.4.d: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमित्याह । असौ वा आदित्यो ब्रध्नः । आदित्यमेवास्मै युनक्ति । अरुषमित्याह । अग्निर्वा अरुषः । अग्निमेवास्मै युनक्ति । चरन्तमित्याह । वायुर्वै चरन् । वायुमेवास्मै युनक्ति । परितस्थुष इत्याह

3.9.4.s: ime vai lokāḥ paritasthuṣaḥ | imānevāsmai lokān yunakti | rocante rocanā divītyāha | nakṣatrāṇi vai rocanā divi | nakṣatrāṇyevāsmai rocayati | yuñjantyasya kāmyetyāha | kāmānevāsmai yunakti | harī vipakṣasetyāha | ime vai harī vipakṣasā | ime evāsmai yunakti
3.9.4.d: इमे वै लोकाः परितस्थुषः । इमानेवास्मै लोकान् युनक्ति । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवीत्याह । नक्षत्राणि वै रोचना दिवि । नक्षत्राण्येवास्मै रोचयति । युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्येत्याह । कामानेवास्मै युनक्ति । हरी विपक्षसेत्याह । इमे वै हरी विपक्षसा । इमे एवास्मै युनक्ति

3.9.4.s: śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasetyāha | ahorātre vai nṛvāhasā | ahorātre evāsmai yunakti | etā evāsmai devatā yunakti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketava iti dhvajaṃ pratimuñcati | yaśa evainaṃ rājñāṃ gamayati | jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkamityāha | yathā yajurevaitat | ye te panthānaḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāsa ityadhvaryuryajamānaṃ vācayatyabhijityai
3.9.4.d: शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसेत्याह । अहोरात्रे वै नृवाहसा । अहोरात्रे एवास्मै युनक्ति । एता एवास्मै देवता युनक्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतव इति ध्वजं प्रतिमुञ्चति । यश एवैनं राज्ञां गमयति । जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकमित्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । ये ते पन्थानः सवितः पूर्व्यास इत्यध्वर्युर्यजमानं वाचयत्यभिजित्यै

3.9.4.s: parā vā etasya yajña eti | yasya paśurupākṛto'nyatra vedyā eti | etaṃ stotaretena pathā punaraśvamāvartayāsi na ityāha | vāyurvai stotā | vāyumevāsya parastāddadhātyāvṛttyai | yathā vai haviṣo gṛhītasya skandati | evaṃ vā etadaśvasya skandati | yadasyopākṛtasya lomāni śīyante | yadvāleṣu kācānāvayanti | lomānyevāsya tathsaṃbharanti
3.9.4.d: परा वा एतस्य यज्ञ एति । यस्य पशुरुपाकृतोऽन्यत्र वेद्या एति । एतं स्तोतरेतेन पथा पुनरश्वमावर्तयासि न इत्याह । वायुर्वै स्तोता । वायुमेवास्य परस्ताद्दधात्यावृत्त्यै । यथा वै हविषो गृहीतस्य स्कन्दति । एवं वा एतदश्वस्य स्कन्दति । यदस्योपाकृतस्य लोमानि शीयन्ते । यद्वालेषु काचानावयन्ति । लोमान्येवास्य तथ्संभरन्ति
3.9.4.m:
The sacrifice of him goes away,
whose animal, once brought up, goes elsewhere than the altar ground.
‘O praiser, turn this horse back to us by this path,’ he says.
Vāyu, indeed, is the praiser;
he places Vāyu beyond it, for turning back.
Just as that which is spilled of the offered oblation [is lost],
so also is that which spills of the horse,
when the hairs of him who has been brought up fall out.
When they weave beads into the tail hairs,
they thereby collect his hairs.

3.9.4.s: bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti prājāpatyābhirāvayanti | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayanti | bhūriti mahiṣī | bhuva iti vāvātā | suvariti parivṛktī | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | hiraṇyayāḥ kācā bhavanti | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ
3.9.4.d: भूर्भुवः सुवरिति प्राजापत्याभिरावयन्ति । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयन्ति । भूरिति महिषी । भुव इति वावाता । सुवरिति परिवृक्ती । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । हिरण्ययाः काचा भवन्ति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः

3.9.4.s: jyotiścaivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | sahasraṃ bhavanti | sahasrasaṃmitaḥ suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | apa vā etasmātteja indriyaṃ paśavaḥ śrīḥ krāmanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | vasavastvā'ñjantu gāyatreṇa chandaseti mahiṣyabhyanakti | tejo vā ājyam | tejo gāyatrī | tejasaivāsmai tejo'varundhe
3.9.4.d: ज्योतिश्चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । सहस्रं भवन्ति । सहस्रसंमितः सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । अप वा एतस्मात्तेज इन्द्रियं पशवः श्रीः क्रामन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । वसवस्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसेति महिष्यभ्यनक्ति । तेजो वा आज्यम् । तेजो गायत्री । तेजसैवास्मै तेजोऽवरुन्धे
3.9.4.m:
Light and realm he thus unites for him.
There are a thousand [beads].
The heavenly realm is measured by a thousand.
[It is] for winning the heavenly realm.
From him who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, fiery energy, power of the senses, domestic animals, and fortune indeed depart.
With "May the Vasus anoint you with the gāyatrī metre," the Chief Queen anoints [him].
Ghee is fiery energy;
the gāyatrī is fiery energy.
By means of fiery energy, she secures fiery energy for him.

3.9.4.s: rudrāstvā'ñjantu traiṣṭubhena chandaseti vāvātā | tejo vā ājyam | indriyaṃ triṣṭup | tejasaivāsmā indriyamavarundhe | ādityāstvā'ñjantu jāgatena chandaseti parivṛktī | tejo vā ājyam | paśavo jagatī | tejasaivāsmai paśūnavarundhe | patnayo'bhyañjanti | śriyā vā etadrūpam
3.9.4.d: रुद्रास्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसेति वावाता । तेजो वा आज्यम् । इन्द्रियं त्रिष्टुप् । तेजसैवास्मा इन्द्रियमवरुन्धे । आदित्यास्त्वाऽञ्जन्तु जागतेन छन्दसेति परिवृक्ती । तेजो वा आज्यम् । पशवो जगती । तेजसैवास्मै पशूनवरुन्धे । पत्नयोऽभ्यञ्जन्ति । श्रिया वा एतद्रूपम्
3.9.4.m:
With "May the Rudras anoint you with the triṣṭubh metre," [anoints] the Favorite Wife.
Ghee is fiery energy;
the triṣṭubh is power of the senses.
By means of fiery energy, she secures power of the senses for him.
With "May the Ādityas anoint you with the jagatī metre," [anoints] the Discarded Wife.
Ghee is fiery energy;
the jagatī is domestic animals.
By means of fiery energy, she secures domestic animals for him.
The wives anoint [him].
For this is the form of fortune:

3.9.4.s: yatpatnayaḥ | śriyamevāsmintaddadhati | nāsmātteja indriyaṃ paśavaḥ śrīrapakrāmanti | lājī ñchācīn yaśomamāṃ ityatiriktamannamaśvāyopāharanti | prajāmevānnādīṃ kurvate | etaddevā annamattaitadannamaddhi prajāpata ityāha | prajāyāmevānnādyaṃ dadhate | yadi nāvajighret | agniḥ paśurāsīdityavaghrāpayet | ava haiva jighrati | ākrān vājī kramairatyakramīdvājī dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamityaśvamanumantrayate | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai | samiddho añjankṛdaraṃ matīnāmityaśvasyāpriyo bhavanti sarūpatvāya
3.9.4.d: यत्पत्नयः । श्रियमेवास्मिन्तद्दधति । नास्मात्तेज इन्द्रियं पशवः श्रीरपक्रामन्ति । लाजी ञ्छाचीन् यशोममां इत्यतिरिक्तमन्नमश्वायोपाहरन्ति । प्रजामेवान्नादीं कुर्वते । एतद्देवा अन्नमत्तैतदन्नमद्धि प्रजापत इत्याह । प्रजायामेवान्नाद्यं दधते । यदि नावजिघ्रेत् । अग्निः पशुरासीदित्यवघ्रापयेत् । अव हैव जिघ्रति । आक्रान् वाजी क्रमैरत्यक्रमीद्वाजी द्यौस्ते पृष्ठं पृथिवी सधस्थमित्यश्वमनुमन्त्रयते । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै । समिद्धो अञ्जन्कृदरं मतीनामित्यश्वस्याप्रियो भवन्ति सरूपत्वाय
3.9.4.m:
that there are wives.
They thus place fortune in him.
Fiery energy, power of the senses, domestic animals, and fortune do not depart from him.
With "Fried grains, barley meal, [bring] honor to me!" they offer the surplus food to the horse.
They make offspring eaters of food.
With "O gods, eat this food; eat this food, O Prajāpati," he says.
They place food and food-eating in offspring.
If he should not smell it,
he should make him smell it with "Agni was the animal."
He indeed smells it.
With "The courser has advanced, the courser has stepped beyond with strides; the sky is your back, the earth your seat," he addresses the horse with the mantra,
for winning these worlds.
With "Kindled, anointing the seat of the prayers..." are the Āprī verses of the horse, for conformity of form.

3.9.5.s: tejasā vā eṣa brahmavarcasena vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | hotā ca brahmā ca brahmodyaṃ vadataḥ | tejasā caivainaṃ brahmavarcasena ca samardhayataḥ | dakṣiṇato brahmā bhavati | dakṣiṇata āyatano vai brahmā | bārhaspatyo vai brahmā | brahmavarcasamevāsya dakṣiṇato dadhāti | tasmāddakṣiṇo'rdho brahmavarcasitaraḥ | uttarato hotā bhavati
3.9.5.d: तेजसा वा एष ब्रह्मवर्चसेन व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । होता च ब्रह्मा च ब्रह्मोद्यं वदतः । तेजसा चैवैनं ब्रह्मवर्चसेन च समर्धयतः । दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा भवति । दक्षिणत आयतनो वै ब्रह्मा । बार्हस्पत्यो वै ब्रह्मा । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवास्य दक्षिणतो दधाति । तस्माद्दक्षिणोऽर्धो ब्रह्मवर्चसितरः । उत्तरतो होता भवति
3.9.5.m:
He who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice is deprived of fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
The Hotṛ and the Brahmā speak the theological dialogue.
They endow him with fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
The Brahmā is on the south.
The Brahmā has his seat on the south;
the Brahmā belongs to Bṛhaspati.
He thus places spiritual preeminence on his south;
therefore the southern half is richer in spiritual preeminence.
The Hotṛ is on the north.

3.9.5.s: uttarata āyatano vai hotā | āgneyo vai hotā | tejo vā agniḥ | teja evāsyottarato dadhāti | tasmāduttaro'rdhastejasvitaraḥ | yūpamabhito vadataḥ | yajamānadevatyo vai yūpaḥ | yajamānameva tejasā ca brahmavarcasena ca samardhayataḥ | kiṃsvidāsītpūrvacittirityāha | dyaurvai vṛṣṭiḥ pūrvacittiḥ
3.9.5.d: उत्तरत आयतनो वै होता । आग्नेयो वै होता । तेजो वा अग्निः । तेज एवास्योत्तरतो दधाति । तस्मादुत्तरोऽर्धस्तेजस्वितरः । यूपमभितो वदतः । यजमानदेवत्यो वै यूपः । यजमानमेव तेजसा च ब्रह्मवर्चसेन च समर्धयतः । किंस्विदासीत्पूर्वचित्तिरित्याह । द्यौर्वै वृष्टिः पूर्वचित्तिः
3.9.5.m:
The Hotṛ has his seat on the north;
the Hotṛ belongs to Agni.
Agni is fiery energy.
He thus places fiery energy on his north;
therefore the northern half is richer in fiery energy.
They speak on either side of the sacrificial post.
The sacrificial post has the sacrificer as its deity.
They endow the sacrificer with fiery energy and spiritual preeminence.
"What was the first thought?" he says.
The sky, rain, was the first thought.

3.9.5.s: divameva vṛṣṭimavarundhe | kiṃ svidāsīdbṛhadvaya ityāha | aśvo vai bṛhadvayaḥ | aśvamevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāsītpiśaṃgiletyāha | rātrirvai piśaṃgilā | rātrimevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāsītpilippiletyāha | śrīrvai pilippilā | annādyamevāvarundhe
3.9.5.d: दिवमेव वृष्टिमवरुन्धे । किं स्विदासीद्बृहद्वय इत्याह । अश्वो वै बृहद्वयः । अश्वमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदासीत्पिशंगिलेत्याह । रात्रिर्वै पिशंगिला । रात्रिमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदासीत्पिलिप्पिलेत्याह । श्रीर्वै पिलिप्पिला । अन्नाद्यमेवावरुन्धे
3.9.5.m:
He secures the sky, rain.
"What was the great bird?" he says.
The horse was the great bird.
He secures the horse.
"What was the reddish-brown one?" he says.
Night was the reddish-brown one.
He secures the night.
"What was the slippery one?" he says.
Fortune was the slippery one.
He secures food and food-eating.

3.9.5.s: kaḥ svidekākī caratītyāha | asau vā āditya ekākī carati | teja evāvarundhe | ka u svijjāyate punarityāha | candramā vai jāyate punaḥ | āyurevāvarundhe | kiṃsviddhimasya bheṣajamityāha | agnirvai himasya bheṣajam | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | kiṃsvidāvapanaṃ mahadityāha
3.9.5.d: कः स्विदेकाकी चरतीत्याह । असौ वा आदित्य एकाकी चरति । तेज एवावरुन्धे । क उ स्विज्जायते पुनरित्याह । चन्द्रमा वै जायते पुनः । आयुरेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विद्धिमस्य भेषजमित्याह । अग्निर्वै हिमस्य भेषजम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । किंस्विदावपनं महदित्याह
3.9.5.m:
"Who wanders alone?" he says.
Yonder sun wanders alone.
He secures fiery energy.
"And who is born again?" he says.
The moon is born again.
He secures lifespan.
"What is the remedy for cold?" he says.
Agni is the remedy for cold.
He secures spiritual preeminence.
"What is the great scattering-ground?" he says.

3.9.5.s: ayaṃ vai loka āvapanaṃ mahat | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | pṛcchāmi tvā paramaṃ taṃ pṛthivyā ityāha | vedirvai paro'ntaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | vedimevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi tvā bhuvanasya nābhimityāha | yajño vai bhuvanasya nābhiḥ | yajñamevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya reta ityāha | somo vai vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ | somapīthamevāvarundhe | pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyometyāha | brahma vai vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe
3.9.5.d: अयं वै लोक आवपनं महत् । अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । पृच्छामि त्वा परमं तं पृथिव्या इत्याह । वेदिर्वै परोऽन्तः पृथिव्याः । वेदिमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि त्वा भुवनस्य नाभिमित्याह । यज्ञो वै भुवनस्य नाभिः । यज्ञमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि त्वा वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेत इत्याह । सोमो वै वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः । सोमपीथमेवावरुन्धे । पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योमेत्याह । ब्रह्म वै वाचः परमं व्योम । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे
3.9.5.m:
"This world is the great scattering-ground."
He establishes himself in this world.
"I ask you about the furthest limit of the earth," he says.
The altar is the furthest limit of the earth.
He secures the altar.
"I ask you about the navel of the world," he says.
The sacrifice is the navel of the world.
He secures the sacrifice.
"I ask you about the seed of the lusty horse," he says.
Soma is the seed of the lusty horse.
He secures the drinking of Soma.
"I ask about the highest heaven of speech," he says.
Brahman is the highest heaven of speech.
He secures spiritual preeminence.

3.9.6.s: apa vā etasmātprāṇāḥ krāmanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāheti saṃjñapyamāna āhutīrjuhoti | prāṇānevāsmindadhāti | nāsmātprāṇā apakrāmanti | avantī sthāvantīstvā'vantu | priyaṃ tvā priyāṇām | varṣiṣṭhamāpyānām | nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mametyāha | apaivāsmai taddhnuvate
3.9.6.d: अप वा एतस्मात्प्राणाः क्रामन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहेति संज्ञप्यमान आहुतीर्जुहोति । प्राणानेवास्मिन्दधाति । नास्मात्प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । अवन्ती स्थावन्तीस्त्वाऽवन्तु । प्रियं त्वा प्रियाणाम् । वर्षिष्ठमाप्यानाम् । निधीनां त्वा निधिपतिं हवामहे वसो ममेत्याह । अपैवास्मै तद्ध्नुवते
3.9.6.m:
The vital breaths depart from him
who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice.
With "To exhalation, svāhā! To diffused breath, svāhā!" he offers oblations while [the horse] is being quieted.
He places the vital breaths in him;
the vital breaths do not depart from him.
With "You are helping ones; may the helping ones help you; / You who are dear among the dear ones, / Highest among friends, / You the lord of treasures among treasures do we invoke, O my treasure," he says.
They appease it for him;

3.9.6.s: atho dhuvantyevainam | atho nyevāsmai hnuvate | triḥ pariyanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyo dhuvate | triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtubhirevainaṃ dhuvate | apa vā etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti
3.9.6.d: अथो धुवन्त्येवैनम् । अथो न्येवास्मै ह्नुवते । त्रिः परियन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभ्य एवैनं लोकेभ्यो धुवते । त्रिः पुनः परियन्ति । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतुभिरेवैनं धुवते । अप वा एतेभ्यः प्राणाः क्रामन्ति

3.9.6.s: ye yajñe dhuvanaṃ tanvate | navakṛtvaḥ pariyanti | nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ | prāṇānevātmandadhate | naibhyaḥ prāṇā apakrāmanti | ambe ambālyambika iti patnīmudānayati | ahvataivainām | subhage kāmpīlavāsinītyāha | tapa evaināmupanayati | suvarge loke saṃprorṇvāthāmityāha
3.9.6.d: ये यज्ञे धुवनं तन्वते । नवकृत्वः परियन्ति । नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः । प्राणानेवात्मन्दधते । नैभ्यः प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । अम्बे अम्बाल्यम्बिक इति पत्नीमुदानयति । अह्वतैवैनाम् । सुभगे काम्पीलवासिनीत्याह । तप एवैनामुपनयति । सुवर्गे लोके संप्रोर्ण्वाथामित्याह

3.9.6.s: suvargamevaināṃ lokaṃ gamayati | ā'hamajāni garbhadhamā tvamajāsi garbhadhamityāha | prajā vai paśavo garbhaḥ | prajāmeva paśūnātmandhatte | devā vā aśvamedhe pavamāne | suvargaṃ lokaṃ na prājānan | tamaśvaḥ prājānāt | yathsūcībhirasi pathānkalpayanti | suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai | gāyatrī triṣṭubjagatītyāha
3.9.6.d: सुवर्गमेवैनां लोकं गमयति । आऽहमजानि गर्भधमा त्वमजासि गर्भधमित्याह । प्रजा वै पशवो गर्भः । प्रजामेव पशूनात्मन्धत्ते । देवा वा अश्वमेधे पवमाने । सुवर्गं लोकं न प्राजानन् । तमश्वः प्राजानात् । यथ्सूचीभिरसि पथान्कल्पयन्ति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै । गायत्री त्रिष्टुब्जगतीत्याह
3.9.6.m:
he makes her go to the heavenly realm.
With "I shall drive in the embryo-layer; drive in the embryo-layer," he says.
Offspring, domestic animals, are the embryo;
he places offspring and domestic animals in himself.
When the horse sacrifice was purifying itself, the gods
did not know the heavenly realm.
The horse knew it.
When they arrange the knife-paths with needles,
[it is] for the knowing of the heavenly realm.
"Gāyatrī, triṣṭubh, jagatī," he says;

3.9.6.s: yathā yajurevaitat | trayyaḥ sūcyo bhavanti | ayasmayyo rajatā hariṇyaḥ | asya vai lokasya rūpamayasmayyaḥ | antarikṣasya rajatāḥ | divo hariṇyaḥ | diśo vā ayasmayyaḥ | avāntaradiśā rajatāḥ | ūrdhvā hariṇyaḥ | diśa evāsmai kalpayati | kastvā chyati kastvā viśāstītyāhāhiṃsāyai
3.9.6.d: यथा यजुरेवैतत् । त्रय्यः सूच्यो भवन्ति । अयस्मय्यो रजता हरिण्यः । अस्य वै लोकस्य रूपमयस्मय्यः । अन्तरिक्षस्य रजताः । दिवो हरिण्यः । दिशो वा अयस्मय्यः । अवान्तरदिशा रजताः । ऊर्ध्वा हरिण्यः । दिश एवास्मै कल्पयति । कस्त्वा छ्यति कस्त्वा विशास्तीत्याहाहिंसायै

3.9.7.s: apa vā etasmācchrī rāṣṭraṃ krāmati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ūrdhvāmenāmucchrayatādityāha | śrīrvai rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ | śriyamevāsmai rāṣṭramūrdhvamucchrayati | veṇubhāraṃ girāvivetyāha | rāṣṭraṃ vai bhāraḥ | rāṣṭramevāsmai paryūhati | athāsyā madhyamedhatāmityāha | śrīrvai rāṣṭrasya madhyam
3.9.7.d: अप वा एतस्माच्छ्री राष्ट्रं क्रामति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । ऊर्ध्वामेनामुच्छ्रयतादित्याह । श्रीर्वै राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः । श्रियमेवास्मै राष्ट्रमूर्ध्वमुच्छ्रयति । वेणुभारं गिराविवेत्याह । राष्ट्रं वै भारः । राष्ट्रमेवास्मै पर्यूहति । अथास्या मध्यमेधतामित्याह । श्रीर्वै राष्ट्रस्य मध्यम्
3.9.7.m: Prosperity and dominion depart from him who performs the horse sacrifice. When he says, 'Raise her upwards,' the horse sacrifice is indeed prosperity and dominion; thus he raises up prosperity and dominion for him. When he says, 'like a burden of reeds upon a mountain,' dominion is indeed a burden; thus he heaps dominion upon him. When he says, 'Then let her middle swell,' the middle of dominion is indeed prosperity;

3.9.7.s: śriyamevāvarundhe | śīte vāte punannivetyāha | kṣemo vai rāṣṭrasya śīto vātaḥ | kṣemamevāvarundhe | yaddhariṇī yavamattītyāha | viḍvai hariṇī | rāṣṭraṃ yavaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | na puṣṭaṃ paśumanyata ityāha | tasmādrājā paśūnna puṣyati
3.9.7.d: श्रियमेवावरुन्धे । शीते वाते पुनन्निवेत्याह । क्षेमो वै राष्ट्रस्य शीतो वातः । क्षेममेवावरुन्धे । यद्धरिणी यवमत्तीत्याह । विड्वै हरिणी । राष्ट्रं यवः । विशं चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । न पुष्टं पशुमन्यत इत्याह । तस्माद्राजा पशून्न पुष्यति
3.9.7.m: thus he secures prosperity. When he says, 'as if winnowing in a cool breeze,' a cool breeze is indeed the security of dominion; thus he secures security. When he says, 'When the doe eats the barley,' the people are the doe and dominion is the barley; thus he aligns the people and dominion with each other. When he says, 'She thinks not of the fattened animal,' therefore the king does not fatten domestic animals.

3.9.7.s: śūdrā yadaryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyatītyāha | tasmādvaiśīputraṃ nābhiṣiñcante | iyaṃ yakā śakuntiketyāha | viḍvai śakuntikā | rāṣṭramaśvamedhaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | āhalamiti sarpatītyāha | tasmādrāṣṭrāya viśaḥ sarpanti | āhataṃ gabhe pasa ityāha | viḍvai gabhaḥ
3.9.7.d: शूद्रा यदर्यजारा न पोषाय धनायतीत्याह । तस्माद्वैशीपुत्रं नाभिषिञ्चन्ते । इयं यका शकुन्तिकेत्याह । विड्वै शकुन्तिका । राष्ट्रमश्वमेधः । विशं चैवास्मै राष्ट्रं च समीची दधाति । आहलमिति सर्पतीत्याह । तस्माद्राष्ट्राय विशः सर्पन्ति । आहतं गभे पस इत्याह । विड्वै गभः
3.9.7.m: When he says, 'When the Śūdra woman has an Ārya paramour, she does not strive for wealth to flourish,' therefore they do not consecrate the son of a Vaiśya woman. When he says, 'This little bird here,' the people are the little bird and the horse sacrifice is dominion; thus he aligns the people and dominion with each other. When he says, 'She creeps, crying āhal,' therefore the people creep towards dominion. When he says, 'The penis is struck into the vulva,' the vulva is the people,

3.9.7.s: rāṣṭraṃ pasaḥ | rāṣṭrameva viśyāhanti | tasmādrāṣṭraṃ viśaṃ ghātukam | mātā ca te pitā ca ta ityāha | iyaṃ vai mātā | asau pitā | ābhyāmevainaṃ paridadāti | agraṃ vṛkṣasya rohata ityāha | śrīrvai vṛkṣasyāgram | śriyamevāvarundhe
3.9.7.d: राष्ट्रं पसः । राष्ट्रमेव विश्याहन्ति । तस्माद्राष्ट्रं विशं घातुकम् । माता च ते पिता च त इत्याह । इयं वै माता । असौ पिता । आभ्यामेवैनं परिददाति । अग्रं वृक्षस्य रोहत इत्याह । श्रीर्वै वृक्षस्याग्रम् । श्रियमेवावरुन्धे
3.9.7.m: and the penis is dominion; thus he drives dominion into the people; therefore dominion is destructive to the people. When he says, 'Both your mother and your father,' this [earth] is the mother and yonder [heaven] is the father; he entrusts him to these two. When he says, 'climb to the top of the tree,' the top of the tree is prosperity; thus he secures prosperity.

3.9.7.s: prasulāmīti te pitā gabhe muṣṭimataṃsayadityāha | viḍvai gabhaḥ | rāṣṭraṃ muṣṭiḥ | rāṣṭrameva viśyāhanti | tasmādrāṣṭraṃ viśaṃ ghātukam | apa vā etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti | ye yajñe'pūtaṃ vadanti | dadhikrāvṇṇo akāriṣamiti surabhimatīmṛcaṃ vadanti | prāṇā vai surabhayaḥ | prāṇānevātmandadhate | naibhyaḥ prāṇā apakrāmanti | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ityadbhirmārjayante | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhirevātmānaṃ pavayante
3.9.7.d: प्रसुलामीति ते पिता गभे मुष्टिमतंसयदित्याह । विड्वै गभः । राष्ट्रं मुष्टिः । राष्ट्रमेव विश्याहन्ति । तस्माद्राष्ट्रं विशं घातुकम् । अप वा एतेभ्यः प्राणाः क्रामन्ति । ये यज्ञेऽपूतं वदन्ति । दधिक्राव्ण्णो अकारिषमिति सुरभिमतीमृचं वदन्ति । प्राणा वै सुरभयः । प्राणानेवात्मन्दधते । नैभ्यः प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति । आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इत्यद्भिर्मार्जयन्ते । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः । देवताभिरेवात्मानं पवयन्ते
3.9.7.m: When he says, 'Saying "I am thrusting," your father moved his fist in the vulva,' the vulva is the people, and the fist is dominion; he drives dominion into the people; therefore dominion is destructive to the people. Breaths depart from those who speak what is unpurified at the sacrifice. They recite the fragrant verse, 'I have celebrated Dadhikrāvan'; the breaths are indeed fragrant; thus they place the breaths in themselves; the breaths do not depart from them. They sprinkle themselves with water, saying, 'Since you waters are beneficent'; the waters are all the deities; thus they purify themselves through the deities.

3.9.8.s: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā preṇā'nu prāviśat | tābhyaḥ punaḥ saṃbhavituṃ nāśaknot | so'bravīt | ṛdhnavadithsaḥ | yo metaḥ punaḥ saṃbharaditi | taṃ devā aśvamedhenaiva samabharan | tato vai ta ārdhnuvan | yo'śvamedhena yajate | prajāpatimeva saṃbharatyṛdhnoti | puruṣamālabhate
3.9.8.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा प्रेणाऽनु प्राविशत् । ताभ्यः पुनः संभवितुं नाशक्नोत् । सोऽब्रवीत् । ऋध्नवदिथ्सः । यो मेतः पुनः संभरदिति । तं देवा अश्वमेधेनैव समभरन् । ततो वै त आर्ध्नुवन् । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । प्रजापतिमेव संभरत्यृध्नोति । पुरुषमालभते
3.9.8.m: Prajāpati, having created offspring, entered into them with his breath. He could not collect himself again from them. He said: 'He shall prosper who shall collect me again from here.' The gods collected him by means of the horse sacrifice; thereupon they prospered. He who performs the horse sacrifice collects Prajāpati and prospers. He offers a human being;

3.9.8.s: vairājo vai puruṣaḥ | virājamevālabhate | atho annaṃ vai virāṭ | annamevāvarundhe | aśvamālabhate | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpatimevālabhate | atho śrīrvā ekaśapham | śriyamevāvarundhe | gāmālabhate
3.9.8.d: वैराजो वै पुरुषः । विराजमेवालभते । अथो अन्नं वै विराट् । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । अश्वमालभते । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । प्रजापतिमेवालभते । अथो श्रीर्वा एकशफम् । श्रियमेवावरुन्धे । गामालभते
3.9.8.m: a human being belongs to the Virāj; he thus offers the Virāj; moreover, the Virāj is food; thus he secures food. He offers a horse; the horse belongs to Prajāpati; he thus offers Prajāpati; moreover, the single-hoofed animal is prosperity; thus he secures prosperity. He offers a cow;

3.9.8.s: yajño vai gauḥ | yajñamevālabhate | atho annaṃ vai gauḥ | annamevāvarundhe | ajāvī ālabhate bhūmne | atho puṣṭirvai bhūmā | puṣṭimevāvarundhe | paryagnikṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ cāraṇyāṃścothsṛjantyahiṃsāyai | ubhau vā etau paśū ālabhyete | yaścāvamo yaśca paramaḥ | te'syobhaye yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ | abhijitā abhihutā bhavanti | nainaṃ daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśavo yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ | abhijitā abhihutā hiṃsanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
3.9.8.d: यज्ञो वै गौः । यज्ञमेवालभते । अथो अन्नं वै गौः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । अजावी आलभते भूम्ने । अथो पुष्टिर्वै भूमा । पुष्टिमेवावरुन्धे । पर्यग्निकृतं पुरुषं चारण्यांश्चोथ्सृजन्त्यहिंसायै । उभौ वा एतौ पशू आलभ्येते । यश्चावमो यश्च परमः । तेऽस्योभये यज्ञे बद्धाः । अभीष्टा अभिप्रीताः । अभिजिता अभिहुता भवन्ति । नैनं दंक्ष्णवः पशवो यज्ञे बद्धाः । अभीष्टा अभिप्रीताः । अभिजिता अभिहुता हिंसन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
3.9.8.m: the cow is the sacrifice; he thus offers the sacrifice; moreover, the cow is food; thus he secures food. He offers a goat and a sheep for abundance; moreover, abundance is nourishment; thus he secures nourishment. They release the human being and the wild animals after fire has been carried around them, for non-injury. Both these kinds of animals are offered: both the lowest and the highest; bound at his sacrifice, sought after, delighted in, conquered, and sacrificed to, they become his. The biting animals, bound at the sacrifice, sought after, delighted in, conquered, and sacrificed to, do not harm him who performs the horse sacrifice and who knows it thus.

3.9.9.s: prathamena vā eṣa stomena rādhvā | catuṣṭomena kṛtenāyānāmuttare'han | ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati | ekaviṃśātpratiṣṭhāyā ṛtūnanvārohati | ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni | ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | ṛtuṣveva saṃvathsare pratiṣṭhāya | devatā abhyārohati | śakvarayaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavantyanyadanyacchandaḥ | anye'nye vā ete paśava ālabhyante
3.9.9.d: प्रथमेन वा एष स्तोमेन राध्वा । चतुष्टोमेन कृतेनायानामुत्तरेऽहन् । एकविंशे प्रतिष्ठायां प्रतितिष्ठति । एकविंशात्प्रतिष्ठाया ऋतूनन्वारोहति । ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि । ऋतवः संवथ्सरः । ऋतुष्वेव संवथ्सरे प्रतिष्ठाय । देवता अभ्यारोहति । शक्वरयः पृष्ठं भवन्त्यन्यदन्यच्छन्दः । अन्येऽन्ये वा एते पशव आलभ्यन्ते
3.9.9.m: Having succeeded with the first chant, having attained the winning throws [of dice] with the fourfold chant on the following day, he is established upon the firm foundation of the twenty-one-fold. From the firm foundation of the twenty-one-fold he mounts upon the seasons. The seasons are the pṛṣṭha stotras; the seasons are the year; having established himself in the seasons, in the year, he mounts up to the deities. The Śakvarī verses become the pṛṣṭha stotra, each verse in a different meter. Various domestic animals are offered;

3.9.9.s: uteva grāmyāḥ | utevāraṇyāḥ | ahareva rūpeṇa samardhayati | atho ahna evaiṣa balirhriyate | tadāhuḥ | apaśavo vā ete | yadajāvayaścāraṇyāśca | ete vai sarve paśavaḥ | yadgavyā iti | gavyānpaśūnuttame'hannālabhate
3.9.9.d: उतेव ग्राम्याः । उतेवारण्याः । अहरेव रूपेण समर्धयति । अथो अह्न एवैष बलिर्ह्रियते । तदाहुः । अपशवो वा एते । यदजावयश्चारण्याश्च । एते वै सर्वे पशवः । यद्गव्या इति । गव्यान्पशूनुत्तमेऽहन्नालभते
3.9.9.m: both those of the village and those of the wild; he enriches the day with its proper form; moreover, this tribute is brought for the day. Concerning this they say: 'These are not domestic animals, namely, the goats, sheep, and the wild beasts; all these are domestic animals, namely, the bovine beasts.' He offers the bovine animals on the final day;

3.9.9.s: tenaivobhayānpaśūnavarundhe | prājāpatyā bhavanti | anabhijitasyābhijityai | saurīrnava śvetā vaśā anūbandhyā bhavanti | antata eva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | somāya svarājñe'novāhāvanaḍvāhāviti dvandvinaḥ paśūnālabhate | ahorātrāṇāmabhijityai | paśubhirvā eṣa vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | chagalaṃ kalmāṣaṃ kikidīviṃ vidīgayamiti tvāṣṭrānpaśūnālabhate | paśubhirevātmānaṃ samardhayati | ṛtubhirvā eṣa vyṛddhyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | piśaṅgāstrayo vāsantā ityṛtupaśūnālabhate | ṛtubhirevātmānaṃ samardhayati | ā vā eṣa paśubhyo vṛścyate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | paryagnikṛtā uthsṛjantyanāvraskāya
3.9.9.d: तेनैवोभयान्पशूनवरुन्धे । प्राजापत्या भवन्ति । अनभिजितस्याभिजित्यै । सौरीर्नव श्वेता वशा अनूबन्ध्या भवन्ति । अन्तत एव ब्रह्मवर्चसमवरुन्धे । सोमाय स्वराज्ञेऽनोवाहावनड्वाहाविति द्वन्द्विनः पशूनालभते । अहोरात्राणामभिजित्यै । पशुभिर्वा एष व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । छगलं कल्माषं किकिदीविं विदीगयमिति त्वाष्ट्रान्पशूनालभते । पशुभिरेवात्मानं समर्धयति । ऋतुभिर्वा एष व्यृद्ध्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । पिशङ्गास्त्रयो वासन्ता इत्यृतुपशूनालभते । ऋतुभिरेवात्मानं समर्धयति । आ वा एष पशुभ्यो वृश्च्यते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । पर्यग्निकृता उथ्सृजन्त्यनाव्रस्काय
3.9.9.m: thereby he secures both kinds of domestic animals. They are dedicated to Prajāpati, for the conquest of what has not been conquered. Nine white barren cows dedicated to Sūrya are the concluding victims; at the end he secures spiritual preeminence. He offers domestic animals in pairs, saying: 'To Soma the self-ruler two cart-drawing oxen,' for the conquest of the days and nights. He who performs the horse sacrifice is deprived of domestic animals; he offers the domestic animals dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ, saying: 'A he-goat, a speckled [beast], a blue jay, a vidīgaya'; thus he enriches himself with domestic animals. He who performs the horse sacrifice is deprived of the seasons; he offers the seasonal victims, saying: 'Three reddish-brown ones belonging to spring'; thus he enriches himself with the seasons. He who performs the horse sacrifice is cut off from domestic animals; they release them after fire has been carried around them, to prevent being cut off.

3.9.10.s: prajāpatirakāmayata mahānannādaḥ syāmiti | sa etāvaśvamedhe mahimānāvapaśyat | tāvagṛhṇīta | tato vai sa mahānannādo'bhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta mahānannādaḥ syāmiti | sa etāvaśvamedhe mahimānau gṛhṇīta | mahānevānnādo bhavati | yajamānadevatyā vai vapā | rājā mahimā | yadvapāṃ mahimnobhayataḥ pariyajati | yajamānameva rājyenobhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | purastāthsvāhākārā vā anye devāḥ | upariṣṭāthsvāhākārā anye | te vā ete'śva eva medhya ubhaye'varudhyante | yadvapāṃ mahimnobhayataḥ pariyajati | tānevobhayānprīṇāti
3.9.10.d: प्रजापतिरकामयत महानन्नादः स्यामिति । स एतावश्वमेधे महिमानावपश्यत् । तावगृह्णीत । ततो वै स महानन्नादोऽभवत् । यः कामयेत महानन्नादः स्यामिति । स एतावश्वमेधे महिमानौ गृह्णीत । महानेवान्नादो भवति । यजमानदेवत्या वै वपा । राजा महिमा । यद्वपां महिम्नोभयतः परियजति । यजमानमेव राज्येनोभयतः परिगृह्णाति । पुरस्ताथ्स्वाहाकारा वा अन्ये देवाः । उपरिष्टाथ्स्वाहाकारा अन्ये । ते वा एतेऽश्व एव मेध्य उभयेऽवरुध्यन्ते । यद्वपां महिम्नोभयतः परियजति । तानेवोभयान्प्रीणाति
3.9.10.m: Prajāpati desired, "May I be a great consumer of food." / He saw these two Mahiman [cups] in the horse sacrifice. / He drew them. / Thereupon, indeed, he became a great consumer of food. / Whoever should desire, "May I be a great consumer of food," / he should draw these two Mahiman [cups] in the horse sacrifice; / he becomes indeed a great consumer of food. / The omentum has the sacrificer as its deity; / the Mahiman cup is a king. / When he offers around the omentum on both sides with the Mahiman cup, / he encompasses the sacrificer on both sides with kingship. / Some gods have the Svāhā-call at the beginning; / others have the Svāhā-call at the end. / Both of them indeed are encompassed in the sacrificial horse itself. / When he offers around the omentum on both sides with the Mahiman cup, / he gratifies both of them.

3.9.11.s: vaiśvadevo vā aśvaḥ | taṃ yatprājāpatyaṃ kuryāt | yā devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena vyardhayet | devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhyāt | stegāndaṃṣṭrābhyāṃ maṇḍūkāñjambhyebhiriti | ājyamavadānaṃ kṛtvā pratisaṃkhyāyamāhutīrjuhoti | yā eva devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena samardhayati | na devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhāti
3.9.11.d: वैश्वदेवो वा अश्वः । तं यत्प्राजापत्यं कुर्यात् । या देवता अपिभागाः । ता भागधेयेन व्यर्धयेत् । देवताभ्यः समदं दध्यात् । स्तेगान्दंष्ट्राभ्यां मण्डूकाञ्जम्भ्येभिरिति । आज्यमवदानं कृत्वा प्रतिसंख्यायमाहुतीर्जुहोति । या एव देवता अपिभागाः । ता भागधेयेन समर्धयति । न देवताभ्यः समदं दधाति
3.9.11.m: The horse belongs to the All-Gods. / If he were to make it belong to Prajāpati, / whichever deities have a share, / he would deprive them of their share; / he would cause discord among the deities. / With: "Fly-specks [I offer] to the fangs, frogs to the grinders," / having made clarified butter the portion, he offers the oblations one by one. / Whichever deities have a share, / he provides them with their share; / he does not cause discord among the deities.

3.9.11.s: caturdaśaitānanuvākāñjuhotyanantarityai | prayāsāya svāheti pañcadaśam | pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayaḥ | ardhamāsaśaḥ saṃvathsara āpyate | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te'bruvannagnayaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ | aśvasya medhyasya vayamuddhāramuddharāmahai | athaitānabhibhavāmeti | te lohitamudaharanta | tato devā abhavan
3.9.11.d: चतुर्दशैताननुवाकाञ्जुहोत्यनन्तरित्यै । प्रयासाय स्वाहेति पञ्चदशम् । पञ्चदश वा अर्धमासस्य रात्रयः । अर्धमासशः संवथ्सर आप्यते । देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन् । तेऽब्रुवन्नग्नयः स्विष्टकृतः । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य वयमुद्धारमुद्धरामहै । अथैतानभिभवामेति । ते लोहितमुदहरन्त । ततो देवा अभवन्
3.9.11.m: He offers these fourteen sections for non-omission. / "To the endeavor, hail!" is the fifteenth. / Fifteen indeed are the nights of the half-month; / by half-months the year is obtained. / The gods and the asuras were in conflict. / The Sviṣṭakṛt Agnis said, / "Let us take up a selected portion of the sacrificial horse, / and then let us overcome them." / They took up the blood. / Thereupon the gods prevailed,

3.9.11.s: parā'surāḥ | yathsviṣṭakṛdbhyo lohitaṃ juhoti bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | gomṛgakaṇṭhena prathamāmāhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vai gomṛgaḥ | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva paśūnantardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutirhūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūnabhimanyate
3.9.11.d: पराऽसुराः । यथ्स्विष्टकृद्भ्यो लोहितं जुहोति भ्रातृव्याभिभूत्यै । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । गोमृगकण्ठेन प्रथमामाहुतिं जुहोति । पशवो वै गोमृगः । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव पशूनन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर्हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः पशूनभिमन्यते
3.9.11.m: the asuras were defeated. / That he offers the blood to the Sviṣṭakṛts is for overcoming the rival. / He himself thrives; / his rival is defeated. / He offers the first oblation with the throat of a nilgai. / Domestic animals indeed are the nilgai; / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. / He screens the domestic animals from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm the domestic animals there.

3.9.11.s: aśvaśaphena dvitīyāmāhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vā ekaśapham | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva paśūnantardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutir hūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūnabhimanyate | ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā tṛtīyām | āhutiṃ juhotyāyāsyo vai prajāḥ | rudro'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrādeva prajā antardadhāti | atho yatraiṣā''hutirhūyate | na tatra rudraḥ prajā abhimanyate
3.9.11.d: अश्वशफेन द्वितीयामाहुतिं जुहोति । पशवो वा एकशफम् । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव पशूनन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर् हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः पशूनभिमन्यते । अयस्मयेन कमण्डलुना तृतीयाम् । आहुतिं जुहोत्यायास्यो वै प्रजाः । रुद्रोऽग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । रुद्रादेव प्रजा अन्तर्दधाति । अथो यत्रैषा'ऽहुतिर्हूयते । न तत्र रुद्रः प्रजा अभिमन्यते
3.9.11.m: He offers the second oblation with a horse's hoof. / Domestic animals indeed are the single-hoofed. / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. / He screens the domestic animals from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm the domestic animals there. / He offers the third oblation with an iron water-pot. Striving indeed are offspring; / Rudra is Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. He screens offspring from Rudra. / And where this oblation is offered, / Rudra does not harm offspring there.

3.9.12.s: aśvasya vā ālabdhasya medha udakrāmat | tadaśvastomīyamabhavat | yadaśvastomīyaṃ juhoti | sa medhamevainamālabhate | ājyena juhoti | medho vā ājyam | medho'śvastomīyam | medhenaivāsminmedhaṃ dadhāti | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī
3.9.12.d: अश्वस्य वा आलब्धस्य मेध उदक्रामत् । तदश्वस्तोमीयमभवत् । यदश्वस्तोमीयं जुहोति । स मेधमेवैनमालभते । आज्येन जुहोति । मेधो वा आज्यम् । मेधोऽश्वस्तोमीयम् । मेधेनैवास्मिन्मेधं दधाति । षट्त्रिंशतं जुहोति । षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा बृहती
3.9.12.m: When the horse was seized, its sacrificial essence went out. / That became the horse-stoma hymn. / When he offers the horse-stoma oblations, / he seizes it endowed with sacrificial essence. / He offers with clarified butter. / Clarified butter is sacrificial essence; / the horse-stoma is sacrificial essence; / with sacrificial essence he places sacrificial essence in it. / He offers thirty-six [oblations]. / The Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables;

3.9.12.s: bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūneva mātrayā samardhayati | tā yadbhūyasīrvā kanīyasīrvā juhuyāt | paśūnmātrayā vyardhayet | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī | bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūneva mātrayā samardhayati
3.9.12.d: बार्हताः पशवः । सा पशूनां मात्रा । पशूनेव मात्रया समर्धयति । ता यद्भूयसीर्वा कनीयसीर्वा जुहुयात् । पशून्मात्रया व्यर्धयेत् । षट्त्रिंशतं जुहोति । षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा बृहती । बार्हताः पशवः । सा पशूनां मात्रा । पशूनेव मात्रया समर्धयति
3.9.12.m: domestic animals belong to the Bṛhatī. / That is the measure of domestic animals; / he provides domestic animals with their measure. / If he were to offer more or fewer of them, / he would deprive the domestic animals of their measure. / He offers thirty-six. / The Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables; / domestic animals belong to the Bṛhatī. / That is the measure of domestic animals; / he provides domestic animals with their measure.

3.9.12.s: aśvastomīyaṃ hutvā dvipadā juhoti | dvipādvai puruṣo dvipratiṣṭhaḥ | tadenaṃ pratiṣṭhayā samardhayati | tadāhuḥ | aśvastomīyaṃ pūrvaṃ hotavyāṃ dvipadāiti | aśvo vā aśvastomīyam | puruṣo dvipadāḥ | aśvastomīyaṃ hutvā dvipadā juhoti | tasmāddvipāccatuṣpādamatti | atho dvipadyeva catuṣpadaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati | dvipadā hutvā | nānyāmuttarāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt | yadanyāmuttarāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt | pra pratiṣṭhāyāścyaveta | dvipadā antato juhoti pratiṣṭhityai
3.9.12.d: अश्वस्तोमीयं हुत्वा द्विपदा जुहोति । द्विपाद्वै पुरुषो द्विप्रतिष्ठः । तदेनं प्रतिष्ठया समर्धयति । तदाहुः । अश्वस्तोमीयं पूर्वं होतव्यां द्विपदाइति । अश्वो वा अश्वस्तोमीयम् । पुरुषो द्विपदाः । अश्वस्तोमीयं हुत्वा द्विपदा जुहोति । तस्माद्द्विपाच्चतुष्पादमत्ति । अथो द्विपद्येव चतुष्पदः प्रतिष्ठापयति । द्विपदा हुत्वा । नान्यामुत्तरामाहुतिं जुहुयात् । यदन्यामुत्तरामाहुतिं जुहुयात् । प्र प्रतिष्ठायाश्च्यवेत । द्विपदा अन्ततो जुहोति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
3.9.12.m: Having offered the horse-stoma [oblations], he offers with the two-footed [verse]. / Two-footed indeed is man, resting on two [feet]; / he provides him with a firm foundation. / On this they say: / "Should the horse-stoma be offered first, or the two-footed [verse]?" / The horse is the horse-stoma; / man is the two-footed. / Having offered the horse-stoma [oblations], he offers with the two-footed [verse]; / therefore the two-footed eats the four-footed. / Moreover, in the two-footed he establishes the four-footed. / Having offered with the two-footed [verse], / he should not offer another subsequent oblation. / If he were to offer another subsequent oblation, / he would fall from his firm foundation. / He offers with the two-footed [verse] at the end, for a firm foundation.

3.9.13.s: prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjata | so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | taṃ yajñakratubhiranvaicchat | taṃ yajñakratubhirnānvavindat | tamiṣṭibhiranvaicchat | tamiṣṭibhiranvavindat | tadiṣṭīnāmiṣṭitvam | yathsaṃvathsaramiṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | sāvitriyo bhavanti
3.9.13.d: प्रजापतिरश्वमेधमसृजत । सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तं यज्ञक्रतुभिरन्वैच्छत् । तं यज्ञक्रतुभिर्नान्वविन्दत् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वैच्छत् । तमिष्टिभिरन्वविन्दत् । तदिष्टीनामिष्टित्वम् । यथ्संवथ्सरमिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । सावित्रियो भवन्ति
3.9.13.m: Prajāpati emitted the horse sacrifice. / Emitted, it departed from him. / He sought it with the sacrificial rites. / He did not find it with the sacrificial rites. / He sought it with the iṣṭis. / He found it with the iṣṭis. / That is the iṣṭi-nature of the iṣṭis. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis for a year, / he thereby seeks the horse. / They are addressed to Savitṛ.

3.9.13.s: iyaṃ vai savitā | yo vā asyāṃ naśyati yo nilayate | asyāṃ vāva taṃ vindanti | na vā imāṃ kaścanetyāhuḥ | tiryaṅnordhvo'tyetumarhatīti | yathsāvitriyo bhavanti | savitṛprasūta evainamicchati | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ | yathsāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | aśvasya yatyai dhṛtyai
3.9.13.d: इयं वै सविता । यो वा अस्यां नश्यति यो निलयते । अस्यां वाव तं विन्दन्ति । न वा इमां कश्चनेत्याहुः । तिर्यङ्नोर्ध्वोऽत्येतुमर्हतीति । यथ्सावित्रियो भवन्ति । सवितृप्रसूत एवैनमिच्छति । ईश्वरो वा अश्वः प्रमुक्तः परां परावतं गन्तोः । यथ्सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अश्वस्य यत्यै धृत्यै
3.9.13.m: This [earth] indeed is Savitṛ. / Whatever is lost on her, whatever hides, / on her indeed they find it. / "For no one at all," they say, / "can cross beyond her, neither sideways nor upwards." / When they are addressed to Savitṛ, / impelled by Savitṛ he seeks it. / The horse, when set free, is liable to go to the farthest distance. / When he offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / it is for the holding of the horse's gait.

3.9.13.s: yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | yathsāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | aśvasyaiva yatyai dhṛtyai | tasmāthsāyaṃ prajāḥ kṣemyā bhavanti | yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate | aśvameva tadanvicchati | tasmāddivā naṣṭaiṣa eti | yatprātariṣṭibhiryajate sāyaṃ dhṛtīrjuhoti | ahorātrābhyāmevainamanvicchati | atho ahorātrābhyāmevāsmai yogakṣemaṃ kalpayati
3.9.13.d: यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । यथ्सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अश्वस्यैव यत्यै धृत्यै । तस्माथ्सायं प्रजाः क्षेम्या भवन्ति । यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते । अश्वमेव तदन्विच्छति । तस्माद्दिवा नष्टैष एति । यत्प्रातरिष्टिभिर्यजते सायं धृतीर्जुहोति । अहोरात्राभ्यामेवैनमन्विच्छति । अथो अहोरात्राभ्यामेवास्मै योगक्षेमं कल्पयति
3.9.13.m: When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning, / he thereby seeks the horse. / When he offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / it is for the holding of the horse's gait. / Therefore in the evening offspring are secure. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning, / he thereby seeks the horse; / therefore one goes seeking what is lost by day. / When he sacrifices with iṣṭis in the morning and offers the holding-oblations in the evening, / by means of day and night he seeks it; / and by means of day and night he secures acquisition and preservation for him.

3.9.14.s: apa vā etasmācchrī rāṣṭraṃ krāmati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | brāhmaṇau vīṇāgāthinau gāyataḥ | śriyā vā etadrūpam | yadvīṇā | śriyamevāsmintaddhattaḥ | yadā khalu vai puruṣaḥ śriyamaśnute | vīṇā'smai vādyate | tadāhuḥ | yadubhau brāhmaṇau gāyetām
3.9.14.d: अप वा एतस्माच्छ्री राष्ट्रं क्रामति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । ब्राह्मणौ वीणागाथिनौ गायतः । श्रिया वा एतद्रूपम् । यद्वीणा । श्रियमेवास्मिन्तद्धत्तः । यदा खलु वै पुरुषः श्रियमश्नुते । वीणाऽस्मै वाद्यते । तदाहुः । यदुभौ ब्राह्मणौ गायेताम्
3.9.14.m: Prestige and dominion depart from him / who performs the horse sacrifice. / Two Brahmin lute-singers sing. / The lute is the form of prestige. / They place prestige in him. / When a man attains prestige, / the lute is played for him. / On this they say: / "If both Brahmins were to sing..."

3.9.14.s: prabhraṃśukā'smācchrīḥ syāt | na vai brāhmaṇe śrī ramata iti | brāhmaṇo'nyo gāyet | rājanyo'nyaḥ | brahma vai brāhmaṇaḥ | kṣattraṃ rājanyaḥ | tathā hāsya brahmaṇā ca kṣattreṇa cobhayataḥ śrīḥ parigṛhītā bhavati | tadāhuḥ | yadubhau divā gāyetām | apāsmādrāṣṭraṃ krāmet
3.9.14.d: प्रभ्रंशुकाऽस्माच्छ्रीः स्यात् । न वै ब्राह्मणे श्री रमत इति । ब्राह्मणोऽन्यो गायेत् । राजन्योऽन्यः । ब्रह्म वै ब्राह्मणः । क्षत्त्रं राजन्यः । तथा हास्य ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्त्रेण चोभयतः श्रीः परिगृहीता भवति । तदाहुः । यदुभौ दिवा गायेताम् । अपास्माद्राष्ट्रं क्रामेत्
3.9.14.m: [they say,] "splendor would fall away from him; / splendor does not dwell with a Brahmin." / One singer should be a Brahmin, / the other a Rājanya. / The Brahmin is brahman; / the Rājanya is regal power. / Thus, through both brahman and regal power, his splendor is enclosed on both sides. / They also say: / "If both were to sing by day, / the realm would depart from him;

3.9.14.s: na vai brāhmaṇe rāṣṭraṃ ramata iti | yadā khalu vai rājā kāmayate | atha brāhmaṇaṃ jināti | divā brāhmaṇo gāyet | naktaṃ rājanyaḥ | brahmaṇo vai rūpamahaḥ | kṣattrasya rātriḥ | tathā hāsya brahmaṇā ca kṣattreṇa cobhayato rāṣṭraṃ parigṛhītaṃ bhavati | ityadadā ityayajathā ityapaca iti brāhmaṇo gāyet | iṣṭāpūrtaṃ vai brāhmaṇasya
3.9.14.d: न वै ब्राह्मणे राष्ट्रं रमत इति । यदा खलु वै राजा कामयते । अथ ब्राह्मणं जिनाति । दिवा ब्राह्मणो गायेत् । नक्तं राजन्यः । ब्रह्मणो वै रूपमहः । क्षत्त्रस्य रात्रिः । तथा हास्य ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्त्रेण चोभयतो राष्ट्रं परिगृहीतं भवति । इत्यददा इत्ययजथा इत्यपच इति ब्राह्मणो गायेत् । इष्टापूर्तं वै ब्राह्मणस्य
3.9.14.m: the realm does not dwell with a Brahmin. / Whenever indeed a king desires, / he oppresses the Brahmin." / The Brahmin should sing by day, / the Rājanya by night. / Day is the form of brahman; / night is the form of regal power. / Thus, through both brahman and regal power, his realm is enclosed on both sides. / "Thus you gave, thus you sacrificed, thus you cooked [the offering]"—so the Brahmin should sing; / sacrificial and charitable work belongs to the Brahmin;

3.9.14.s: iṣṭāpūrtenaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | ityajinā ityayudhyathā ityamuṃ saṃgrāmamahanniti rājanyaḥ | yuddhaṃ vai rājanyasya | yuddhenaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | aklṛptā vā etasyartava ityāhuḥ | yo'śvamedhena yajata iti | tisro'nyo gāyati tisro'nyaḥ | ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūnevāsmai kalpayataḥ | tābhyāṃ saṃsthāyām | anoyukte ca śate ca dadāti | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati
3.9.14.d: इष्टापूर्तेनैवैनं स समर्धयति । इत्यजिना इत्ययुध्यथा इत्यमुं संग्राममहन्निति राजन्यः । युद्धं वै राजन्यस्य । युद्धेनैवैनं स समर्धयति । अक्लृप्ता वा एतस्यर्तव इत्याहुः । योऽश्वमेधेन यजत इति । तिस्रोऽन्यो गायति तिस्रोऽन्यः । षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतूनेवास्मै कल्पयतः । ताभ्यां संस्थायाम् । अनोयुक्ते च शते च ददाति । शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति
3.9.14.m: he enriches him with sacrificial and charitable work. / "Thus you conquered, thus you fought, thus you struck that battle"—so the Rājanya [should sing]; / warfare belongs to the Rājanya; / he enriches him with warfare. / They say: "Unordered are his seasons / who offers the horse sacrifice." / One sings three [verses], the other sings three; / they amount to six; / the seasons are six; / the two order the seasons for him. / At the completion of the rite, / he gives to both of them a yoked cart and a hundred [cows]; / man has a lifespan of a hundred years and a hundred faculties; / he firmly establishes himself in lifespan and faculty.

3.9.15.s: sarveṣu vā eṣu lokeṣu mṛtyavo'nvāyattāḥ | tebhyo yadāhutīrna juhuyāt | loke loka enaṃ mṛtyurvindet | mṛtyave svāhā mṛtyave svāhetyabhi pūrvamāhutīrjuhoti | lokāllokādeva mṛtyumavayajate | nainaṃ loke loke mṛtyurvindati | yadamuṣmai svāhā'muṣmai svāheti juhvathsaṃcakṣīta | bahuṃ mṛtyumamitraṃ kurvīta | mṛtyave svāhetyekasmā evaikāṃ juhuyāt | eko vā amuṣmiṃ lloke mṛtyuḥ
3.9.15.d: सर्वेषु वा एषु लोकेषु मृत्यवोऽन्वायत्ताः । तेभ्यो यदाहुतीर्न जुहुयात् । लोके लोक एनं मृत्युर्विन्देत् । मृत्यवे स्वाहा मृत्यवे स्वाहेत्यभि पूर्वमाहुतीर्जुहोति । लोकाल्लोकादेव मृत्युमवयजते । नैनं लोके लोके मृत्युर्विन्दति । यदमुष्मै स्वाहाऽमुष्मै स्वाहेति जुह्वथ्संचक्षीत । बहुं मृत्युममित्रं कुर्वीत । मृत्यवे स्वाहेत्येकस्मा एवैकां जुहुयात् । एको वा अमुष्मिं ल्लोके मृत्युः
3.9.15.m: Deaths attend upon all these worlds. / If he were not to offer oblations to them, / death would find him in world after world. / "To death, svāhā! To death, svāhā!"—thus he offers oblations in succession; / he wards off death from world after world; / death does not find him in world after world. / If he were to recite, offering: "To such a one svāhā! To such a one svāhā!", / he would create many a death as an enemy. / "To death, svāhā!"—so he should offer just one [oblation] to the one; / for there is only one death in yonder world:

3.9.15.s: aśanayā mṛtyureva | tamevāmuṣmiṃ lloke'vayajate | bhrūṇahatyāyai svāhetyavabhṛtha āhutiṃ juhoti | bhrūṇahatyāmevāvayajate | tadāhuḥ | yadbhrūṇahatyā'pātryā'tha | kasmādyajñe'pi kriyata iti | amṛtyurvā anyo bhrūṇahatyāyā ityāhuḥ | bhrūṇahatyā vāva mṛtyuriti | yadbhrūṇahatyāyai svāhetyavabhṛtha āhutiṃ juhoti
3.9.15.d: अशनया मृत्युरेव । तमेवामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽवयजते । भ्रूणहत्यायै स्वाहेत्यवभृथ आहुतिं जुहोति । भ्रूणहत्यामेवावयजते । तदाहुः । यद्भ्रूणहत्याऽपात्र्याऽथ । कस्माद्यज्ञेऽपि क्रियत इति । अमृत्युर्वा अन्यो भ्रूणहत्याया इत्याहुः । भ्रूणहत्या वाव मृत्युरिति । यद्भ्रूणहत्यायै स्वाहेत्यवभृथ आहुतिं जुहोति
3.9.15.m: death by hunger itself; / that one he wards off in yonder world. / "To the slaying of an embryo, svāhā!"—thus he offers an oblation at the final bath; / he wards off the slaying of an embryo. / As to that, they say: / "Since the slaying of an embryo is unfit for the sacrificial cup, / why then is it performed in the sacrifice?" / "Death is nothing other than the slaying of an embryo," they say; / "the slaying of an embryo is indeed death." / When he offers an oblation at the final bath saying, "To the slaying of an embryo, svāhā!",

3.9.15.s: mṛtyumevāhutyā tarpayitvā paripāṇaṃ kṛtvā | bhrūṇaghne bheṣajaṃ karoti | etāṃ ha vai muṇḍibha audanyavaḥ | bhrūṇahatyāyai prāyaścittiṃ vidāñcakāra | yo hāsyāpi prajāyāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hanti | sarvasmai tasmai bheṣajaṃ karoti | jumbakāya svāhetyavabhṛtha uttamāmāhutiṃ juhoti | varuṇo vai jumbakaḥ | antata eva varuṇamavayajate | khalaterviklidhasya śuklasya piṅgākṣasya mūrdhañjuhoti | etadvai varuṇasya rūpam | rūpeṇaiva varuṇamavayajate
3.9.15.d: मृत्युमेवाहुत्या तर्पयित्वा परिपाणं कृत्वा । भ्रूणघ्ने भेषजं करोति । एतां ह वै मुण्डिभ औदन्यवः । भ्रूणहत्यायै प्रायश्चित्तिं विदाञ्चकार । यो हास्यापि प्रजायां ब्राह्मणं हन्ति । सर्वस्मै तस्मै भेषजं करोति । जुम्बकाय स्वाहेत्यवभृथ उत्तमामाहुतिं जुहोति । वरुणो वै जुम्बकः । अन्तत एव वरुणमवयजते । खलतेर्विक्लिधस्य शुक्लस्य पिङ्गाक्षस्य मूर्धञ्जुहोति । एतद्वै वरुणस्य रूपम् । रूपेणैव वरुणमवयजते
3.9.15.m: having gratified death with the oblation and made a defense, / he makes a cure for the slayer of an embryo. / Muṇḍibha Audanyava indeed / knew this expiation for the slaying of an embryo; / even if someone among his descendants kills a Brahmin, / he effects a remedy for all that. / "To Jumbaka, svāhā!"—thus he offers the final oblation at the final bath; / Jumbaka is Varuṇa; / at the very end he wards off Varuṇa. / He offers it on the head of a bald, mangy, white, yellow-eyed man; / that is the form of Varuṇa; / through his form he wards off Varuṇa.

3.9.16.s: vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ | taṃ devatayā vyardhayati | yatprājāpatyaṃ karoti | namo rājñe namo varuṇāyetyāha | vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayati | namo'śvāya namaḥ prajāpataya ityāha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā samardhayati | namo'dhipataya ityāha
3.9.16.d: वारुणो वा अश्वः । तं देवतया व्यर्धयति । यत्प्राजापत्यं करोति । नमो राज्ञे नमो वरुणायेत्याह । वारुणो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयति । नमोऽश्वाय नमः प्रजापतय इत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया समर्धयति । नमोऽधिपतय इत्याह
3.9.16.m: The horse belongs to Varuṇa; / he deprives it of its deity / when he makes it belong to Prajāpati. / He says: "Homage to the king, homage to Varuṇa!" / The horse belongs to Varuṇa; / he enriches it with its own deity. / He says: "Homage to the horse, homage to Prajāpati!" / The horse belongs to Prajāpati; / he enriches it with its own deity. / He says: "Homage to the sovereign!"

3.9.16.s: dharmo vā adhipatiḥ | dharmamevāvarundhe | adhipatirasyadhipatiṃ mā kurvadhipatirahaṃ prajānāṃ bhūyāsamityāha | adhipatimevainaṃ samānānāṃ karoti | māṃ dhehi mayi dhehītyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | upākṛtāya svāhetyupākṛte juhoti | ālabdhāya svāheti niyukte juhoti | hutāya svāheti hute juhoti | eṣāṃ lokānāmabhijityai
3.9.16.d: धर्मो वा अधिपतिः । धर्ममेवावरुन्धे । अधिपतिरस्यधिपतिं मा कुर्वधिपतिरहं प्रजानां भूयासमित्याह । अधिपतिमेवैनं समानानां करोति । मां धेहि मयि धेहीत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । उपाकृताय स्वाहेत्युपाकृते जुहोति । आलब्धाय स्वाहेति नियुक्ते जुहोति । हुताय स्वाहेति हुते जुहोति । एषां लोकानामभिजित्यै
3.9.16.m: Righteous order is the sovereign; / he wins righteous order. / "You are the sovereign; make me the sovereign; may I become the sovereign of offspring"—he says; / he makes him the sovereign among his peers. / "Establish me, establish within me"—he says; / it is this blessing that he invokes. / "To the brought up, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is brought up; / "To the seized, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is tied up; / "To the offered, svāhā!"—thus he offers when it is sacrificed, / for the conquest of these worlds.

3.9.16.s: pra vā eṣa ebhyo lokebhyaścyavate | yo'śvamedhena yajate | āgneyamaindrāgnamāśvinam | tānpaśūnālabhate pratiṣṭhityai | yadāgneyo bhavati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatā evāvarundhe | brahma vā agniḥ | kṣattramindraḥ | yadaindrāgno bhavati
3.9.16.d: प्र वा एष एभ्यो लोकेभ्यश्च्यवते । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । आग्नेयमैन्द्राग्नमाश्विनम् । तान्पशूनालभते प्रतिष्ठित्यै । यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः । देवता एवावरुन्धे । ब्रह्म वा अग्निः । क्षत्त्रमिन्द्रः । यदैन्द्राग्नो भवति
3.9.16.m: He falls away from these worlds / who offers the horse sacrifice. / [A victim] for Agni, one for Indra-and-Agni, one for the Aśvins— / he seizes these sacrificial animals for firm standing. / Because there is one for Agni, / Agni being all the deities, / he secures the deities. / Agni is brahman; / Indra is regal power; / because there is one for Indra-and-Agni,

3.9.16.s: brahmakṣattre evāvarundhe | yadāśvino bhavati | āśiṣāmavaruddhyai | trayo bhavanti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣveva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati | agnaye'ṃhomuce'ṣṭākapāla iti daśahaviṣamiṣṭiṃ nirvapati | daśākṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājaivānnādyamavarundhe | agnermanve prathamasya pracetasa iti yājyānuvākyā bhavanti sarvatvāya
3.9.16.d: ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रे एवावरुन्धे । यदाश्विनो भवति । आशिषामवरुद्ध्यै । त्रयो भवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एष्वेव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति । अग्नयेऽंहोमुचेऽष्टाकपाल इति दशहविषमिष्टिं निर्वपति । दशाक्षरा विराट् । अन्नं विराट् । विराजैवान्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । अग्नेर्मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतस इति याज्यानुवाक्या भवन्ति सर्वत्वाय
3.9.16.m: he secures both brahman and regal power. / Because there is one for the Aśvins, / [it is] for the securing of blessings. / They are three; / three are these worlds; / he firmly establishes himself in these worlds. / "To Agni, who delivers from distress, [a cake] on eight potsherds"—thus he performs a sacrificial rite of ten oblations. / The virāj has ten syllables; / the virāj is food; / by means of the virāj he secures proper food. / "I consider Agni the first, the wise…"—these are the offering verse and invitatory verse, for completeness.

3.9.17.s: yadyaśvamupatapadvindet | āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | saumyaṃ carum | sāvitramaṣṭākapālam | yadāgneyo bhavati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhirevainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yathsaumyo bhavati | somo vā oṣadhīnāṃ rājā | yābhya evainaṃ vindati
3.9.17.d: यद्यश्वमुपतपद्विन्देत् । आग्नेयमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् । सौम्यं चरुम् । सावित्रमष्टाकपालम् । यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः । देवताभिरेवैनं भिषज्यति । यथ्सौम्यो भवति । सोमो वा ओषधीनां राजा । याभ्य एवैनं विन्दति
3.9.17.m:
If illness should befall the horse, / he should offer [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni, / a mess of boiled grain to Soma, / and [a cake] on eight potsherds to Savitṛ. / Because there is one for Agni, / Agni being all deities, / he heals it through the deities. / Because there is one for Soma, / Soma being the king of plants, / through those very plants from which it suffers,

he heals it with them. / Because there is one for Savitṛ, / impelled by Savitṛ he heals it. / With these deities he heals it; / it becomes free from disease. / He should offer a mess of boiled grain to Pūṣan / if it should be lame; / Pūṣan is the healer of lameness; / he heals it; / it becomes free from lameness.

3.9.17.s: tābhirevainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yathsāvitro bhavati | savitṛprasūta evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | etābhirevainaṃ devatābhirbhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi śloṇaḥ syāt | pūṣā vai ślauṇyasya bhiṣak | sa evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | aśloṇo haiva bhavati
3.9.17.d: ताभिरेवैनं भिषज्यति । यथ्सावित्रो भवति । सवितृप्रसूत एवैनं भिषज्यति । एताभिरेवैनं देवताभिर्भिषज्यति । अगदो हैव भवति । पौष्णं चरुं निर्वपेत् । यदि श्लोणः स्यात् । पूषा वै श्लौण्यस्य भिषक् । स एवैनं भिषज्यति । अश्लोणो हैव भवति

3.9.17.s: raudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi mahatī devatā'bhimanyeta | etaddevatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā bhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapenmṛgākhare yadi nāgacchet | iyaṃ vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | iyamevainamarcibhyāṃ parirodhamānayati | ā haiva sutyamahargacchati | yadyadhīyāt
3.9.17.d: रौद्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् । यदि महती देवताऽभिमन्येत । एतद्देवत्यो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया भिषज्यति । अगदो हैव भवति । वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेन्मृगाखरे यदि नागच्छेत् । इयं वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः । इयमेवैनमर्चिभ्यां परिरोधमानयति । आ हैव सुत्यमहर्गच्छति । यद्यधीयात्
3.9.17.m: He should offer a mess of boiled grain to Rudra / if the great deity should assail it; / the horse belongs to this deity; / he heals it through its own deity; / it becomes free from disease. / He should offer [a cake] on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara at a deer-lair if it should not return; / this [earth] is Agni Vaiśvānara; / she brings it back, confining it with her flames; / it arrives on the very day of soma-pressing. / If it should wander away,

3.9.17.s: agnaye'ṃhomuce'ṣṭākapālaḥ | sauryaṃ payaḥ | vāyavya ājyabhāgaḥ | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | aṃhasā vā eṣa gṛhītaḥ | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | yadaṃhomuce nirvapati | aṃhasa eva tena mucyate | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | retasā vā eṣa vyṛdhyate
3.9.17.d: अग्नयेऽंहोमुचेऽष्टाकपालः । सौर्यं पयः । वायव्य आज्यभागः । यजमानो वा अश्वः । अंहसा वा एष गृहीतः । यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । यदंहोमुचे निर्वपति । अंहस एव तेन मुच्यते । यजमानो वा अश्वः । रेतसा वा एष व्यृध्यते
3.9.17.m: [There is a cake] on eight potsherds for Agni, Deliverer from Distress; / milk for Sūrya; / a portion of clarified butter for Vāyu. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / Seized by distress indeed is he / whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / In that he offers to the Deliverer from Distress, / thereby he is freed from distress. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / From semen indeed is he deprived,

3.9.17.s: yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | sauryaṃ retaḥ | yathsauryaṃ payo bhavati | retasaivainaṃ sa samardhayati | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | garbhairvā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito'dhyeti | vāyavyā garbhāḥ | yadvāyavya ājyabhāgo bhavati | garbhairevainaṃ sa samardhayati | atho yasyaiṣā'śvamedhe prāyaścitiḥ kriyate | iṣṭvā vasīyānbhavati
3.9.17.d: यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । सौर्यं रेतः । यथ्सौर्यं पयो भवति । रेतसैवैनं स समर्धयति । यजमानो वा अश्वः । गर्भैर्वा एष व्यृध्यते । यस्याश्वो मेधाय प्रोक्षितोऽध्येति । वायव्या गर्भाः । यद्वायव्य आज्यभागो भवति । गर्भैरेवैनं स समर्धयति । अथो यस्यैषाऽश्वमेधे प्रायश्चितिः क्रियते । इष्ट्वा वसीयान्भवति
3.9.17.m: whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / Semen belongs to Sūrya. / In that there is milk for Sūrya, / he endows him with semen. / The horse indeed is the sacrificer. / From embryos indeed is he deprived, / whose horse, sprinkled for the sacrifice, mates. / Embryos belong to Vāyu. / In that the portion of clarified butter belongs to Vāyu, / he endows him with embryos. / Moreover, he for whom this expiation is performed at the horse sacrifice, / having sacrificed, becomes more prosperous.

3.9.18.s: tadāhuḥ | dvādaśa brahmaudanānthsaṃsthite nirvapet | dvādaśabhirveṣṭibhiryajeteti | yadiṣṭibhiryajeta | upanāmuka enaṃ yajñaḥ syāt | pāpīyāṃstu syāt | āptāni vā etasya chandāṃsi | ya ījānaḥ | tāni ka etāvadāśu punaḥ prayuṃjīteti | sarvā vai saṃsthite yajñe vāgāpyate
3.9.18.d: तदाहुः । द्वादश ब्रह्मौदनान्थ्संस्थिते निर्वपेत् । द्वादशभिर्वेष्टिभिर्यजेतेति । यदिष्टिभिर्यजेत । उपनामुक एनं यज्ञः स्यात् । पापीयांस्तु स्यात् । आप्तानि वा एतस्य छन्दांसि । य ईजानः । तानि क एतावदाशु पुनः प्रयुंजीतेति । सर्वा वै संस्थिते यज्ञे वागाप्यते
3.9.18.m: Concerning this they say: / 'When [the sacrifice] is completed, he should offer twelve boiled rice messes for Brahmins; / or he should sacrifice with twelve oblations.' / If he should sacrifice with oblations, / the sacrifice would be inclined to yield to him, / but he would become worse off. / Reached indeed are the meters of him / who has sacrificed. / 'Who would employ them again so quickly?' [they ask]. / All speech indeed is reached when the sacrifice is completed.

3.9.18.s: sā''ptā bhavati yātayāmnī | krūrīkṛteva hi bhavatyaruṣkṛtā | sā na punaḥ prayujyetyāhuḥ | dvādaśaiva brahmaudanānthsaṃsthite nirvapet | prajāpatirvā odanaḥ | yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ | upanāmuka enaṃ yajño bhavati | na pāpīyānbhavati | dvādaśa bhavanti | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsara eva pratitiṣṭhati
3.9.18.d: सा'ऽप्ता भवति यातयाम्नी । क्रूरीकृतेव हि भवत्यरुष्कृता । सा न पुनः प्रयुज्येत्याहुः । द्वादशैव ब्रह्मौदनान्थ्संस्थिते निर्वपेत् । प्रजापतिर्वा ओदनः । यज्ञः प्रजापतिः । उपनामुक एनं यज्ञो भवति । न पापीयान्भवति । द्वादश भवन्ति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठति
3.9.18.m: Having been reached, it becomes exhausted; / for it becomes, as it were, wounded, full of sores. / 'It is not to be employed again,' they say. / When [the sacrifice] is completed, he should offer just twelve boiled rice messes for Brahmins. / Boiled rice mess indeed is Prajāpati; / the sacrifice is Prajāpati. / The sacrifice becomes inclined to yield to him; / he does not become worse off. / There are twelve. / Twelve months are the year. / In the year indeed he finds a firm foundation.

3.9.19.s: eṣa vai vibhūrnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vibhu bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai prabhūrnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra prabhu bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vā ūrjasvānnāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatrorjasvadbhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai payasvānnāma yajñaḥ
3.9.19.d: एष वै विभूर्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र विभु भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै प्रभूर्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र प्रभु भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वा ऊर्जस्वान्नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्रोर्जस्वद्भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै पयस्वान्नाम यज्ञः
3.9.19.m: This sacrifice is named Far-reaching; / everything indeed becomes far-reaching there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Abundant; / everything indeed becomes abundant there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Full of Vigor; / everything indeed becomes full of vigor there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Rich in Milk;

3.9.19.s: sarvaṃ ha vai tatra payasvadbhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vidhṛto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vidhṛtaṃ bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vyāvṛtto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vyāvṛttaṃ bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai pratiṣṭhito nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ bhavati
3.9.19.d: सर्वं ह वै तत्र पयस्वद्भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै विधृतो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र विधृतं भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै व्यावृत्तो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र व्यावृत्तं भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै प्रतिष्ठितो नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र प्रतिष्ठितं भवति
3.9.19.m:
