everything indeed becomes rich in milk there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Sustained; / everything indeed becomes sustained there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Distinguished; / everything indeed becomes distinguished there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Established; / everything indeed becomes established there

where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Possessing Fiery Energy; / everything indeed possesses fiery energy there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Endowed with Spiritual Preeminence; / a Brahmin endowed with spiritual preeminence is born there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Piercing Far; / a Rājanya who pierces far is born there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Long; / long-lived indeed are the people there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice. / This sacrifice is named Well-ordered; / acquisition and preservation turn out successfully for the offspring there / where they sacrifice with this sacrifice.

3.9.19.s: yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai tejasvī nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra tejasvi bhavati | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai brahmavarcasī nāma yajñaḥ | ā ha vai tatra brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyate | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vā ativyādhī nāma yajñaḥ | ā ha vai tatra rājanyo'tivyādhī jāyate | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai dīrgho nāma yajñaḥ | dīrghāyuṣo ha vai tatra manuṣyā bhavanti | yatraitena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai klṛpto nāma yajñaḥ | kalpate ha vai tatra prajābhyo yogakṣemaḥ | yatraitena yajñena yajante
3.9.19.d: यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै तेजस्वी नाम यज्ञः । सर्वं ह वै तत्र तेजस्वि भवति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै ब्रह्मवर्चसी नाम यज्ञः । आ ह वै तत्र ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वा अतिव्याधी नाम यज्ञः । आ ह वै तत्र राजन्योऽतिव्याधी जायते । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै दीर्घो नाम यज्ञः । दीर्घायुषो ह वै तत्र मनुष्या भवन्ति । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते । एष वै क्लृप्तो नाम यज्ञः । कल्पते ह वै तत्र प्रजाभ्यो योगक्षेमः । यत्रैतेन यज्ञेन यजन्ते

3.9.20.s: tārpyeṇāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | yajño vai tārpyam | yajñenaivainaṃ samardhayanti | yāmena sāmnā prastotā'nūpatiṣṭhate | yamalokamevainaṃ gamayati | tārpye ca kṛttyadhīvāse cāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | etadvai paśūnāṃ rūpam | rūpeṇaiva paśūnavarundhe | hiraṇyakaśipu bhavati | tejaso'varuddhyai
3.9.20.d: तार्प्येणाश्वं संज्ञपयन्ति । यज्ञो वै तार्प्यम् । यज्ञेनैवैनं समर्धयन्ति । यामेन साम्ना प्रस्तोताऽनूपतिष्ठते । यमलोकमेवैनं गमयति । तार्प्ये च कृत्त्यधीवासे चाश्वं संज्ञपयन्ति । एतद्वै पशूनां रूपम् । रूपेणैव पशूनवरुन्धे । हिरण्यकशिपु भवति । तेजसोऽवरुद्ध्यै
3.9.20.m: With a garment of tārpya cloth they suffocate the horse. / Sacrifice indeed is the tārpya cloth; / with sacrifice indeed they endow it. / With the chant of Yama the Prastotṛ attends [it]; / to the world of Yama indeed he conducts it. / Upon the tārpya cloth and an upper garment of skins they suffocate the horse. / This indeed is the form of domestic animals; / by form indeed he secures domestic animals. / There is a gold-embroidered cushion, / for the securing of fiery energy.

3.9.20.s: rukmo bhavati | suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai | aśvo bhavati | prajāpaterāptyai | asya vai lokasya rūpaṃ tārpyam | antarikṣasya kṛttyadhīvāsaḥ | divo hiraṇyakaśipu | ādityasya rukmaḥ | prajāpateraśvaḥ | imameva lokaṃ tārpyeṇāpnoti ||
3.9.20.d: रुक्मो भवति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्यानुख्यात्यै । अश्वो भवति । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । अस्य वै लोकस्य रूपं तार्प्यम् । अन्तरिक्षस्य कृत्त्यधीवासः । दिवो हिरण्यकशिपु । आदित्यस्य रुक्मः । प्रजापतेरश्वः । इममेव लोकं तार्प्येणाप्नोति ॥
3.9.20.m: There is a gold plate, / for the illumination of the heavenly realm. / There is a horse, / for the attainment of Prajāpati. / The tārpya cloth is the form of this world; / the upper garment of skins, of the atmosphere; / the gold-embroidered cushion, of heaven; / the gold plate, of the sun; / the horse, of Prajāpati. / This world he attains with the tārpya cloth,

3.9.20.s: antarikṣaṃ kṛtyadhīvāsena | divaṃ hiraṇyakaśipunā | ādityaṃ rukmeṇa | aśvenaiva medhyena prajāpateḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | etāsāmeva devatānāṃ sāyujyam | sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatāmāpnoti | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
3.9.20.d: अन्तरिक्षं कृत्यधीवासेन । दिवं हिरण्यकशिपुना । आदित्यं रुक्मेण । अश्वेनैव मेध्येन प्रजापतेः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । एतासामेव देवतानां सायुज्यम् । सार्ष्टितां समानलोकतामाप्नोति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
3.9.20.m: the atmosphere with the upper garment of skins, / heaven with the gold-embroidered cushion, / the sun with the gold plate; / by the horse fit for sacrifice he attains unison and co-residence with Prajāpati. / He attains unison, / equal power, and sharing the same realm with these deities, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, / and who thus knows it.

3.9.21.s: ādityāścāṃgirasaśca suvarge loke'spardhanta | te'ṃgirasa ādityebhyaḥ | amumādityamaśvaṃ śvetaṃ bhūtaṃ dakṣiṇāmanayan | te'bruvan | yaṃ no'neṣṭa | sa varyo'bhūditi | tasmādaśvaṃ savaryetyāhvayanti | tasmādyajñe varo dīyate | yatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvo nāma
3.9.21.d: आदित्याश्चांगिरसश्च सुवर्गे लोकेऽस्पर्धन्त । तेऽंगिरस आदित्येभ्यः । अमुमादित्यमश्वं श्वेतं भूतं दक्षिणामनयन् । तेऽब्रुवन् । यं नोऽनेष्ट । स वर्योऽभूदिति । तस्मादश्वं सवर्येत्याह्वयन्ति । तस्माद्यज्ञे वरो दीयते । यत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वो नाम
3.9.21.m: The Ādityas and the Aṅgirases vied in the heavenly realm. / Those Aṅgirases brought that sun / having become a white horse as the sacrificial fee to the Ādityas. / They said: / 'The one whom you have brought to us, / he has become precious.' / Therefore they address the horse as 'precious'; / therefore the choice boon is given at the sacrifice. / In that Prajāpati, being seized, became a horse (aśva), / therefore he is named horse (áśva).

3.9.21.s: yacchvayadarurāsīt | tasmādarvā nāma | yathsadyo vājānthsamajayat | tasmādvājī nāma | yadasurāṇāṃ lokānādatta | tasmādādityo nāma | agnirvā aśvamedhasya yonirāyatanam | sūryo'gneryonirāyatanam | yadaśvamedhe'gnau citya uttaravedimupavapati | yonimantamevainamāyatanavantaṃ karoti
3.9.21.d: यच्छ्वयदरुरासीत् । तस्मादर्वा नाम । यथ्सद्यो वाजान्थ्समजयत् । तस्माद्वाजी नाम । यदसुराणां लोकानादत्त । तस्मादादित्यो नाम । अग्निर्वा अश्वमेधस्य योनिरायतनम् । सूर्योऽग्नेर्योनिरायतनम् । यदश्वमेधेऽग्नौ चित्य उत्तरवेदिमुपवपति । योनिमन्तमेवैनमायतनवन्तं करोति
3.9.21.m: In that, swelling, he was a courser (aru), / therefore he is named steed (árvan). / In that he immediately won the prize (vāja), / therefore he is named charger (vājín). / In that he took away (ādatta) the worlds of the asuras, / therefore he is named Āditya. / Agni indeed is the womb and resting place of the horse sacrifice; / Sūrya is the womb and resting place of Agni. / In that at the horse sacrifice, when the fire is to be piled, he strews the high altar, / he makes him possess a womb and a resting place.

3.9.21.s: yonimānāyatanavānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda | prāṇāpānau vā etau devānām | yadarkāśvamedhau | prāṇāpānāvevāvarundhe | ojo balaṃ vā etau devānām | yadarkāśvamedhau | ojo balamevāvarundhe | agnirvā aśvamedhasya yonirāyatanam | sūryo'gneryonirāyatanam | yadaśvamedhe'gnau citya uttaravediṃ cinoti | tāvarkāśvamedhau | arkāśvamedhāvevāvarundhe | atho arkāśvamedhayoreva pratitiṣṭhati
3.9.21.d: योनिमानायतनवान्भवति । य एवं वेद । प्राणापानौ वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदर्काश्वमेधौ । प्राणापानावेवावरुन्धे । ओजो बलं वा एतौ देवानाम् । यदर्काश्वमेधौ । ओजो बलमेवावरुन्धे । अग्निर्वा अश्वमेधस्य योनिरायतनम् । सूर्योऽग्नेर्योनिरायतनम् । यदश्वमेधेऽग्नौ चित्य उत्तरवेदिं चिनोति । तावर्काश्वमेधौ । अर्काश्वमेधावेवावरुन्धे । अथो अर्काश्वमेधयोरेव प्रतितिष्ठति
3.9.21.m: He comes to possess a womb and a resting place / who knows thus. / The exhalation and inhalation of the gods indeed are these two, / namely Arka and the horse sacrifice; / exhalation and inhalation indeed he secures. / The splendorous might and physical strength of the gods indeed are these two, / namely Arka and the horse sacrifice; / splendorous might and physical strength indeed he secures. / Agni indeed is the womb and resting place of the horse sacrifice; / Sūrya is the womb and resting place of Agni. / In that at the horse sacrifice, when the fire is to be piled, he piles the high altar, / those two are Arka and the horse sacrifice; / Arka and the horse sacrifice indeed he secures; / moreover, he finds a firm foundation in Arka and the horse sacrifice.

3.9.22.s: prajāpatiṃ vai devāḥ pitaram | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāyālabhanta | tamālabhyopāvasan | prātaryaṣṭāsmaha iti | ekaṃ vā etaddevānāmahaḥ | yathsaṃvathsaraḥ | tasmādaśvaḥ purastāthsaṃvathsara ālabhyate | yatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvaḥ | yathsadyo medho'bhavat
3.9.22.d: प्रजापतिं वै देवाः पितरम् । पशुं भूतं मेधायालभन्त । तमालभ्योपावसन् । प्रातर्यष्टास्मह इति । एकं वा एतद्देवानामहः । यथ्संवथ्सरः । तस्मादश्वः पुरस्ताथ्संवथ्सर आलभ्यते । यत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वः । यथ्सद्यो मेधोऽभवत्
3.9.22.m: The gods seized their father Prajāpati, / who had become a domestic animal, for the sacrifice. / Having seized him, they waited by [him], saying: / 'We shall sacrifice tomorrow.' / Indeed, one day of the gods / is a year. / Therefore, the horse is seized a year beforehand. / Because Prajāpati, when seized, became a horse (áśva), / therefore it is a horse. / Because he immediately became sacrificial substance (médha),

3.9.22.s: tasmādaśvamedhaḥ | veduko'śvamāśuṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | yadvai tatprajāpatirālabdho'śvo'bhavat | tasmādaśvaḥ prajāpateḥ paśūnāmanurūpatamaḥ | ā'sya putraḥ pratirūpo jāyate | ya evaṃ veda | sarvāṇi bhūtāni saṃbhṛtyālabhate | samenaṃ devāstejase brahmavarcasāya bharanti | yo'śvamedhena yajate
3.9.22.d: तस्मादश्वमेधः । वेदुकोऽश्वमाशुं भवति । य एवं वेद । यद्वै तत्प्रजापतिरालब्धोऽश्वोऽभवत् । तस्मादश्वः प्रजापतेः पशूनामनुरूपतमः । आऽस्य पुत्रः प्रतिरूपो जायते । य एवं वेद । सर्वाणि भूतानि संभृत्यालभते । समेनं देवास्तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय भरन्ति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते
3.9.22.m: therefore it is the horse sacrifice (aśvamedhá). / He becomes one who finds a swift horse, / whoever knows thus. / When Prajāpati, having been seized, became a horse, / therefore, of domestic animals, the horse is the most suitable counterpart to Prajāpati. / A son who is his exact counterpart is born to him, / whoever knows thus. / Having gathered all beings, he seizes [it]. / The gods bring him together for fiery energy and spiritual preeminence, / who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice,

3.9.22.s: ya u cainamevaṃ veda | etadvai taddevā etāṃ devatām | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāyālabhanta | yajñameva | yajñena yajñamayajanta devāḥ | kāmapraṃ yajñamakurvata | te'mṛtatvamakāmayanta | te'mṛtatvamagacchan | yo'śvamedhena yajate | devānāmevāyanenaiti
3.9.22.d: य उ चैनमेवं वेद । एतद्वै तद्देवा एतां देवताम् । पशुं भूतं मेधायालभन्त । यज्ञमेव । यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः । कामप्रं यज्ञमकुर्वत । तेऽमृतत्वमकामयन्त । तेऽमृतत्वमगच्छन् । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । देवानामेवायनेनैति
3.9.22.m: and whoever knows it thus. / This was that deity that the gods / seized for the sacrifice when he had become a domestic animal: / namely, sacrifice itself. / With sacrifice the gods sacrificed to sacrifice; / they made the sacrifice wish-fulfilling. / They desired immortality; / they went to immortality. / Whoever sacrifices with the horse sacrifice / goes along the very path of the gods.

3.9.22.s: prājāpatyenaiva yajñena yajate kāmapreṇa | apunarmārameva gacchati | etasya vai rūpeṇa purastātprājāpatyamṛṣabhaṃ tūparaṃ bahurūpamā labhate | sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ | sarvasyāptyai | sarvasya jityai | sarvameva tenāpnoti | sarvaṃ jayati | yo'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda
3.9.22.d: प्राजापत्येनैव यज्ञेन यजते कामप्रेण । अपुनर्मारमेव गच्छति । एतस्य वै रूपेण पुरस्तात्प्राजापत्यमृषभं तूपरं बहुरूपमा लभते । सर्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यः । सर्वस्याप्त्यै । सर्वस्य जित्यै । सर्वमेव तेनाप्नोति । सर्वं जयति । योऽश्वमेधेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद
3.9.22.m: He sacrifices with the wish-fulfilling sacrifice of Prajāpati; / he attains non-dying-again. / In the form of this [Prajāpati], beforehand, he seizes a hornless, many-colored bull sacred to Prajāpati / for all desires, / for the attainment of everything, / for the conquest of everything. / By that he attains everything; / he conquers everything— / whoever sacrifices with the horse sacrifice, / and whoever knows it thus.

3.9.23.s: yo vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhoti | ahorātre vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī | yathsāyaṃ prātarjuhoti | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya lomaṃ llomañjuhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya pade veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya pade pade juhoti | darśapūrṇamāsau vā aśvasya medhyasya pade
3.9.23.d: यो वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमनी वेद । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुहोति । अहोरात्रे वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमनी । यथ्सायं प्रातर्जुहोति । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुहोति । एतदनुकृति ह स्म वै पुरा । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य लोमं ल्लोमञ्जुह्वति । यो वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य पदे वेद । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य पदे पदे जुहोति । दर्शपूर्णमासौ वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य पदे
3.9.23.m: Whoever knows the two hairs of the sacrificial horse, / he offers upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / Day and night are the two hairs of the sacrificial horse. / When he offers evening and morning, / he offers upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer upon each hair of the sacrificial horse. / Whoever knows the two footprints of the sacrificial horse, / he offers in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / The new-moon and full-moon rites are the two footprints of the sacrificial horse.

3.9.23.s: yaddarśapūrṇamāsau yajate | aśvasyaiva medhyasya pade pade juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya pade pade juhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya vivartanaṃ veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti | asau vā ādityo'śvaḥ | sa āhavanīyamāgacchati | tadvivartate | yadagnihotraṃ juhoti | aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhvati
3.9.23.d: यद्दर्शपूर्णमासौ यजते । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य पदे पदे जुहोति । एतदनुकृति ह स्म वै पुरा । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य पदे पदे जुह्वति । यो वा अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य विवर्तनं वेद । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य विवर्तने विवर्तने जुहोति । असौ वा आदित्योऽश्वः । स आहवनीयमागच्छति । तद्विवर्तते । यदग्निहोत्रं जुहोति । अश्वस्यैव मेध्यस्य विवर्तने विवर्तने जुहोति । एतदनुकृति ह स्म वै पुरा । अश्वस्य मेध्यस्य विवर्तने विवर्तने जुह्वति
3.9.23.m: When he performs the new-moon and full-moon rites, / he offers in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer in every footprint of the sacrificial horse. / Whoever knows the rolling-place of the sacrificial horse, / he offers at every roll of the sacrificial horse. / Yonder sun is the horse. / He comes to the Āhavanīya; / there he rolls. / When he offers the Agnihotra, / he offers at every roll of the sacrificial horse. / In imitation of this, formerly, / they used to offer at every roll of the sacrificial horse.

3.10.1.s: saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ prajñānaṃ jānadabhijānat | saṃkalpamānaṃ prakalpamānamupakalpamānamupaklṛptaṃ klṛptam | śreyo vasīya āyathsaṃbhūtaṃ bhūtam | citraḥ ketuḥ prabhānābhānthsaṃbhān | jyotiṣmāg stejasvānātapaṃ stapannabhitapan | rocano rocamānaḥ śobhanaḥ śobhamānaḥ kalyāṇaḥ | darśā dṛṣṭā darśatā viśvarūpā sudarśanā | āpyāyamānā pyāyamānā pyāyā sūnṛterā | āpūryamāṇā pūryamāṇā pūrayantī pūrṇā paurṇamāsī | dātā pradātā''nando modaḥ pramodaḥ
3.10.1.d: संज्ञानं विज्ञानं प्रज्ञानं जानदभिजानत् । संकल्पमानं प्रकल्पमानमुपकल्पमानमुपक्लृप्तं क्लृप्तम् । श्रेयो वसीय आयथ्संभूतं भूतम् । चित्रः केतुः प्रभानाभान्थ्संभान् । ज्योतिष्माग् स्तेजस्वानातपं स्तपन्नभितपन् । रोचनो रोचमानः शोभनः शोभमानः कल्याणः । दर्शा दृष्टा दर्शता विश्वरूपा सुदर्शना । आप्यायमाना प्यायमाना प्याया सूनृतेरा । आपूर्यमाणा पूर्यमाणा पूरयन्ती पूर्णा पौर्णमासी । दाता प्रदाता'ऽनन्दो मोदः प्रमोदः
3.10.1.m: Awareness, discernment, understanding, knowing, recognizing; / designing, planning, arranging, arranged, accomplished; / better, wealthier, coming, arrived, been; / Citra, Ketu, Prabhān, Ābhān, Saṃbhān; / luminous, possessed of fiery energy, radiating, burning, scorching; / bright, shining, beautiful, splendid, auspicious; / Dárśā, Dṛṣṭā́, Darśatā́, Viśvárūpā, Sudarśanā́; / swelling, thriving, abundance, gladness, refreshment; / filling up, waxing, replenishing, full, full-moon night; / giver, bestower, joy, pleasure, delight;

3.10.1.s: āveśayanniveśayanthsaṃveśanaḥ saṃśāntaḥ śāntaḥ | ābhavanprabhavanthsaṃbhavanthsaṃbhūto bhūtaḥ | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ saṃstutaṃ kalyāṇaṃ viśvarūpam | śukramamṛtaṃ tejasvi tejaḥ samiddham | aruṇaṃ bhānumanmarīcimadabhitapattapasvat | savitā prasavitā dīpto dīpayandīpyamānaḥ | jvalañjvalitā tapanvitapanthsaṃtapan | rocano rocamānaḥ śumbhūḥ śumbhamāno vāmaḥ | sutā sunvatī prasutā sūyamānā'bhiṣūyamāṇā | pītī prapā saṃpā tṛptistarpayantī
3.10.1.d: आवेशयन्निवेशयन्थ्संवेशनः संशान्तः शान्तः । आभवन्प्रभवन्थ्संभवन्थ्संभूतो भूतः । प्रस्तुतं विष्टुतं संस्तुतं कल्याणं विश्वरूपम् । शुक्रममृतं तेजस्वि तेजः समिद्धम् । अरुणं भानुमन्मरीचिमदभितपत्तपस्वत् । सविता प्रसविता दीप्तो दीपयन्दीप्यमानः । ज्वलञ्ज्वलिता तपन्वितपन्थ्संतपन् । रोचनो रोचमानः शुम्भूः शुम्भमानो वामः । सुता सुन्वती प्रसुता सूयमानाऽभिषूयमाणा । पीती प्रपा संपा तृप्तिस्तर्पयन्ती
3.10.1.m: settling, establishing, housing, appeased, peaceful; / arising, originating, coming into being, formed, existed; / praised in the prologue, praised diversely, chanted together, auspicious, omniform; / clear, immortal, possessed of fiery energy, fiery energy, kindled; / reddish, radiant, beaming, scorching, full of heat; / Savitṛ, the impeller, shining, illuminating, brilliant; / blazing, flamed, heating, burning intensely, scorching completely; / bright, shining, handsome, adorning, lovely; / pressed, pressing, pressed out, being pressed, being squeezed out; / drinking, drinking-trough, common draught, satisfaction, satisfying;

3.10.1.s: kāntā kāmyā kāmajātā''yuṣmatī kāmadughā | abhiśāstā'numantā''nando modaḥ pramodaḥ | āsādayanniṣādayanthsaṃsādanaḥ saṃsannaḥ sannaḥ | ābhūrvibhūḥ prabhūḥ śaṃbhūrbhuvaḥ | pavitraṃ paviyiṣyanpūto medhyaḥ | yaśo yaśasvānāyuramṛtaḥ | jīvo jīviṣyanthsvargo lokaḥ | sahasvānthsahīyānojasvānthsahamānaḥ | jayannabhijayanthsudraviṇo draviṇodāḥ | ārdrapavitro harikeśo modaḥ pramodaḥ
3.10.1.d: कान्ता काम्या कामजाता'ऽयुष्मती कामदुघा । अभिशास्ताऽनुमन्ता'ऽनन्दो मोदः प्रमोदः । आसादयन्निषादयन्थ्संसादनः संसन्नः सन्नः । आभूर्विभूः प्रभूः शंभूर्भुवः । पवित्रं पवियिष्यन्पूतो मेध्यः । यशो यशस्वानायुरमृतः । जीवो जीविष्यन्थ्स्वर्गो लोकः । सहस्वान्थ्सहीयानोजस्वान्थ्सहमानः । जयन्नभिजयन्थ्सुद्रविणो द्रविणोदाः । आर्द्रपवित्रो हरिकेशो मोदः प्रमोदः
3.10.1.m: beloved, desirable, born of desire, long-lived, yielding desires; / commander, assenter, joy, pleasure, delight; / seating, depositing, settling, settled, seated; / existing, pervasive, mighty, beneficent, earth; / purifier, about to purify, cleansed, fit for sacrifice; / fame, famous, lifespan, immortal; / living, about to live, heavenly realm; / powerful, mightier, splendorous, prevailing; / winning, conquering, rich in wealth, wealth-giver; / having a fresh strainer, golden-haired, joy, delight.

3.10.1.s: aruṇo'ruṇarajāḥ puṇḍarīko viśvajidabhijit | ārdraḥ pinvamāno'nnavānrasavānirāvān | sarvauṣadhaḥ sambharo mahasvān | ejatkā jovatkāḥ | kṣullakāḥ śipiviṣṭakāḥ | sarisrarāḥ suśeravaḥ | ajirāso gamiṣṇavaḥ | idānīṃ tadānīmetarhi kṣipramajiram | āśurnimeṣaḥ phaṇo dravannatidravan | tvaraṃstvaramāṇa āśurāśīyāñjavaḥ | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'tirātro dvirātrastrirātraścatūrātraḥ | agnirṛtuḥ sūrya ṛtuścandramā ṛtuḥ | prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsaro mahānkaḥ
3.10.1.d: अरुणोऽरुणरजाः पुण्डरीको विश्वजिदभिजित् । आर्द्रः पिन्वमानोऽन्नवान्रसवानिरावान् । सर्वौषधः सम्भरो महस्वान् । एजत्का जोवत्काः । क्षुल्लकाः शिपिविष्टकाः । सरिस्रराः सुशेरवः । अजिरासो गमिष्णवः । इदानीं तदानीमेतर्हि क्षिप्रमजिरम् । आशुर्निमेषः फणो द्रवन्नतिद्रवन् । त्वरंस्त्वरमाण आशुराशीयाञ्जवः । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽतिरात्रो द्विरात्रस्त्रिरात्रश्चतूरात्रः । अग्निरृतुः सूर्य ऋतुश्चन्द्रमा ऋतुः । प्रजापतिः संवथ्सरो महान्कः
3.10.1.m: Red, red-dusted, lotus-like, all-conquering, victorious; / moist, overflowing, rich in food, sapful, rich in refreshment; / containing all herbs, all-gathering, mighty; / stirring, moving quickly; / small, Śipiviṣṭa; / gliding, easy to lie upon; / swift, departing; / now, then, at this moment, instantly, swiftly; / quick, twinkling, gliding, running, outrunning; / hastening, hurrying, swift, swifter, speed; / Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Atirātra, Dvirātra, Trirātra, Catūrātra; / Agni is the season, Sūrya is the season, Candramas is the season; / Prajāpati is the year, the great Ka.

3.10.2.s: bhūragniṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokānthsaṃvathsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda | bhuvo vāyuṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokānthsaṃvathsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda | svarādityaṃ ca divaṃ ca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokānthsaṃvathsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścandramasaṃ ca diśaśca māṃ ca | trīṃśca lokānthsaṃvathsaraṃ ca | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.10.2.d: भूरग्निं च पृथिवीं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । भुवो वायुं चान्तरिक्षं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । स्वरादित्यं च दिवं च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद । भूर्भुवः स्वश्चन्द्रमसं च दिशश्च मां च । त्रींश्च लोकान्थ्संवथ्सरं च । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.10.2.m: 'Bhūḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with Agni, the earth, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Bhuvaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with Vāyu, the atmosphere, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Svaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with the sun, heaven, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!' / 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ! May Prajāpati seat you / with the moon, the directions, and me, / and the three worlds, and the year! / With that deity, sit firm like Angiras!'

3.10.3.s: tvameva tvāṃ vettha yo'si so'si | tvameva tvāmacaiṣīḥ | citaścāsi saṃcitaścāsyagne | etāvāṃścāsi bhūyāṃścāsyagne | yatte agne nyūnaṃ yadu te'tiriktam | ādityāstadaṃgirasaścinvantu | viśve te devāścitimāpūrayantu | citaścāsi saṃcitaścāsyagne | etāvāṃścāsi bhūyāṃścāsyagne | mā te agne cayena mā'ti ca yenāyurāvṛkṣi | sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiryadadāvudeti | tapaso jātamanibhṛṣṭamojaḥ | tatte jyotiriṣṭake | tena me tapa | tena me jvala | tena me dīdihi | yāvaddevāḥ | yāvadasāti sūryaḥ | yāvadutāpi brahma
3.10.3.d: त्वमेव त्वां वेत्थ योऽसि सोऽसि । त्वमेव त्वामचैषीः । चितश्चासि संचितश्चास्यग्ने । एतावांश्चासि भूयांश्चास्यग्ने । यत्ते अग्ने न्यूनं यदु तेऽतिरिक्तम् । आदित्यास्तदंगिरसश्चिन्वन्तु । विश्वे ते देवाश्चितिमापूरयन्तु । चितश्चासि संचितश्चास्यग्ने । एतावांश्चासि भूयांश्चास्यग्ने । मा ते अग्ने चयेन माऽति च येनायुरावृक्षि । सर्वेषां ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर्यददावुदेति । तपसो जातमनिभृष्टमोजः । तत्ते ज्योतिरिष्टके । तेन मे तप । तेन मे ज्वल । तेन मे दीदिहि । यावद्देवाः । यावदसाति सूर्यः । यावदुतापि ब्रह्म
3.10.3.m: You alone know yourself, who you are, what you are. / You alone have piled yourself. / You are piled, and you are gathered, O Agni; / you are so great, and you are greater still, O Agni. / What of yours is deficient, O Agni, and what of yours is redundant, / let the Ādityas and the Aṅgirases pile that; / let all the gods fill up the layer. / You are piled, and you are gathered, O Agni; / you are so great, and you are greater still, O Agni. / May I not cut off your lifespan, O Agni, by under-piling or by over-piling! / The light of all lights that rises yonder, / the unflagging splendorous might born of ascetic heat, / that is your light, O brick. / With that heat me; / with that shine for me; / with that beam for me, / as long as there are gods, / as long as the sun shall be, / and even as long as brahman!

3.10.4.s: saṃvathsaro'si parivathsaro'si | idāvathsaro'sīdu vathsaro'si | idvathsaro'si vathsaro'si | tasya te vasantaḥ śiraḥ | grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | varṣāḥ puccham | śaraduttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | hemanto madhyam | pūrvapakṣāścitayaḥ | aparapakṣāḥ purīṣam
3.10.4.d: संवथ्सरोऽसि परिवथ्सरोऽसि । इदावथ्सरोऽसीदु वथ्सरोऽसि । इद्वथ्सरोऽसि वथ्सरोऽसि । तस्य ते वसन्तः शिरः । ग्रीष्मो दक्षिणः पक्षः । वर्षाः पुच्छम् । शरदुत्तरः पक्षः । हेमन्तो मध्यम् । पूर्वपक्षाश्चितयः । अपरपक्षाः पुरीषम्
3.10.4.m: You are the Saṃvatsara; you are the Parivatsara; / you are the Idāvatsara; you are the Iduvatsara; / you are the Idvatsara; you are the Vatsara. / Of you, spring is the head; / summer is the right wing; / the rains are the tail; / autumn is the left wing; / winter is the middle; / the waxing fortnights are the layers; / the waning fortnights are the loose soil;

3.10.4.s: ahorātrāṇīṣṭakāḥ | ṛṣabho'si svargo lokaḥ | yasyāṃ diśi mahīyase | tato no maha āvaha | vāyurbhūtvā sarvā diśa āvāhi | sarvā diśo'nu vivāhi | sarvā diśo'nu saṃvāhi | cityā citimāpṛṇa | acityā citimāpṛṇa | cidasi samudrayoniḥ
3.10.4.d: अहोरात्राणीष्टकाः । ऋषभोऽसि स्वर्गो लोकः । यस्यां दिशि महीयसे । ततो नो मह आवह । वायुर्भूत्वा सर्वा दिश आवाहि । सर्वा दिशोऽनु विवाहि । सर्वा दिशोऽनु संवाहि । चित्या चितिमापृण । अचित्या चितिमापृण । चिदसि समुद्रयोनिः
3.10.4.m: the days and nights are the bricks. / You are the bull, the heavenly realm. / In whichever quarter you are magnified, / from there bring us greatness. / Becoming the wind, blow in all directions; / blow along through all directions; / blow together through all directions. / With thought fill the layer; / with absence of thought fill the layer. / You are thought, ocean-born;

3.10.4.s: indurdakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā | hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyuḥ | mahānthsadhasthe dhruva āniṣattaḥ | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ | eti preti vīti samityuditi | divaṃ me yaccha | antarikṣaṃ me yaccha | pṛthivīṃ me yaccha | pṛthivīṃ me yaccha | antarikṣaṃ me yaccha | divaṃ me yaccha | ahnā prasāraya | rātryā samaca | rātryā prasāraya | ahnā samaca | kāmaṃ prasāraya | kāmaṃ samaca
3.10.4.d: इन्दुर्दक्षः श्येन ऋतावा । हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनो भुरण्युः । महान्थ्सधस्थे ध्रुव आनिषत्तः । नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः । एति प्रेति वीति समित्युदिति । दिवं मे यच्छ । अन्तरिक्षं मे यच्छ । पृथिवीं मे यच्छ । पृथिवीं मे यच्छ । अन्तरिक्षं मे यच्छ । दिवं मे यच्छ । अह्ना प्रसारय । रात्र्या समच । रात्र्या प्रसारय । अह्ना समच । कामं प्रसारय । कामं समच
3.10.4.m: a drop, skillful, a righteous falcon, / a golden-winged, nurturing bird, / great, seated firm in the common abode. / Homage be to you; do not harm me! / Entering, issuing forth, dispersing, uniting, ascending! / Grant me heaven; / grant me the midspace; / grant me the earth. / Grant me the earth; / grant me the midspace; / grant me heaven. / Stretch forth by day; / contract by night. / Stretch forth by night; contract by day. / Stretch forth desire; / contract desire.

3.10.5.s: bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ | ojo balam | brahma kṣattram | yaśo mahat | satyaṃ tapo nāma | rūpamamṛtam | cakṣuḥ śrotram | mana āyuḥ | viśvaṃ yaśo mahaḥ | samaṃ tapo haro bhāḥ | jātavedā yadi vā pāvako'si | vaiśvānaro yadi vā vaidyuto'si | śaṃ prajābhyo yajamānāya lokam | ūrjaṃ puṣṭiṃ dadadabhyāvavṛthsva
3.10.5.d: भूर्भुवः स्वः । ओजो बलम् । ब्रह्म क्षत्त्रम् । यशो महत् । सत्यं तपो नाम । रूपममृतम् । चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् । मन आयुः । विश्वं यशो महः । समं तपो हरो भाः । जातवेदा यदि वा पावकोऽसि । वैश्वानरो यदि वा वैद्युतोऽसि । शं प्रजाभ्यो यजमानाय लोकम् । ऊर्जं पुष्टिं दददभ्याववृथ्स्व
3.10.5.m: Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! / Splendorous might, power; / brahman, regal power; / glory, greatness; / truth, ascetic heat, name; / form, the immortal; / eye, ear; / mind, lifespan; / all, glory, greatness; / equality, ascetic heat, heat-glow, light! / Whether you are Jātavedas or the purifying one, / whether you are Vaiśvānara or the lightning fire, / giving welfare to offspring, a realm to the sacrificer, / vigor, and nourishment, turn toward [us]!

3.10.6.s: rājñī virājñī | samrājñī svarājñī | arciḥ śociḥ | tapo haro bhāḥ | agnirindro bṛhaspatiḥ | viśve devā bhuvanasya gopāḥ | te mā sarve yaśasā saṃsṛjantu
3.10.6.d: राज्ञी विराज्ञी । सम्राज्ञी स्वराज्ञी । अर्चिः शोचिः । तपो हरो भाः । अग्निरिन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः । विश्वे देवा भुवनस्य गोपाः । ते मा सर्वे यशसा संसृजन्तु
3.10.6.m: Queen, ruling queen, / sovereign queen, self-ruling queen! / Flare, radiance, / ascetic heat, heat-glow, light! / Agni, Indra, Bṛhaspati, / all the gods, guardians of the world— / may they all endow me with glory!

3.10.7.s: asave svāhā vasave svāhā | vibhuve svāhā vivasvate svāhā | abhibhuve svāhā'dhipataye svāhā | divāṃ pataye svāhā'ṃhaspatyāya svāhā | cākṣuṣmatyāya svāhā jyotiṣmatyāya svāhā | rājñe svāhā virājñe svāhā | saṃrājñe svāhā svarājñe svāhā | śūṣāya svāhā sūryāya svāhā | candramase svāhā jyotiṣe svāhā | saṃsarpāya svāhā kalyāṇāya svāhā | arjunāya svāhā
3.10.7.d: असवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहा । विभुवे स्वाहा विवस्वते स्वाहा । अभिभुवे स्वाहाऽधिपतये स्वाहा । दिवां पतये स्वाहाऽंहस्पत्याय स्वाहा । चाक्षुष्मत्याय स्वाहा ज्योतिष्मत्याय स्वाहा । राज्ञे स्वाहा विराज्ञे स्वाहा । संराज्ञे स्वाहा स्वराज्ञे स्वाहा । शूषाय स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा । चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा ज्योतिषे स्वाहा । संसर्पाय स्वाहा कल्याणाय स्वाहा । अर्जुनाय स्वाहा
3.10.7.m: To breath, svāhā! / To the Vasu, svāhā! / To the pervasive one, svāhā! / To Vivasvat, svāhā! / To the vanquisher, svāhā; to the overlord, svāhā! / To the lord of days, svāhā; to the lord of distress, svāhā! / To the visionary one, svāhā; to the luminous one, svāhā! / To the king, svāhā; to the sovereign, svāhā! / To the emperor, svāhā! / To the independent king, svāhā! / To vigor, svāhā; to the sun, svāhā! / To the moon, svāhā; to the light, svāhā! / To the creeping one, svāhā! / To the auspicious one, svāhā! / To the bright one, svāhā!

3.10.8.s: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata | mahī na dhārā'tyandho arṣati | ahirha jīrṇāmatisarpati tvacam | atyo na krīḍannasaradvṛṣā hariḥ | upayāmagṛhīto'si mṛtyave tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | eṣa te yonirmṛtyave tvā | apa mṛtyumapa kṣudham | apetaḥ śapathaṃ jahi | adhā no agna āvaha | rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam
3.10.8.d: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत । मही न धाराऽत्यन्धो अर्षति । अहिर्ह जीर्णामतिसर्पति त्वचम् । अत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः । उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मृत्यवे त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । एष ते योनिर्मृत्यवे त्वा । अप मृत्युमप क्षुधम् । अपेतः शपथं जहि । अधा नो अग्न आवह । रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम्
3.10.8.m: Sing to the wise purifying one; / like a mighty stream, he rushes beyond the soma plant; / the snake indeed sloughs its worn skin; / like a steed playing, the tawny bull has run. / You are taken with a support; I take you pleasing to Death. / This is your womb; for Death, you! / Death away, hunger away! / Slay the curse away from here! / Then, O Agni, bring us / nourishment of wealth a thousandfold!

3.10.8.s: ye te sahasramayutaṃ pāśāḥ | mṛtyo martyāya hantave | tān yajñasya māyayā | sarvānavayajāmahe | bhakṣo'syamṛtabhakṣaḥ | tasya te mṛtyupītasyāmṛtavataḥ | svagākṛtasya madhumataḥ | upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi | mandrā'bhibhūtiḥ keturyajñānāṃ vāk | asāvehi
3.10.8.d: ये ते सहस्रमयुतं पाशाः । मृत्यो मर्त्याय हन्तवे । तान् यज्ञस्य मायया । सर्वानवयजामहे । भक्षोऽस्यमृतभक्षः । तस्य ते मृत्युपीतस्यामृतवतः । स्वगाकृतस्य मधुमतः । उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि । मन्द्राऽभिभूतिः केतुर्यज्ञानां वाक् । असावेहि
3.10.8.m: The thousand, the myriad fetters that are yours, / O Death, for the mortal's slaying— / all those, by the sacrifice's mystic power, / we sacrifice away. / You are a portion, the portion of immortality. / Of you, drunk by Death, possessed of immortality, / made into svagā, full of honey, / invited, I partake as an invited one. / Pleasing, conquering, the banner of sacrifices is speech. / O So-and-so, come!

3.10.8.s: andho jāgṛviḥ prāṇa | asāvehi | badhira ākrandayitarapāna | asāvehi | ahasto'stvā cakṣuḥ | asāvehi | apādāśo manaḥ | asāvehi | kave vipracitte śrotra | asāvehi |
3.10.8.d: अन्धो जागृविः प्राण । असावेहि । बधिर आक्रन्दयितरपान । असावेहि । अहस्तोऽस्त्वा चक्षुः । असावेहि । अपादाशो मनः । असावेहि । कवे विप्रचित्ते श्रोत्र । असावेहि ।
3.10.8.m: Blind, watchful exhalation; / O So-and-so, come! / Deaf, shrieking inhalation; / O So-and-so, come! / Handless archer, eye; / O So-and-so, come! / Footless runner, mind; / O So-and-so, come! / O sage, wise-minded ear; / O So-and-so, come!

3.10.8.s: suhastaḥ suvāsāḥ | śūṣo nāmāsyamṛto martyeṣu | taṃ tvā'haṃ tathā veda | asāvehi | agnirme vāci śritaḥ | vāgghṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | vāyurme prāṇe śritaḥ
3.10.8.d: सुहस्तः सुवासाः । शूषो नामास्यमृतो मर्त्येषु । तं त्वाऽहं तथा वेद । असावेहि । अग्निर्मे वाचि श्रितः । वाग्घृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । वायुर्मे प्राणे श्रितः
3.10.8.m: Deft-handed, well-clad, / you are named strength, immortal among mortals; / as such do I know you. / O So-and-so, come! / Agni is resting in my speech; / speech in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Vāyu is resting in my exhalation;

3.10.8.s: prāṇo hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | sūryo me cakṣuṣi śritaḥ | cakṣurhṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | candramā me manasi śritaḥ
3.10.8.d: प्राणो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । सूर्यो मे चक्षुषि श्रितः । चक्षुर्हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । चन्द्रमा मे मनसि श्रितः
3.10.8.m: the exhalation in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Sūrya is resting in my eye; / the eye in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The moon is resting in my mind;

3.10.8.s: mano hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | diśo me śrotre śritāḥ | śrotraṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | āpo me retasi śritāḥ
3.10.8.d: मनो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । दिशो मे श्रोत्रे श्रिताः । श्रोत्रं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । आपो मे रेतसि श्रिताः
3.10.8.m: the mind in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The directions are resting in my ear; / the ear in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The waters are resting in my semen;

3.10.8.s: reto hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | pṛthivī me śarīre śritā | śarīraṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | oṣadhivanaspatayo me lomasu śritāḥ
3.10.8.d: रेतो हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पृथिवी मे शरीरे श्रिता । शरीरं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । ओषधिवनस्पतयो मे लोमसु श्रिताः
3.10.8.m: the semen in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The earth is resting in my body; / the body in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Herbs and trees are resting in my bodily hairs;

3.10.8.s: lomāni hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | indro me bale śritaḥ | balaṃ hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | parjanyo me mūrdhni śritaḥ
3.10.8.d: लोमानि हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । इन्द्रो मे बले श्रितः । बलं हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पर्जन्यो मे मूर्ध्नि श्रितः
3.10.8.m: the bodily hairs in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Indra is resting in my power; / power in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Parjanya is resting in my head;

3.10.8.s: mūrdhā hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | īśāno me manyau śritaḥ | manyurhṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | ātmā ma ātmani śritaḥ
3.10.8.d: मूर्धा हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । ईशानो मे मन्यौ श्रितः । मन्युर्हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । आत्मा म आत्मनि श्रितः
3.10.8.m: the head in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Īśāna is resting in my wrath; / wrath in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / The self is resting in my self;

3.10.8.s: ātmā hṛdaye | hṛdayaṃ mayi | ahamamṛte | amṛtaṃ brahmaṇi | punarma ātmā punarāyurāgāt | punaḥ prāṇaḥ punarākūtamāgāt | vaiśvānaro raśmibhirvāvṛdhānaḥ | antastiṣṭhatvamṛtasya gopāḥ
3.10.8.d: आत्मा हृदये । हृदयं मयि । अहममृते । अमृतं ब्रह्मणि । पुनर्म आत्मा पुनरायुरागात् । पुनः प्राणः पुनराकूतमागात् । वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर्वावृधानः । अन्तस्तिष्ठत्वमृतस्य गोपाः
3.10.8.m: the self in the heart; / the heart in me; / I in the immortal; / the immortal in brahman. / Back has come my self, back my lifespan, / back exhalation, back intention has come. / May Vaiśvānara, waxing with his rays, / stand within as the guardian of immortality!

3.10.9.s: prajāpatirdevānasṛjata | te pāpmanā saṃditā ajāyanta | tānvyadyat | yadvyadyat | tasmādvidyut | tamavṛścat | yadavṛścat | tasmādvṛṣṭiḥ | tasmādyatraite devate abhiprāpnutaḥ | vi ca haivāsya tatra pāpmānaṃ dyataḥ
3.10.9.d: प्रजापतिर्देवानसृजत । ते पाप्मना संदिता अजायन्त । तान्व्यद्यत् । यद्व्यद्यत् । तस्माद्विद्युत् । तमवृश्चत् । यदवृश्चत् । तस्माद्वृष्टिः । तस्माद्यत्रैते देवते अभिप्राप्नुतः । वि च हैवास्य तत्र पाप्मानं द्यतः
3.10.9.m: Prajāpati created the gods. / They were born bound by evil. / He cut them free. / Because he cut them free [vyadyat], / therefore lightning [vidyut] came to be. / He sheared it away. / Because he sheared it away [avṛścat], / therefore rain [vṛṣṭiḥ] came to be. / Therefore, wherever these two deities reach, / they cut away and they shear away his evil there;

3.10.9.s: vṛścataśca | saiṣā mīmāṃsā'gnihotra eva saṃpannā | atho āhuḥ | sarveṣu yajñakratuṣviti | hoṣyannapa upaspṛśet | vidyudasi vidya me pāpmānamiti | atha hutvopaspṛśet | vṛṣṭirasi vṛśca me pāpmānamiti | yakṣyamāṇo veṣṭvā vā | vi ca haivāsyaite devate pāpmānaṃ dyataḥ
3.10.9.d: वृश्चतश्च । सैषा मीमांसाऽग्निहोत्र एव संपन्ना । अथो आहुः । सर्वेषु यज्ञक्रतुष्विति । होष्यन्नप उपस्पृशेत् । विद्युदसि विद्य मे पाप्मानमिति । अथ हुत्वोपस्पृशेत् । वृष्टिरसि वृश्च मे पाप्मानमिति । यक्ष्यमाणो वेष्ट्वा वा । वि च हैवास्यैते देवते पाप्मानं द्यतः
3.10.9.m: and they shear it away. / This same inquiry is accomplished in the Agnihotra alone. / Moreover, they say: / "In all sacrificial rites." / About to offer, he should touch water, [saying,] / "You are lightning; cut away my evil!" / Then having offered, he should touch [water, saying,] / "You are rain; shear away my evil!" / Whether about to sacrifice or having sacrificed, / these two deities cut away his evil

3.10.9.s: vṛścataśca | atyaṃho hāruṇiḥ | brahmacāriṇe praśnānprocya prajighāya | parehi | plakṣaṃ daiyāmpātiṃ pṛccha | vettha sāvitrānna vetthāiti | tamāgatya papraccha | ācāryo mā prāhaiṣīt | vettha sāvitrānna vetthāiti | sa hovāca vedeti
3.10.9.d: वृश्चतश्च । अत्यंहो हारुणिः । ब्रह्मचारिणे प्रश्नान्प्रोच्य प्रजिघाय । परेहि । प्लक्षं दैयाम्पातिं पृच्छ । वेत्थ सावित्रान्न वेत्थाइति । तमागत्य पप्रच्छ । आचार्यो मा प्राहैषीत् । वेत्थ सावित्रान्न वेत्थाइति । स होवाच वेदेति
3.10.9.m: and shear it away. / Atyaṃhas Āruṇi, / having explained the questions to a Vedic student, sent him forth: / "Go, / ask Plakṣa Dayyāmpāti: / 'Do you know the Sāvitra [fire] or do you not know it?'" / Coming to him, he asked: / "The teacher has sent me: / 'Do you know the Sāvitra [fire] or do you not know it?'" / He said: "I know it."

3.10.9.s: sa kasminpratiṣṭhita iti | parorajasīti | kastadyatparorajā iti | eṣa vāva sa parorajā iti hovāca | ya eṣa tapati | eṣo'rvāgrajā iti | sa kasmintveṣa iti | satya iti | kiṃ tathsatyamiti | tapa iti
3.10.9.d: स कस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठित इति । परोरजसीति । कस्तद्यत्परोरजा इति । एष वाव स परोरजा इति होवाच । य एष तपति । एषोऽर्वाग्रजा इति । स कस्मिन्त्वेष इति । सत्य इति । किं तथ्सत्यमिति । तप इति
3.10.9.m: "On what is it established?" [the student asked]. / "Beyond the realm of space [parorajas]," [Plakṣa replied]. / "What is that which is beyond the realm of space?" / "This one indeed is beyond the realm of space," he said, / "who shines here; / he is [also] on this side of the realm of space [arvāgrajas]." / "On what, however, is this one [established]?" / "On truth." / "What is that truth?" / "Austerity."

3.10.9.s: kasminnu tapa iti | bala iti | kiṃ tadbalamiti | prāṇa iti | mā sma prāṇamati pṛccha iti mā''cāryo'bravīditi hovāca brahmacārī | sa hovāca plakṣo dayyāmpātiḥ | yadvai brahmacārinprāṇamatyaprakṣyaḥ | mūrdhā te vyapatiṣyat | ahamuta ācāryācchreyānbhaviṣyāmi | yo mā sāvitre samavādiṣṭeti
3.10.9.d: कस्मिन्नु तप इति । बल इति । किं तद्बलमिति । प्राण इति । मा स्म प्राणमति पृच्छ इति मा'ऽचार्योऽब्रवीदिति होवाच ब्रह्मचारी । स होवाच प्लक्षो दय्याम्पातिः । यद्वै ब्रह्मचारिन्प्राणमत्यप्रक्ष्यः । मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यत् । अहमुत आचार्याच्छ्रेयान्भविष्यामि । यो मा सावित्रे समवादिष्टेति
3.10.9.m: "In what now is austerity [established]?" / "In strength." / "What is that strength?" / "The exhalation." / "Do not question beyond the exhalation, so my teacher told me," said the Vedic student. / Plakṣa Dayyāmpāti said: / "If, O Vedic student, you had questioned beyond the exhalation, / your head would have fallen off. / And I shall be better than your teacher, / who disputed with me about the Sāvitra [fire]."

3.10.9.s: tasmāthsāvitre na saṃvadeta | sa yo ha vai sāvitraṃ viduṣā sāvitre saṃvadate | sahāsmiñchriyaṃ dadhāti | anu ha vā asmā asau tapañchriyaṃ manyate | anvasmai śrīstapo manyate | anvasmai tapo balaṃ manyate | anvasmai balaṃ prāṇaṃ manyate | sa yadāha | saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ darśā dṛṣṭeti | eṣa eva tat
3.10.9.d: तस्माथ्सावित्रे न संवदेत । स यो ह वै सावित्रं विदुषा सावित्रे संवदते । सहास्मिञ्छ्रियं दधाति । अनु ह वा अस्मा असौ तपञ्छ्रियं मन्यते । अन्वस्मै श्रीस्तपो मन्यते । अन्वस्मै तपो बलं मन्यते । अन्वस्मै बलं प्राणं मन्यते । स यदाह । संज्ञानं विज्ञानं दर्शा दृष्टेति । एष एव तत्
3.10.9.m: Therefore one should not dispute about the Sāvitra [fire]. / Whoever disputes about the Sāvitra [fire] with one who knows the Sāvitra [fire], / he places prosperity in him. / That one who shines over there certainly concedes prosperity to him; / prosperity concedes austerity to him; / austerity concedes strength to him; / strength concedes the exhalation to him. / When he says: / "Consciousness, discernment, sight, seen," / it is just this [sun].

3.10.9.s: atha yadāha | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatīti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva tānyahāni | eṣa rātrayaḥ | atha yadāha | citraḥ keturdātā pradātā savitā prasavitā'bhiśāstā'numanteti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te'hno muhūrtāḥ | eṣa rātreḥ
3.10.9.d: अथ यदाह । प्रस्तुतं विष्टुतं सुता सुन्वतीति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तान्यहानि । एष रात्रयः । अथ यदाह । चित्रः केतुर्दाता प्रदाता सविता प्रसविताऽभिशास्ताऽनुमन्तेति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तेऽह्नो मुहूर्ताः । एष रात्रेः
3.10.9.m: Then, when he says: / "Praised, branched, pressed, pressing," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those days; / he is the nights. / Then, when he says: / "Bright, banner, giver, distributor, Savitṛ, impeller, ruler, consenter," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those muhūrtas of the day; / he is [those] of the night.

3.10.9.s: atha yadāha | pavitraṃ pavayiṣyanthsahasvān thsahīyānaruṇo'ruṇarajā iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te'rdhamāsāḥ | eṣa māsāḥ | atha yadāha | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'gnirṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsara iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te yajñakratavaḥ | eṣa ṛtavaḥ |
3.10.9.d: अथ यदाह । पवित्रं पवयिष्यन्थ्सहस्वान् थ्सहीयानरुणोऽरुणरजा इति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव तेऽर्धमासाः । एष मासाः । अथ यदाह । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽग्निरृतुः प्रजापतिः संवथ्सर इति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव ते यज्ञक्रतवः । एष ऋतवः ।
3.10.9.m: Then, when he says: / "Purifier, about to purify, mighty, mightier, reddish, having red dust," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those fortnights; / he is the months. / Then, when he says: / "Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Agni, season, Prajāpati, year," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is those sacrificial rites; / he is the seasons;

3.10.9.s: eṣa saṃvathsaraḥ | atha yadāha | idānīṃ tadānīmiti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hyeva te muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtāḥ | janako ha vaidehaḥ | ahorātraiḥ samājagāma | taṃ hocuḥ | yo vā asmān veda | vijahatpāpmānameti
3.10.9.d: एष संवथ्सरः । अथ यदाह । इदानीं तदानीमिति । एष एव तत् । एष ह्येव ते मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्ताः । जनको ह वैदेहः । अहोरात्रैः समाजगाम । तं होचुः । यो वा अस्मान् वेद । विजहत्पाप्मानमेति
3.10.9.m: he is the year. / Then, when he says: / "Now, then," / it is just this [sun]. / For he alone is the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas. / Janaka of Videha / met with the days and nights. / They said to him: / "Whoever knows us / goes leaving evil behind;

3.10.9.s: sarvamāyureti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmiṃ lloke'nnaṃ kṣīyata iti | vijahaddha vai pāpmānameti | sarvamāyureti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmiṃ lloke'nnaṃ kṣīyate | ya evaṃ veda | ahīnā hāśvathyaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra
3.10.9.d: सर्वमायुरेति । अभि स्वर्गं लोकं जयति । नास्यामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽन्नं क्षीयत इति । विजहद्ध वै पाप्मानमेति । सर्वमायुरेति । अभि स्वर्गं लोकं जयति । नास्यामुष्मिं ल्लोकेऽन्नं क्षीयते । य एवं वेद । अहीना हाश्वथ्यः । सावित्रं विदांचकार
3.10.9.m: he attains full lifespan; / he wins the heavenly realm; / his food does not diminish in yonder realm." / Leaving evil behind, indeed, he goes; / he attains full lifespan; / he wins the heavenly realm; / his food does not diminish in yonder realm, / who knows thus. / Ahīnas Āśvatthya / knew the Sāvitra [fire].

3.10.9.s: sa ha haṃso hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokamiyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | haṃso ha vai hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokameti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | devabhāgo ha śrautarṣaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra | taṃ ha vāgadṛśyamānā'bhyuvāca
3.10.9.d: स ह हंसो हिरण्मयो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमियाय । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । हंसो ह वै हिरण्मयो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमेति । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । य एवं वेद । देवभागो ह श्रौतर्षः । सावित्रं विदांचकार । तं ह वागदृश्यमानाऽभ्युवाच
3.10.9.m: Becoming a golden goose [haṃsa], / he went to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya. / Becoming a golden goose, / he goes to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya, / who knows thus. / Devabhāga Śrautarṣa / knew the Sāvitra [fire]. / An invisible voice spoke to him:

3.10.9.s: sarvaṃ bata gautamo veda | yaḥ sāvitraṃ vedeti | sa hovāca | kaiṣā vāgasīti | ayamahaṃ sāvitraḥ | devānāmuttamo lokaḥ | guhyaṃ maho bibhraditi | etāvati ha gautamaḥ | yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā'dho nipapāta | namo nama iti
3.10.9.d: सर्वं बत गौतमो वेद । यः सावित्रं वेदेति । स होवाच । कैषा वागसीति । अयमहं सावित्रः । देवानामुत्तमो लोकः । गुह्यं महो बिभ्रदिति । एतावति ह गौतमः । यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वाऽधो निपपात । नमो नम इति
3.10.9.m: "Ah, Gautama knows everything, / he who knows the Sāvitra [fire]!" / He said: / "What voice are you?" / "I am this Sāvitra [fire], / the highest world of the gods, / bearing a secret greatness." / At that, Gautama, / having arranged his sacred thread over his shoulder, bowed down low, / [saying,] "Homage! Homage!"

3.10.9.s: sa hovāca | mā bhaiṣīrgautama | jito vai te loka iti | tasmādye ke ca sāvitraṃ viduḥ | sarve te jitalokāḥ | sa yo ha vai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā'bhiṣiktaṃ veda | śriyā haivābhiṣicyate | ghṛṇiriti dve akṣare | sūrya iti trīṇi | āditya iti trīṇi
3.10.9.d: स होवाच । मा भैषीर्गौतम । जितो वै ते लोक इति । तस्माद्ये के च सावित्रं विदुः । सर्वे ते जितलोकाः । स यो ह वै सावित्रस्याष्टाक्षरं पदं श्रियाऽभिषिक्तं वेद । श्रिया हैवाभिषिच्यते । घृणिरिति द्वे अक्षरे । सूर्य इति त्रीणि । आदित्य इति त्रीणि
3.10.9.m: It said: / "Do not fear, Gautama; / your world has indeed been won." / Therefore, whoever knows the Sāvitra [fire], / all of them have their world won. / Whoever knows the eight-syllabled line of the Sāvitra [fire] anointed with prosperity, / he is indeed anointed with prosperity. / 'Ghṛṇiḥ' are two syllables; / 'sūryaḥ' are three; / 'ādityaḥ' are three.

3.10.9.s: etadvai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā'bhiṣiktam | ya evaṃ veda | śriyā haivābhiṣicyate | tadetadṛcā'bhyuktam | ṛco akṣare parame vyoman | yasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ | yastaṃ na veda kimṛcā kariṣyati | ya ittadvidusta ime samāsata iti | na ha vā etasyarcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā'rtho'sti | yaḥ sāvitraṃ veda
3.10.9.d: एतद्वै सावित्रस्याष्टाक्षरं पदं श्रियाऽभिषिक्तम् । य एवं वेद । श्रिया हैवाभिषिच्यते । तदेतदृचाऽभ्युक्तम् । ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन् । यस्मिन्देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः । यस्तं न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति । य इत्तद्विदुस्त इमे समासत इति । न ह वा एतस्यर्चा न यजुषा न साम्नाऽर्थोऽस्ति । यः सावित्रं वेद
3.10.9.m: This indeed is the eight-syllabled line of the Sāvitra [fire] anointed with prosperity. / Whoever knows thus / is indeed anointed with prosperity. / That is declared by a verse: / 'In the supreme firmament, the syllable of the ṛc, / in which all the gods are seated; / he who does not know that, what will he do with the ṛc? / Only those who know that sit here together.' / He who knows the Sāvitra [fire] / has no need for a ṛc, nor a yajus, nor a sāman.

3.10.9.s: tadetatpari yaddevacakram | ārdraṃ pinvamānaṃ svarge loka eti | vijahadviśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyat | ārdro ha vai pinvamānaḥ svarge loka eti | vijahanviśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyan | ya evaṃ veda | śūṣo ha vai vārṣṇeyaḥ | ādityena samājagāma | taṃ hovāca | ehi sāvitraṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai svargyo'gniḥ pārayiṣṇuramṛtāthsaṃbhūta iti | eṣa vāva sa sāvitraḥ | ya eṣa tapati | ehi māṃ viddhi | iti haivainaṃ taduvāca
3.10.9.d: तदेतत्परि यद्देवचक्रम् । आर्द्रं पिन्वमानं स्वर्गे लोक एति । विजहद्विश्वा भूतानि संपश्यत् । आर्द्रो ह वै पिन्वमानः स्वर्गे लोक एति । विजहन्विश्वा भूतानि संपश्यन् । य एवं वेद । शूषो ह वै वार्ष्णेयः । आदित्येन समाजगाम । तं होवाच । एहि सावित्रं विद्धि । अयं वै स्वर्ग्योऽग्निः पारयिष्णुरमृताथ्संभूत इति । एष वाव स सावित्रः । य एष तपति । एहि मां विद्धि । इति हैवैनं तदुवाच
3.10.9.m: That wheel of the gods, moving around, / moist and swelling, goes in the heavenly realm, / leaving all beings behind, beholding [them]. / Moist and swelling, he goes in the heavenly realm, / leaving all beings behind, beholding [them], / who knows thus. / Śūṣa Vārṣṇeya / met with Āditya. / He said to him: / "Come, know the Sāvitra [fire]; / this indeed is the heavenly Agni, transporting across, born from the immortal." / This one indeed is that Sāvitra [fire] / who shines here. / "Come, know me!" / — thus indeed he said to him then.

3.10.10.s: iyaṃ vāva saraghā | tasyā agnireva sāraghaṃ madhu | yā etāḥ pūrvapakṣāparapakṣayo rātrayaḥ | tā madhukṛtaḥ | yānyahāni | te madhuvṛṣāḥ | sa yo ha vā etā madhukṛtaśca madhuvṛṣāṃśca veda | kurvanti hāsyaitā agnau madhu | nāsyeṣṭāpūrtaṃ dhayanti | atha yo na veda
3.10.10.d: इयं वाव सरघा । तस्या अग्निरेव सारघं मधु । या एताः पूर्वपक्षापरपक्षयो रात्रयः । ता मधुकृतः । यान्यहानि । ते मधुवृषाः । स यो ह वा एता मधुकृतश्च मधुवृषांश्च वेद । कुर्वन्ति हास्यैता अग्नौ मधु । नास्येष्टापूर्तं धयन्ति । अथ यो न वेद
3.10.10.m: This [earth] indeed is a queen bee; / her wild honey is Agni alone. / Those nights of the waxing fortnight and waning fortnight, / they are the honey-makers; / the days, / they are the honey-drones. / He who knows these honey-makers and honey-drones, / they make honey for him in the fire; / they do not suck away his sacrificial and charitable works. / Now, he who does not know [them],

3.10.10.s: na hāsyaitā agnau madhu kurvanti | dhayantyasyeṣṭāpūrtam | yo ha vā ahorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | nāhorātreṣvārtimārcchati | saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ darśā dṛṣṭeti | etāvanuvākau pūrvapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatīti | etāvanuvākāvaparapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni | nāhorātreṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda
3.10.10.d: न हास्यैता अग्नौ मधु कुर्वन्ति । धयन्त्यस्येष्टापूर्तम् । यो ह वा अहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि वेद । नाहोरात्रेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । संज्ञानं विज्ञानं दर्शा दृष्टेति । एतावनुवाकौ पूर्वपक्षस्याहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि । प्रस्तुतं विष्टुतं सुता सुन्वतीति । एतावनुवाकावपरपक्षस्याहोरात्राणां नामधेयानि । नाहोरात्रेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद
3.10.10.m: they do not make honey for him in the fire; / they suck out his accrued merit. / Whoever knows the names of the days and nights / does not incur misfortune among the days and nights. / 'Consciousness, discernment, new-moon night, seen night' — / these two anuvākas are the names of the days and nights of the bright fortnight. / 'Praised, separated, pressed, pressing' — / these two anuvākas are the names of the days and nights of the dark fortnight. / He does not incur misfortune among the days and nights, / who knows thus.

3.10.10.s: yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | na muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | citraḥ keturdātā pradātā savitā prasavitā'bhiśāstā'numanteti | ete'nuvākā muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni | na muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni veda | nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣvārtimārcchati | pavitraṃ paviyiṣyanthsahasvānthsahīyānaruṇo'ruṇarajā iti | ete'nuvākā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni
3.10.10.d: यो ह वै मुहूर्तानां नामधेयानि वेद । न मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । चित्रः केतुर्दाता प्रदाता सविता प्रसविताऽभिशास्ताऽनुमन्तेति । एतेऽनुवाका मुहूर्तानां नामधेयानि । न मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वा अर्धमासानां च मासानां च नामधेयानि वेद । नार्धमासेषु न मासेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । पवित्रं पवियिष्यन्थ्सहस्वान्थ्सहीयानरुणोऽरुणरजा इति । एतेऽनुवाका अर्धमासानां च मासानां च नामधेयानि
3.10.10.m:
Whoever knows the names of the muhūrtas / does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas. / 'Bright, beacon, giver, bestower, stimulator, instigator, commander, consenter' — / these anuvākas are the names of the muhūrtas. / He does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the names of the half-months and of the months / does not incur misfortune among the half-months nor among the months. / 'Purifier, about to purify, mighty, mightier, reddish, reddish-dust' — / these anuvākas are the names of the half-months and of the months.

He does not incur misfortune among the half-months nor among the months, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the names of the sacrificial rites, and of the seasons, and of the year / does not incur misfortune among the sacrificial rites, nor among the seasons, nor in the year. / 'Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Agni is the season, Prajāpati is the year' — / these anuvākas are the names of the sacrificial rites, and of the seasons, and of the year. / He does not incur misfortune among the sacrificial rites, nor among the seasons, nor in the year, / who knows thus. / Whoever knows the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas / does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas.

3.10.10.s: nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai yajñakratūnāṃ cartūnāṃ ca saṃvathsarasya ca nāmadheyāni veda | na yajñakratuṣu nartuṣu na saṃvathsara ārtimārcchati | agniṣṭoma ukthyo'gnir ṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvathsara iti | ete'nuvākā yajñakratūnāṃ cartūnāṃ ca saṃvathsarasya ca nāmadheyāni | na yajñakratuṣu nartuṣu na saṃvathsara ārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtān veda | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati |
3.10.10.d: नार्धमासेषु न मासेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वै यज्ञक्रतूनां चर्तूनां च संवथ्सरस्य च नामधेयानि वेद । न यज्ञक्रतुषु नर्तुषु न संवथ्सर आर्तिमार्च्छति । अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्योऽग्निर् ऋतुः प्रजापतिः संवथ्सर इति । एतेऽनुवाका यज्ञक्रतूनां चर्तूनां च संवथ्सरस्य च नामधेयानि । न यज्ञक्रतुषु नर्तुषु न संवथ्सर आर्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । यो ह वै मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तान् वेद । न मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति ।

3.10.10.s: idānīṃ tadānīmiti | ete vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtāḥ | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣvārtimārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | atho yathā kṣetrajño bhūtvā'nu praviśyānnamatti | evamevaitān kṣetrajño bhūtvā'nu praviśyānnamatti | sa eteṣāmeva salokatāṃ sāyujyamaśnute | apa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda
3.10.10.d: इदानीं तदानीमिति । एते वै मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्ताः । न मुहूर्तानां मुहूर्तेष्वार्तिमार्च्छति । य एवं वेद । अथो यथा क्षेत्रज्ञो भूत्वाऽनु प्रविश्यान्नमत्ति । एवमेवैतान् क्षेत्रज्ञो भूत्वाऽनु प्रविश्यान्नमत्ति । स एतेषामेव सलोकतां सायुज्यमश्नुते । अप पुनर्मृत्युं जयति । य एवं वेद
3.10.10.m: 'Now, then' — / these are the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas. / He does not incur misfortune among the muhūrtas of the muhūrtas, / who knows thus. / And just as one who knows the field, having entered, eats food, / even so he, knowing the field, having entered these, eats food. / He attains unison and co-residence with them. / He wards off re-death, / who knows thus.

3.10.11.s: kaściddha vā asmāllokātpretya | ātmānaṃ veda | ayamahamasmīti | kaścithsvaṃ lokaṃ na prati prajānāti | agnimugdho haiva dhūmatāntaḥ | svaṃ lokaṃ na prati prajānāti | atha yo haivaitamagniṃ sāvitraṃ veda | sa evāsmāllokātpretya | ātmānaṃ veda | ayamahamasmīti
3.10.11.d: कश्चिद्ध वा अस्माल्लोकात्प्रेत्य । आत्मानं वेद । अयमहमस्मीति । कश्चिथ्स्वं लोकं न प्रति प्रजानाति । अग्निमुग्धो हैव धूमतान्तः । स्वं लोकं न प्रति प्रजानाति । अथ यो हैवैतमग्निं सावित्रं वेद । स एवास्माल्लोकात्प्रेत्य । आत्मानं वेद । अयमहमस्मीति
3.10.11.m: A certain one, having departed from this world, / knows himself: / 'This am I.' / Another does not recognize his own world. / Deluded by fire, overcome with smoke, / he does not recognize his own world. / But whoever knows this Sāvitra fire, / he, having departed from this world, / knows himself: / 'This am I.'

3.10.11.s: sa svaṃ lokaṃ pratiprajānāti | eṣa u vevainaṃ tathsāvitraḥ | svargaṃ lokamabhivahati | ahorātrairvā idaṃ sayugbhiḥ kriyate | itirātrāyādīkṣiṣata | itirātrāya vratamupāguriti | tānihānevaṃ viduṣaḥ | amuṣmiṃ lloke śevadhiṃ dhayanti | dhītaṃ haiva sa śevadhimanu paraiti | atha yo haivaitamagniṃ sāvitraṃ veda
3.10.11.d: स स्वं लोकं प्रतिप्रजानाति । एष उ वेवैनं तथ्सावित्रः । स्वर्गं लोकमभिवहति । अहोरात्रैर्वा इदं सयुग्भिः क्रियते । इतिरात्रायादीक्षिषत । इतिरात्राय व्रतमुपागुरिति । तानिहानेवं विदुषः । अमुष्मिं ल्लोके शेवधिं धयन्ति । धीतं हैव स शेवधिमनु परैति । अथ यो हैवैतमग्निं सावित्रं वेद
3.10.11.m: He recognizes his own world. / And this Sāvitra [fire] / carries him up to the heavenly realm. / By the days and nights joined together this is done: / 'They were consecrated for this night; / they have undertaken the vow for this night.' / For him who does not know thus, / they suck out his treasure in yonder world. / Sucked dry, he follows after that treasure. / But he who knows this Sāvitra fire —

3.10.11.s: tasya haivāhorātrāṇi | amuṣmiṃ lloke śevadhiṃ na dhayanti | adhītaṃ haiva sa śevadhimanu paraiti | bharadvājo ha tribhirāyurbhirbrahmacaryamuvāsa | taṃ ha jīrṇiṃ sthaviraṃ śayānam | indra upa vrajyovāca | bharadvāja | yatte caturthamāyurdadyām | kimenena kuryā iti | brahmacaryamevainena careyamiti hovāca
3.10.11.d: तस्य हैवाहोरात्राणि । अमुष्मिं ल्लोके शेवधिं न धयन्ति । अधीतं हैव स शेवधिमनु परैति । भरद्वाजो ह त्रिभिरायुर्भिर्ब्रह्मचर्यमुवास । तं ह जीर्णिं स्थविरं शयानम् । इन्द्र उप व्रज्योवाच । भरद्वाज । यत्ते चतुर्थमायुर्दद्याम् । किमेनेन कुर्या इति । ब्रह्मचर्यमेवैनेन चरेयमिति होवाच
3.10.11.m: the days and nights / do not suck out his treasure in yonder world. / Unsucked, he follows after that treasure. / Bharadvāja lived in studenthood for three lifespans. / When he was lying decrepit and aged, / Indra approached and said: / 'Bharadvāja, / if I were to give you a fourth lifespan, / what would you do with it?' / 'I would just practice studenthood with it,' he said.

3.10.11.s: taṃ ha trīngirirūpānavijñātāniva darśayāṃcakāra | teṣāṃ haikaikasmānmuṣṭinā''dade | sa hovāca | bharadvājetyāmantrya | vedā vā ete | anantā vai vedāḥ | etadvā etaistribhirāyurbhiranvavocathāḥ | atha ta itaradananūktameva | ehīmaṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai sarvavidyeti
3.10.11.d: तं ह त्रीन्गिरिरूपानविज्ञातानिव दर्शयांचकार । तेषां हैकैकस्मान्मुष्टिना'ऽददे । स होवाच । भरद्वाजेत्यामन्त्र्य । वेदा वा एते । अनन्ता वै वेदाः । एतद्वा एतैस्त्रिभिरायुर्भिरन्ववोचथाः । अथ त इतरदननूक्तमेव । एहीमं विद्धि । अयं वै सर्वविद्येति
3.10.11.m: He showed him three unknown things, as it were, shaped like mountains. / From each one of them he took a handful. / He said, / addressing him: 'Bharadvāja, / these are the Vedas! / Boundless, indeed, are the Vedas! / This is what you have recited through those three lifespans, / and the rest of yours is just unstudied! / Come, know this: / this is all-knowledge!'

3.10.11.s: tasmai haitamagniṃ sāvitramuvāca | taṃ sa viditvā | amṛto bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokamiyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | amṛto haiva bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokameti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | eṣo eva trayī vidyā
3.10.11.d: तस्मै हैतमग्निं सावित्रमुवाच । तं स विदित्वा । अमृतो भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमियाय । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । अमृतो हैव भूत्वा । स्वर्गं लोकमेति । आदित्यस्य सायुज्यम् । य एवं वेद । एषो एव त्रयी विद्या
3.10.11.m: He declared this Sāvitra fire to him. / Having known it, / having become immortal, / he went to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya. / Having become immortal, / he goes to the heavenly realm, / to unison with Āditya, / who knows thus. / This is indeed the threefold knowledge.

3.10.11.s: yāvantaṃ ha vai trayyā vidyayā lokaṃ jayati | tāvantaṃ lokaṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | agnervā etāni nāmadheyāni | agnereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | vāyorvā etāni nāmadheyāni | vāyoreva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | indrasya vā etāni nāmadheyāni
3.10.11.d: यावन्तं ह वै त्रय्या विद्यया लोकं जयति । तावन्तं लोकं जयति । य एवं वेद । अग्नेर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । अग्नेरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । वायोर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । वायोरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । इन्द्रस्य वा एतानि नामधेयानि
3.10.11.m:
As great a world as one wins by the threefold knowledge, / that great a world he wins, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Agni; / he attains unison and co-residence with Agni, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Vāyu; / he attains unison and co-residence with Vāyu, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Indra;

he attains unison and co-residence with Indra, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Bṛhaspati; / he attains unison and co-residence with Bṛhaspati, / who knows thus. / These are the names of Prajāpati; / he attains unison and co-residence with Prajāpati, / who knows thus. / These are the names of brahman; / he attains unison and co-residence with brahman, / who knows thus. / That fire, wingless and tailless, is Vāyu himself; / Agni is its mouth; / yonder Āditya is its head. / Because it sews together all that is between these two deities, / therefore it is Sāvitra.

3.10.11.s: indrasyaiva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | bṛhaspatervā etāni nāmadheyāni | bṛhaspatereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | prajāpatervā etāni nāmadheyāni | prajāpatereva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | brahmaṇo vā etāni nāmadheyāni | brahmaṇa eva sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | sa vā eṣo'gnirapakṣapuccho vāyureva | tasyāgnirmukham | asāvādityaḥ śiraḥ | sa yadete devate antareṇa | tathsarvaṃ sīvyati | tasmāthsāvitraḥ
3.10.11.d: इन्द्रस्यैव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । बृहस्पतेर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । बृहस्पतेरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । प्रजापतेर्वा एतानि नामधेयानि । प्रजापतेरेव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । ब्रह्मणो वा एतानि नामधेयानि । ब्रह्मण एव सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एवं वेद । स वा एषोऽग्निरपक्षपुच्छो वायुरेव । तस्याग्निर्मुखम् । असावादित्यः शिरः । स यदेते देवते अन्तरेण । तथ्सर्वं सीव्यति । तस्माथ्सावित्रः

3.11.1.s: loko'si svargo'si | ananto'syapāro'si | akṣito'syakṣayyo'si | tapasaḥ pratiṣṭhā | tvayīdamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartā viśvasya janayitā | taṃ tvopadadhe kāmadughamakṣitam | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: लोकोऽसि स्वर्गोऽसि । अनन्तोऽस्यपारोऽसि । अक्षितोऽस्यक्षय्योऽसि । तपसः प्रतिष्ठा । त्वयीदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्ता विश्वस्य जनयिता । तं त्वोपदधे कामदुघमक्षितम् । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m: You are the world, you are the heavenly realm; / you are boundless, you are without end; / you are imperishable, you are inexhaustible; / support of ascetic heat; / within you is this: / all wonder, all being, all well-being; / maintainer of all, generator of all. / I place you, the inexhaustible wish-milking cow. / May Prajāpati set you; / with that deity, sit firm like the Aṅgirases!

3.11.1.d: तपोऽसि लोके श्रितम् । तेजसः प्रतिष्ठा । त्वयीदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्तृ विश्वस्य जनयितृ । तत्त्वोपदधे कामदुघमक्षितम् । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद

3.11.1.m:
You are the months, resting on the seasons,
the foundation of the half-months; within you
is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporters of all, the begetters of all.
As such I place you, yielding desires, imperishable.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!

3.11.1.s: ardhamāsāḥ stha māsu śritāḥ | ahorātrayoḥ pratiṣṭhā yuṣmāsu | idamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartāro viśvasya janayitāraḥ | tān va upadadhe kāmadughānakṣitān | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: अर्धमासाः स्थ मासु श्रिताः । अहोरात्रयोः प्रतिष्ठा युष्मासु । इदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्तारो विश्वस्य जनयितारः । तान् व उपदधे कामदुघानक्षितान् । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m:
You are the half-months, resting on the months,
the foundation of day and night; within you
is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporters of all, the begetters of all.
As such I place you, yielding desires, imperishable.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!

3.11.1.s: ahorātre stho'rdhamāseṣu śrite | bhūtasya pratiṣṭhe bhavyasya pratiṣṭhe | yuvayoridamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartryau viśvasya janayitryau | te vāmupadadhe kāmadughe akṣite | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: अहोरात्रे स्थोऽर्धमासेषु श्रिते । भूतस्य प्रतिष्ठे भव्यस्य प्रतिष्ठे । युवयोरिदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्त्र्यौ विश्वस्य जनयित्र्यौ । ते वामुपदधे कामदुघे अक्षिते । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m:
You two are day and night, resting on the half-months,
the foundations of what has been, the foundations of what will be;
within you two is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporters of all, the begetters of all.
As such I place you two, yielding desires, imperishable.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!

3.11.1.s: paurṇamāsyaṣṭakā'māvāsyā | annādāḥ sthānnadugho yuṣmāsu | idamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartryo viśvasya janayitryaḥ | tā va upadadhe kāmadughā akṣitāḥ | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: पौर्णमास्यष्टकाऽमावास्या । अन्नादाः स्थान्नदुघो युष्मासु । इदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्त्र्यो विश्वस्य जनयित्र्यः । ता व उपदधे कामदुघा अक्षिताः । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m:
Full moon, eighth day, new moon—
you are food-eating, yielding food; within you
is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporters of all, the begetters of all.
As such I place you, yielding desires, imperishable.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!

3.11.1.s: rāḍasi bṛhatī śrīrasīndrapatnī dharmapatnī | viśvaṃ bhūtamanuprabhūtā | tvayīdamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartrī viśvasya janayitrī | tāṃ tvopadadhe kāmadughāmakṣitām | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: राडसि बृहती श्रीरसीन्द्रपत्नी धर्मपत्नी । विश्वं भूतमनुप्रभूता । त्वयीदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्त्री विश्वस्य जनयित्री । तां त्वोपदधे कामदुघामक्षिताम् । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m:
You are ruler, you are lofty, you are prosperity, Indra’s consort, the consort of order,
pervading along with every being.
Within you is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporter of all, the begetter of all.
As such I set you down, fulfilling wishes, inexhaustible.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!

3.11.1.s: ojo'si saho'si | balamasi bhrājo'si | devānāṃ dhāmāmṛtam | amartyastapojāḥ | tvayīdamantaḥ | viśvaṃ yakṣaṃ viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ viśvaṃ subhūtam | viśvasya bhartā viśvasya janayitā | taṃ tvopadadhe kāmadughamakṣitam | prajāpatistvā sādayatu | tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā sīda
3.11.1.d: ओजोऽसि सहोऽसि । बलमसि भ्राजोऽसि । देवानां धामामृतम् । अमर्त्यस्तपोजाः । त्वयीदमन्तः । विश्वं यक्षं विश्वं भूतं विश्वं सुभूतम् । विश्वस्य भर्ता विश्वस्य जनयिता । तं त्वोपदधे कामदुघमक्षितम् । प्रजापतिस्त्वा सादयतु । तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवा सीद
3.11.1.m:
Splendorous might are you, overpowering might are you,
strength are you, radiance are you,
the immortal domain of the gods,
immortal, born of ascetic heat.
Within you is this:
every wonder, every being, every well-being,
the supporter of all, the begetter of all.
As such I set you down, fulfilling wishes, inexhaustible.
May Prajāpati seat you.
With that deity, Angiras-like, sit firm!
